Title: Digital Marketing Specialist

Department: Marketing

Reporting to: AD, Digital and Partner Marketing

Compensation: $58K - $75K USD

Employment: Full Time

Location: USA - Remote

Who we are:

World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.

About the Opportunity:

The Digital Marketing Specialist plays a critical role in supporting WES’s evolving digital marketing strategy. This position reports to the Associate Direct, Digital and Partner Marketing and focuses on day-to-day execution, reporting, and project management across SEM, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI searchability initiatives. The Digital Marketing Specialist assists with high-impact projects such as webinars, conferences, podcast series, and e-commerce transformation.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and optimize SEM campaigns across Google Ads and other platforms.
  • Implement SEO best practices for website content and landing pages.
  • Support GEO and AI-driven search optimization strategies to improve global visibility and future-proof WES’s digital presence.
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyze data, and prepare reports with actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with the content team to design and produce digital marketing assets for multiple channels (website, paid ads, social media).
  • Coordinate logistics, asset creation, and post-event reporting for applicant-facing webinars and major conferences.
  • Assist in planning, scheduling, and execution of WES’s new podcast series, ensuring timely delivery and cross-team collaboration.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on e-commerce transformation projects to align marketing strategies with new platform capabilities.
  • Review and help fix Google Tags in Google Tag Manager to ensure accurate tracking and reporting.
  • Executing, scheduling, and monitoring email campaigns to build engagement

Your Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business management, or in a related field preferred.
  • At least 2 years' experience as a marketing specialist, or a similar role.
  • Proven SEO experience.
  • Strong understanding of SEM, SEO, GEO, and digital analytics tools (Google Ads, GA4, Tag Manager).
  • Experience in gathering and interpreting customer experience information.
  • Knowledge of online customer engagement platforms and channels.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a client-centered approach.
  • Great organizational and time management abilities with the ability to handle shifting workloads and priorities.
  • Experience reporting up and identifying trends or opportunities for process or improvement.
  • Ability to both think strategically and execute tactically.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Project work demonstrating understanding of digital user experience and technology platforms.
  • Advanced computer proficiency.
  • Proactive, self-starter who is comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrates adaptability when it comes to shifting priorities and change.
  • Demonstrate strategic thinking driving campaigns, value propositions and managing multiple projects.
  • Outcome-orientated, quantitative, and qualitative problem-solver; comfortable with ambiguity, displaying superb pattern-recognition abilities.
  • Experienced working in a rapidly evolving, entrepreneurial, technology and service driven, client-focused environment.
  • Action orientated individual, thinking, and leading “out of the box.
  • Strong alignment with WES mission and values and demonstrates a growth mindset

What We Offer:

Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options.

  • Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions.
  • Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career.
  • Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change.
  • Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.

Values:

  • Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures.
  • Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity.
  • Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions.
  • Enterprising - We are resourceful, inventive, and driven.
  • Expertise - We challenge ourselves to be the best at what we do.

Inclusive Recruitment Process:

We welcome all applicants, irrespective of their experience perfectly fitting the job description, as we value diverse and innovative viewpoints. At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

Our Commitment:

At World Education Services, we're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the rich tapestry of our communities, both in the US and Canada. This commitment is underscored by our unwavering dedication to providing equal opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or genetics. This commitment extends to every aspect of employment, from recruitment and hiring to promotions, training, and benefits. We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local anti-discrimination laws. For us, diversity goes beyond compliance – it's about embracing unique perspectives and cultivating an environment where everyone feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential.

If you encounter challenges accessing or using our career site due to a disability, you may request reasonable accommodation by contacting us via email . Our Talent Acquisition team is dedicated to supporting qualified candidates by providing solutions that can meet their needs.

Please be advised that this email address is intended to receive and respond to inquiries concerning the accessibility of the online application system, and requests for assistance and accommodation during any part of the recruitment process. Résumés or applications sent to this email address will not be reviewed.

For more information about WES, please visit our website at.

raw.description:
Millennium Systems International is the leading business management software provider for the beauty and wellness industry and the maker of Meevo. Built over three decades of insight, innovation, and disruption, Meevo is a true all-in-one solution for sophisticated salons, spas, and med spas looking to bolster their successes. Meevo grows with you, supporting your goals and vision every step of the way with reliable tools you can count on today and tomorrow. Meevo is HIPAA compliant and user-friendly, with more than 150,000 users logging in daily to help their salon, spa, and med spa businesses thrive.

We’re just as passionate about our people as we are about our product. MSI is proud to be recognized as a New Jersey Top Workplace and Remote Top Workplace, along with earning Top Workplaces Culture Excellence Awards for Technology Industry, Work-Life Flexibility, Purpose & Values, Employee Well-Being, Employee Appreciation, and Professional Development. We are honored to have been named as a 2025 NJ Top Workplace for the fourth consecutive year. In addition to this core honor, MSI also earned two specialty awards: Top Technology Workplace and Top Remote Workplace, underscoring the company’s culture of innovation and flexibility.

Our values are the principles that guide how we think, act, and win—every day:
  • Innovation
  • Disruption
  • Empowerment
  • Inspire
  • Creativity
  • Integrity
As we expand our reach in the beauty and wellness industry, we are looking for a strategic and innovative Product Manager to lead the development and evolution of our AI powered SaaS solutions.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Set Direction
• Find the manual work that front-desk staff, schedulers, and owners do today across scheduling, service menus, commissions, retail inventory, and rebooking.
Turn it into agent-first capabilities that deliver measurable ROI, where agents take on the work and operators stay in control.
• Prioritize ruthlessly on customer impact. Use AI to synthesize customer feedback, usage data, and market evidence, then make the call without waiting for consensus and own the result.
• Stay current on LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, and tool use. Know their limits well enough to set goals that are both ambitious and realistic.
• Explain product and AI direction clearly to customers, partners, and internal stakeholders. Own the Product Intent and Pod Brief
• Author the Product Intent before pod work begins. It covers market context, user problem, desired outcomes, strategic rationale, and how the outcome will be measured in-product.
• Partner with your Pod Lead to turn the Intent into the Pod Brief. This is the pod’s living plan, covering solutions, constraints, acceptance criteria, risk, design approach, and the context AI agents need. It should be crisp enough to build from without added clarification
. • Own user experience decisions but bring in a UX Designer when design system changes are needed.
• Act as the pod’s single point of intake. Route outside requests through yourself and hold them for the next checkpoint rather than shifting priorities mid-build.

Build With Customers
• Spend real time with salon and spa owners, managers, and front-desk staff. Build fluency in how they run day to day, even if the domain is new to you.
• Prototype hands-on with Claude at the fidelity the idea needs and no more, and iterate with engineering in rapid cycles.
• Run the weekly Customer Feedback session. Bring the pod’s open questions to customers, and work what you hear into the next round.
• Run the weekly Stakeholder Feedback session. Decide with the pod what to act on now, what to queue, and what to leave undone, then send stakeholders that decision by end of day.
• Ship valuable increments continuously rather than perfect solutions later.

Measure and Land Outcomes
• Instrument each capability against the outcome you declared: time saved, fewer no shows and cancellations, better chair utilization, and protected retail margin.
• Bring the pod’s work and evidence to each checkpoint with your Pod Lead, from Intent approval through ship to pilot and go to market.
• Own internal UAT with SMEs before any customer sees the work. Close each release with a final demo before pilot.
• Treat documentation as a pod deliverable, so education, sales, and customer success have what they need at pilot, not at launch.
• Partner with Product Marketing well before launch. Make sure they understand what was built, who it serves, and the outcome it delivers, so they can communicate its value to customers clearly.
• Pull in help across Meevo as the work needs it, including other PMs, SMEs, customer success, sales, and education. The pod stays small; its reach does not.

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

Required
• 5+ years in product management, with at least 2 years shipping AI/ML-powered products to production.
• Domain experience in a vertical SaaS business management platform, including hands on work with integrated payments.
• Agent-first thinking: you frame problems as tasks AI agents can take on, not just features for people to click. You also have the technical depth to hold your own in architecture conversations.
• Builder mentality and speed: you co-create with engineers, prototype, and ship continuously. You make sound calls on imperfect evidence and own the result.
• Fast domain learning: you can get fluent in how salons and spas actually run without months of ramp-up.
• Clear communication with audiences ranging from front-desk staff to executives and investors.
• Experience defining and tracking metrics tied to business outcomes such as retention, utilization, adoption, and revenue.

Preferred
• Experience at software companies serving salons, spas, wellness, hospitality, or other appointment-based businesses, ideally in vertical SaaS.
• Hands-on, shipped work with LLMs, agentic systems, RAG, or AI workflow automation.
• Experience at a growth-stage or PE-backed SaaS company moving from traditional software to AI-native products.
• Understanding of API-first, cloud-native architecture and how it shapes what can ship fast.

Candidates must reside in the U.S. Millennium Systems International participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We Offer:
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Holidays
Enjoy a generous 3 weeks of Paid Time Off (PTO) that begins accruing with every pay period from your very first day! Plus, you’ll enjoy ten (10) paid holidays throughout 2025, along with five (5) paid sick days and one (1) personal day—because we believe in taking care of you!

Medical, Dental, and Vision Benefits
Your well-being is a priority! We offer subsidized Medical, Dental, and Vision plans, with coverage kicking in quickly. It's all about making sure you stay healthy, happy, and well-cared for.

Life Insurance
Peace of mind for you and your loved ones! We provide Life Insurance and Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D). What’s even better? Millennium Systems International fully covers the entire cost—100% on us!

Long-Term and Short-Term Disability Insurance
Stay secure no matter what life brings your way. Short-Term and Long-Term Disability insurance. And we’ve got your back—Millennium Systems International covers the full cost of Long-Term Disability at 100%.

401(k) Retirement Plan
Plan for your future with confidence! You’ll be eligible to enroll in our robust 401(k) plan. When you do, you’ll enjoy a 100% match on up to 4% of your contributions, thanks to our Safe Harbor plan. It’s our way of helping you build a brighter tomorrow.

Learning & Development Opportunities
We foster a culture of growth and professional excellence. As part of our benefits, we offer unlimited access to Udemy’s online courses, helping you refine your skills, explore new areas, and advance your career. Whether you're deepening your expertise or learning new technologies, we’re here to support your development every step of the way.

Description

Company

Nym empowers healthcare providers with AI-based solutions that simplify healthcare administration and optimize revenue cycle management processes.

Our innovative technology understands clinical language and transforms medical records into clear, actionable information. By fully automating medical coding, Nym improves operational efficiency, optimizes financial performance, and reduces administrative burdens, ultimately enabling providers to focus more time on patient care.

At Nym, the future is bright. Our engine currently processes over six million charts annually in more than 300 healthcare facilities across the US, enabling clinical and administrative teams to spend more time on patient care. We are backed by top-tier VCs and growing rapidly, with offices in New York City and Tel Aviv.

Join us!

About the Role

As Nym continues to scale, we are seeking a US-based Director of Product Management with deep healthcare domain expertise, strong product instincts, and a passion for transforming how healthcare organizations operate through AI.

This leader will play a critical role in shaping the future of autonomous coding and AI-driven revenue cycle transformation. You will partner closely with customers, coding and compliance experts, operations teams, implementation leaders, product, and engineering to translate complex real-world healthcare workflows into scalable, intelligent product capabilities.

We are looking for someone who understands both the operational realities of healthcare revenue cycle management and the art of building scalable products. The ideal candidate brings a strong point of view on productization, workflow design, and how AI can drive efficiency, quality, and customer value at scale.

Key Responsibilities

Product Strategy & Market Insights

  • Develop a deep understanding of HIM, coding, and revenue cycle workflows
  • Translate customer and operational challenges into scalable product solutions
  • Understand and incorporate: Clinical documentation workflows; DRG/CPT/ICD coding logic; Denial patterns and payer behavior; Coding compliance and operational realities

Productization & Scalability

  • Identify reusable patterns across customer implementations
  • Help reduce implementation-specific customization
  • Balance customer needs with scalable product design
  • Enabling an AI-first culture
  • Contribute to building strong product thinking and product culture across the organization

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with customers, compliance, implementation teams, customer operations, and product teams
  • Act as a key liaison between US market needs and Israel-based R&D teams
  • Support prioritization and decision-making around workflow standardization and scalability

Requirements

Required Experience

  • Deep expertise in healthcare revenue cycle management
  • Experience with Mid Revenue Cycle, Coding, CDI, HIM, or Revenue Integrity workflows
  • Strong understanding of provider operations and coding/compliance environments
  • Experience working with enterprise healthcare customers

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO)
  • Opportunities for career growth and professional development
  • Flexible work environment
  • Remote employee perks, such as monthly meal budget, home office stipend, and utilities reimbursement

Approximate base compensation: 180K - 230K. Final package may vary and will be determined by various factors including location, the role is expected to be performed, candidate experience, education, and ideal qualifications.

We are an equal-opportunity employer and encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. We are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace.

Role Title: STEM Expert – Chemistry & Computational Chemistry (PhD)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.
  2. Provide expert-level insights on reaction mechanisms, synthesis planning, spectroscopy analysis, molecular simulations, and electronic structure methods.
  3. Assess and optimize experimental protocols, simulation parameters, and software configurations for accuracy and reproducibility.
  4. Analyze chemical, spectroscopic, and simulation data and provide actionable recommendations.
  5. Leverage domain knowledge to guide the development and validation of chemistry-related AI models and tools.
  6. Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly, both in writing and verbally, to technical and non-technical collaborators.
  7. Document findings, methodologies, and best practices to ensure knowledge transfer across the customer’s team.

Areas of Expertise (we welcome applicants from any of the following):

  1. Organic synthesis & reaction mechanisms
  2. Inorganic & organometallic chemistry
  3. Physical & theoretical chemistry
  4. Analytical chemistry & spectroscopy
  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  1. PhD in chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, materials science, or a closely related field.
  2. Hands-on research lab experience, including wet lab experience for experimental subfields, or extensive simulation-heavy research for computational subfields.
  3. Deep expertise in at least one of the areas listed above.
  4. Professional written and spoken English (C1 or higher).
  5. Proficiency in Python and/or industry-standard tools in your subfield (e.g., Gaussian, ORCA, Psi4, GROMACS, LAMMPS, RDKit).
  6. Excellent quantitative, analytical, and scientific reasoning skills.
  7. Outstanding written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.
  8. Track record of rigorous scientific problem-solving in complex chemistry domains.

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

Senior ML Engineer (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $60–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for highly skilled Machine Learning Experts to contribute to an AI training project involving model development, training and inference systems, numerical computing, performance optimization, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating challenging machine-learning engineering tasks. A representative task may require implementing or modifying a model, constructing a reproducible training or inference workflow, optimizing memory or throughput, debugging numerical or system-level failures, and verifying that the resulting implementation satisfies objective correctness and performance requirements.

This is a very coding heavy role. Candidates but have experience using coding agents with python in their workflow.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Develop and validate machine-learning models, training pipelines, inference systems, and supporting infrastructure.
  2. Implement model components, data pipelines, evaluation systems, and numerical methods.
  3. Build reproducible programmatic workflows using Python and command-line tools.

Required Qualifications

  1. A master’s degree or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Engineering, or a closely related quantitative discipline.
  2. Strong professional or research experience in machine learning.
  3. Practical proficiency with Python and coding agents.

Equivalent tools may also be considered when the candidate demonstrates directly relevant depth.

Experience at a well-established technology company, AI laboratory, research organization, or other recognized engineering environment is strongly preferred. Exceptional open-source or academic experience may also qualify.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Aerodynamics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Pay: $80–$120/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)

Schedule: Flexible—you can choose the hours and days you work, including weekends if desired

We are looking for a highly skilled Aerodynamics Expert to contribute to an AI training project involving computational fluid dynamics, aerodynamic analysis, engineering simulation, and Python.

The work involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating engineering tasks that can be completed through programmatic, command-line-based workflows. A representative task may require analyzing an airfoil, preparing a computational domain and mesh, defining appropriate boundary conditions, running a CFD simulation, calculating lift and drag, and determining whether the resulting flow field is numerically and physically valid.

What You’ll Work On

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.
  9. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

raw.description:
The Director, Enterprise Strategy Analytics, leads a team responsible for transforming enterprise questions into decision-ready insights that enable strategic, client-centered business decisions. Reporting to the Vice President, Enterprise Analytics & Data Management, this role serves as a senior thought partner to executive, business, and functional leaders by connecting strategy, analytics, business acumen, and client insights to evaluate opportunities and solve complex enterprise challenges.

This leader is accountable for translating ambiguity into clarity, identifying opportunities for enterprise value creation, developing analytics and measurement frameworks, and ensuring leaders have the information, context, and recommendations necessary to make informed decisions.

The Director will lead a team focused on enterprise priorities and will partner closely with Enterprise Strategy, Finance, Data, and Divisional Leadership to establish shared measures, create common understanding, and enable enterprise performance.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead and advise on large, complex strategy and analytics engagements, answering the enterprise’s most important strategic questions, spanning multiple business areas, functions, products, and channels, ensuring Thrivent's most important strategic decisions are informed by trusted insights, rigorous analysis, and a scalable enterprise analytics capability.
  • Partner with senior executive leaders and business stakeholders to frame difficult or undefined business questions, clarify decision needs, identify relevant hypotheses, and establish engagement scope, deliverables, and measures of success.
  • Lead team of dedicated analysts with specialized knowledge and business acumen working on the most important strategic and business questions for the Enterprise. Establish engagement priorities and direct Enterprise Analytics resources toward the organization's highest-value strategic opportunities.
  • Facilitate hypothesis-driven problem solving to support business strategy, growth opportunities, operational effectiveness, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Proactively identify emerging risks, opportunities, and strategic questions where analysis or decision support could improve growth, client or advisor outcomes, investment prioritization, operating effectiveness, or transformation results.
  • Identify new ongoing data needs and requirements and champion the establishment of new systems and data sources in partnership with Data Product Leadership and appropriate business areas.
  • Define and evolve the Enterprise Analytics methodologies, and consulting practices.
  • Recruit, develop, and sustain a high-performing team while promoting a culture of shared accountability, operational excellence, and partnership across the organization.
  • Models Thrivent’s leadership competencies – Model the Way, Rally the Team, and Deliver Outcomes. ​
  • Support and/or develop an environment in which Thrivent employees and colleagues are focused on continuous improvement, exceptional employee engagement, and an unwavering commitment to our clients. Shape and/or support a culture that represents the Thrivent purpose, promise and values, ensuring that Thrivent’s trust and reputation remain strong with its clients.

Describe below the audience this role will interact with and level of influence they will have on those roles.


The Director, Enterprise Analytics, serves as a senior enterprise advisor and strategic partner who influences decisions across the organization through analytics, business acumen, and consultative leadership. This role works closely with the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) members, Enterprise Strategy Leaders, VP/SVP level audience across divisions to frame enterprise questions, , evaluate strategic opportunities, and deliver decision-ready recommendations. The role will require high levels of influencing, dealing with ambiguity, and strong communication skills to be effective. The role also provides direct leadership to a team of analytics professionals and plays a key role in shaping enterprise strategy execution, performance measurement, and analytics capability development.

QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS:

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Statistics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in analytics, business strategy, management consulting, enterprise performance management, decision support, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including coaching and developing professional-level talent.
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, cross-functional initiatives and influencing decisions across multiple business functions.
  • Experience partnering with Vice President, Senior Vice President, and executive-level leaders on strategic business challenges.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to translate data and analysis into actionable business recommendations.
  • Experience leading teams responsible for strategic analysis, business performance insights, problem solving, and decision support.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, facilitation, and executive presentation skills.
  • Proven ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to navigate ambiguity and structure complex business problems.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Economics, Analytics, Data Science, Finance, or a related field.
  • 5+ years experience in relevant industries - banking, insurance, and wealth management
  • Experience supporting executive strategy development, annual planning, investment prioritization, or business case development.
  • Experience operating within a matrixed or hub-and-spoke organizational model.
  • Experience leading organizational change, analytics transformation, or operating model redesign initiatives.
  • Familiarity with modern analytics, data visualization, and data management platforms.

raw.description:
Headquartered in Dublin, Ohio, Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global, integrated healthcare services and products company connecting patients, providers, payers, pharmacists and manufacturers for integrated care coordination and better patient management. Backed by nearly 100 years of combined experience, with more than 50,000 employees in nearly 60 countries, Cardinal Health ranks among the top 20 on the Fortune 500.

We boast tremendous opportunities to grow and apply technical skills to meet organizational needs, empowering talented team members who mentor and uplift others, led by leaders with a focus on employee development and well-being, dedicated training programs, and a collaborative atmosphere.

We currently have a career opening for a Customer Success Account Manager.

Time Zone Support

This role will support a hospital system in the Midwest and therefore requires someone to work traditional Eastern Time Zone hours.

Location

Remote

Travel

No known immediate travel however; one must be willing to travel once per quarter in US Midwest if necessary.

Role Overview

The Account Manager, Customer Success serves as the primary relationship owner and trusted partner for the healthcare system and its hospital and pharmacy stakeholders. This highly visible role represents Cardinal Health across a large, complex customer organization and is accountable for delivering a consistently responsive, accurate, and solutions-oriented customer experience.

The ideal candidate combines a strong passion for the customer experience with disciplined execution, analytical thinking, polished communication, and end-to-end ownership. This individual must be comfortable coordinating across multiple Cardinal Health teams, identifying the right accountable partners, and maintaining momentum until customer needs are fully addressed. Success requires a customer-centric mindset, sense of urgency, attention to detail, professional resilience, and the ability to translate complex information into practical actions and strategic value.

Responsibilities

The successful Account Manager will make the customer feel heard, understood, and well supported. One must ensure that requests are acknowledged, priorities are understood, information is accurate, and issues will continue moving without repeated follow-up. This person will remain steady and constructive when conversations are direct, persist when new ideas initially meet resistance, and continue finding practical ways to support the customer. Internally, this person will independently coordinate the right resources, communicate clear ownership and timelines, and bring both solutions and strategic insights that strengthen the partnership and demonstrate Cardinal Health’s value.

Additional Responsibilities:

  • Customer-focused and relationship driven: Builds trust through genuine support, empathy, reliability, and a strong understanding of the customer’s priorities and operating environment.
  • Communication: Communicates clearly, professionally, and proactively with customer and internal stakeholders; acknowledges requests promptly, sets expectations, and provides updates through resolution.
  • Organization/Multitasker: Manages a high volume of requests, recurring deliverables, meetings, reports, and time-sensitive priorities without losing track of commitments.
  • Strong sense of urgency: Quickly recognizes customer impact, prioritizes appropriately, and acts immediately when an issue is operationally, financially, or clinically significant.
  • Action oriented with end-to-end ownership: Drives complex issues to resolution, even when they require coordination across several teams, ongoing escalation, or rapid turnaround. The customer should not have to repeatedly follow up to keep work moving.
  • Analytics: This role will regularly use Excel with VLOOKUPs and other formulas, functions, and data tools, to organize, validate, reconcile, and analyze information efficiently. Identifies trends and risks and turns financial, operational, utilization, inventory, compliance, and service data into clear insights and recommended actions.
  • Presentation/Facilitation: Leads customer meetings and business reviews with confidence, explains complex information in an understandable way, and moves conversations from reporting into decisions, opportunities, and next steps.
  • Relationship Building: Learns processes quickly, identifies the right accountable partners, and builds effective cross-functional relationships to resolve issues efficiently.
  • Proactive and forward looking: Anticipates deadlines, risks, customer questions, and upcoming needs; plans and identifies opportunities before the customer must ask.
  • Dependability: Follows established processes, meets commitments, delivers accurate work on time, learns from mistakes, and puts safeguards in place to prevent recurring issues.
  • Demonstrates professional resilience: Receives direct or challenging feedback professionally and understands that it comes from the customer’s commitment to getting the right outcome. Manage tough conversations listening for the underlying concern, remains constructive, and uses the feedback to strengthen the partnership.
  • Persistent and comfortable leading through resistance: Recognizes that the customer may be hesitant to adopt new ideas or changes. Continues to look for practical, customer-centered ways to add value, adjusts the approach based on feedback, and keeps appropriate opportunities visible without becoming discouraged by initial resistance or repeated “no” responses.
  • Calm and adaptable: Maintains professionalism while balancing competing priorities, ambiguity, escalations, and urgent customer situations.

Qualifications

  • Prior experience in a direct customer facing role.
  • Prior experience executing in-person or live video presentations to external stakeholders and articulating metrics.
  • Strong Analytical and Reporting capabilities.
  • Excel VLOOKUP proficiency is required
  • Demonstrate ability to problem solve and develop key relationships with external and internal customers.
  • Willingness to travel once per quarter .
  • Team player, focused on continuous improvement and development.
  • Ability to identify needs, act and manage projects.
  • Strong communication skills.
  • Attention to detail.

Anticipated salary range: $68,500 - $107,470

Bonus eligible: No

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Application window anticipated to close: 11/20/26 *if interested in opportunity, please submit application as soon as possible.

The salary range listed is an estimate. Pay at Cardinal Health is determined by multiple factors including, but not limited to, a candidate’s geographical location, relevant education, experience and skills and an evaluation of internal pay equity.

Cardinal Health supports an inclusive workplace that values diversity of thought, experience and background. We celebrate the power of our differences to create better solutions for our customers by ensuring employees can be their authentic selves each day. Cardinal Health is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, pregnancy, veteran status, marital status, creed, status with regard to public assistance, genetic status or any other status protected by federal, state or local law.

raw.description:
WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We believe that real media impact comes from having a holistic understanding of consumers, culture, channels, content and commerce. Deciphering present day trends and historical performance from these interconnected and interdependent fields begins to represent our journey towards lasting growth for our clients.

As such, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Integrated Media Strategy & Planning who shares this approach and wants to join a talented team of growth marketers. This role is equal parts research and insight development as well as a strategic client partner. This person will join us as a key member of our strategy team; working alongside the directors to provide robust data-based strategies to our clients while also helping to guide larger cross-functional teams on campaign planning and ongoing optimizations.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor for internal cross-functional team members and external partners and become a steward of integrated planning and strategy core practices and solutions, with a particular focus on transforming the way consumers engage and shop across retail marketplaces and direct-to-consumer (D2C) environments.

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules.

You'll be responsible for:

Planning

  • Developing integrated media plans across D2C and retail marketplace business models, including tactic-level plans and investment scenarios, grounded in strategy, methodology benchmarks, and thoughtful assumptions.
  • Translating research insights into actionable media plans by synthesizing inputs from tools such as GWI, eMarketer, Pathmatics, Similarweb, and client or platform data (Meta, Google, Amazon, The Trade Desk, etc.).
  • Building full-funnel, channel-agnostic media plans using both CPC- and CPM-based investment frameworks.
  • Developing audience-first communication plans, including budget allocation, KPI frameworks, channel selection, and partner recommendations.
  • Aligning campaign planning with product launch calendars, retail media opportunities, and promotional moments across key U.S. retailers.
  • Applying a strong working knowledge of Amazon Ads (search, DSP, display) to support retail and performance-focused planning efforts. Familiarity with Best Buy Ads, Walmart Connect, and Target Roundel is highly valuable, with the ability to adapt plans to evolving retail media capabilities and brand footprints.
  • Maintaining awareness of global retail and go-to-market considerations to inform planning for international expansion and multi-market execution.

Collaboration

  • Serving as a dependable thought partner to strategy leads, helping to operationalize strategic planning frameworks and guide planning through to activation.
  • Working closely with cross-functional team members both externally and internally across Client Services, Media Activation, Data Science, and Creative to deliver connected plans and ensure seamless campaign execution, including tracking plan vs. actuals.
  • Navigating complexity across platforms, stakeholders, and business models, and translating that complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Presenting and articulating planning recommendations clearly to both internal and external stakeholders with confidence.
  • Boosting morale and contributing to an inclusive, supportive team culture by being a positive example in group problem solving and growing careers of junior team members.
  • Sharing platform trends, retail innovations, and media shifts with the team to inspire fresh thinking and continuous improvement.

You'll need to have:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in media planning and strategy, with an emphasis on digital media buying both on and off retail environments.
  • 2+ years experience using planning and research tools such as GWI, Pathmatics, Comscore, eMarketer, and platform-native dashboards.
  • 2+ years of client facing and team management experience.
  • Strong familiarity with Amazon’s retail media solutions; knowledge of Best Buy, Target, Walmart, and other retail platforms is a strong plus.
  • Proven experience planning across both CPC and CPM channels, with a clear understanding of brand and performance media and how they work together.
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, full-funnel planning, and measurement frameworks.
  • Ability to clearly and concisely articulate a persuasive point of view, both written and verbal, presenting to project stakeholders.
  • A curious and creative mindset, while also rigorous and analytical.
  • Energized by the evolving intersection of media, retail, technology, and consumer behavior.
  • Strong collaboration, client relationship building, and leadership skills.
  • Experience navigating cross-functional teams and dynamic organizational environments.

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle, or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

raw.excerpt: Our MissionAt Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life.
raw.description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters.

Job Summary

Role Overview


Palo Alto Networks is seeking an experienced, strategic, and proactive Senior Manager, Public Policy & Government Affairs responsible for Australia and New Zealand, based in Australia, preferably in Sydney or Canberra.


In this role, you will lead engagement with Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments, the New Zealand Government, parliamentary stakeholders, and key cybersecurity, national security, and digital government agencies. Priority relationships will include Australia’s Department of Home Affairs and the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD), including its Australian Cyber Security Centre (ACSC), and New Zealand’s Government Communications Security Bureau (GCSB), including its National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC).


You will work cross-functionally with executive leadership, Go to Market Teams, Product Management, and Threat Intelligence (Unit 42), to shape public policy outcomes that foster innovation, protect critical infrastructure, and strengthen trust in the Australian and New Zealand digital economies. Reporting to the Vice President, JAPAC, you will coordinate with regional and global public policy colleagues to align local engagement with broader business and policy priorities.


Key Responsibilities


Policy Strategy & Advocacy: Design and execute strategic advocacy initiatives across Australia and New Zealand on issues including AI security, supply chain risk management, zero trust, incident reporting, critical infrastructure resilience, and cloud security. Engage with Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand ministries, departments, and agencies.


Government & Parliamentary Engagement: Develop trusted relationships with ministers’ offices, senior public servants, relevant parliamentary committees, and government cybersecurity leaders in both countries. Priority stakeholders will include:

  • Australia: The Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, the Department of Defence, the Department of Industry, Science and Resources, the Digital Transformation Agency, and relevant State and Territory cybersecurity and digital government bodies.
  • New Zealand: GCSB/NCSC, the Department of the Prime Minister and Cabinet, the Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment, the Department of Internal Affairs, and relevant defence, education, health and digital government stakeholders.


Qualifications

  • 8 plus years of relevant experience in cybersecurity public policy, technology policy, or government affairs, preferably spanning government and the private technology sector.
  • Experience within Australian or New Zealand government, a ministerial office, parliamentary committee, or a relevant cybersecurity, national security, or digital government agency is highly alued. Experience working across both markets is desirable.
  • Subject Matter Expertise: Deep familiarity with the Australian and New Zealand cybersecurity nand technology policy landscapes, including Australia’s ASD Information Security Manual, Essential Eight, and Information Security Registered Assessors Program (IRAP), and New Zealand’s Information Security Manual and Protective Security Requirements.
  • Strong understanding of critical infrastructure security, government security and cloud assurance settings, software supply chain security, and emerging AI policy frameworks.
  • Familiarity with international cybersecurity frameworks and their relevance to both markets is also desirable.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Computer Science, Law, or a related field.
  • Exceptional written, analytical, and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to synthesise complex technical security topics for non-technical policymakers, senior government officials, and C-suite executives.
  • An established network of trusted relationships across Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand government stakeholders.
  • Strong relationships with the Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, GCSB/NCSC, relevant parliamentary committees, and cybersecurity, national security, and digital government agencies are particularly valuable.
  • Based in Australia, with Sydney or Canberra preferred, and willing to travel regularly to Canberra, other Australian capitals, and New Zealand, particularly Wellington, for government and stakeholder engagement.

Our Commitment

raw.excerpt: About Avaya Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.
raw.description:
About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

The Opportunity

Enterprise software should be as intuitive, engaging, and seamless as the consumer experiences people use every day. At Avaya, we’re bringing that standard to enterprise customer experience by transforming Avaya Infinity into a next-generation Connection Center—one that goes beyond traditional contact center workflows to create more intelligent, connected, and personalized customer interactions.

Our vision is built around three principles: Connections, Context, and Insights. By bringing together real-time data, customer history, and AI-powered capabilities, Avaya Infinity will help organizations deliver more meaningful interactions across web, desktop, mobile, and AI-driven workflows.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Designer – AI & Enterprise UX to help define and bring this vision to life. This is an opportunity to shape the experience of a strategic enterprise platform—not only designing new capabilities, but reimagining existing workflows, modernizing the user experience, and establishing the design systems and standards that will guide the platform forward.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll operate at the intersection of product strategy, design, and engineering. You’ll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences, use rapid prototyping and AI-enabled design tools to accelerate decision-making, and partner closely with engineering to translate design intent into high-quality products. Your influence will extend beyond individual features to the overall usability, consistency, and evolution of Avaya Infinity.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the Avaya Infinity Experience: Translate the vision for Connections, Context, and Insights into intuitive, human-centered experiences across web, desktop (Windows/Mac), and mobile—raising the bar for enterprise software usability and design.

  • Design New Capabilities and Modernize Existing Experiences: Lead UX and product design for key Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives while identifying and addressing usability gaps, outdated workflows, and inconsistencies across the platform.

  • Accelerate Innovation Through Rapid Prototyping: Use interactive prototypes, AI-enabled design tools, and iterative testing to validate concepts early, clarify requirements, and help engineering teams move from idea to implementation faster.

  • Build Scalable Design Systems and Engineering Workflows: Establish and evolve Figma components, variables, design tokens, and handoff standards in close partnership with engineering. Ensure designs translate effectively into production across React, Electron, and native applications while minimizing rework and improving implementation quality.

  • Design the Next Generation of AI-Powered Experiences: Create intuitive ways to incorporate real-time agent assistance, automated interaction summaries, predictive routing, and generative AI capabilities—making complex information actionable without overwhelming users.

  • Lead UX Strategy Across Product and Engineering: Own the UX roadmap for Avaya Infinity, influence product priorities, and advocate for user-centered design in executive reviews. Partner across Product Management, Solution Architecture, and Engineering to align design decisions with customer needs, technical feasibility, and business outcomes.

What You Bring

  • Enterprise Product Design Experience: Significant experience designing complex B2B software across web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Experience with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, or other enterprise SaaS products is highly valued.

  • A Strong UX Portfolio: Demonstrated ability to transform complex workflows and information-dense interfaces into intuitive, modern experiences. Your portfolio shows how you balance usability, visual design, and business requirements to simplify the user experience.

  • Strategic Thinking and Hands-On Execution: Ability to move seamlessly between defining a long-term UX vision and delivering high-quality designs for immediate product priorities. You know how to modernize existing experiences while building a foundation for future capabilities.

  • Advanced Figma and Design Systems Expertise: Strong command of Figma, including variables, design tokens, component libraries, auto-layout, and reusable design patterns. Experience establishing scalable design systems and integrating design workflows with frontend development is essential.

  • Rapid Prototyping and AI-Enabled Design: Experience using interactive prototyping, iterative testing, and emerging AI-powered design tools to validate concepts quickly, resolve ambiguity, and accelerate product development.

  • Close Collaboration with Engineering: Proven ability to partner with frontend engineers to evaluate technical feasibility, communicate design intent, and deliver implementation-ready specifications across modern web, desktop, and native applications.

  • Product and Customer Experience Acumen: Understanding of complex customer interaction workflows, omnichannel experiences, real-time data, and analytics. You connect design decisions to customer needs, product strategy, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Accessibility and Inclusive Design: Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and experience incorporating inclusive design principles into complex enterprise applications from the outset.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences, including real-time agent assistance, contextual recommendations, automated summaries, or generative AI workflows.

  • Familiarity with React, Electron, native application architectures, and design-to-code workflows.

  • Experience leading design strategy and influencing product and engineering decisions as a senior individual contributor in a cross-functional environment.

How Success Is Measured

  • Design Delivery and Engineering Velocity: Deliver high-quality, implementation-ready designs for Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives on schedule. Use rapid prototyping, clear specifications, and close engineering collaboration to target a 25–30% improvement in design-to-code velocity.

  • Platform Modernization and UX Improvement: Evaluate existing Infinity experiences, identify the highest-impact usability challenges, and establish a prioritized UX improvement roadmap. Reduce friction in legacy workflows while improving consistency, usability, and scalability across the platform.

  • Design System Adoption and Handoff Quality: Establish consistent Figma components, design tokens, and design-to-code workflows across web, desktop, and mobile. Reduce ambiguity, minimize developer rework, and improve the fidelity of implemented designs.

  • Measurable User Experience Impact: Improve usability through measurable reductions in cognitive load, unnecessary interaction steps, and task completion time. Track progress through usability testing, System Usability Scale (SUS) scores, and agent satisfaction (Agent CSAT), where applicable.

Why Join Avaya?

At Avaya, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise customer experience—not simply refine existing interfaces. You’ll help transform Avaya Infinity into a modern, AI-enabled Connection Center that brings together Connections, Context, and Insights to make customer interactions more intuitive, intelligent, and meaningful.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you can influence product strategy, establish the UX direction for a strategic platform, and see your work move from concept to production. You’ll combine creative ownership and hands-on design with close collaboration across Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering.

If you’re energized by simplifying complex technology, challenging legacy design conventions, and using emerging AI capabilities to create better user experiences, Avaya offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on software that supports customer interactions around the world.

The pay range for this opportunity is up to $187,800 in total compensation, inclusive of base salary and bonus. Actual total compensation will vary based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

Experience

5 - 8 Years of Experience

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Footer

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

Avaya is an Equal Opportunity employer and a U.S. Federal Contractor. Our commitment to equality is a core value of Avaya. All qualified applicants and employees receive equal treatment without consideration for race, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran or any other protected characteristic. In general, positions at Avaya require the ability to communicate and use office technology effectively. Physical requirements may vary by assigned work location. This job brief/description is subject to change. Nothing in this job description restricts Avaya right to alter the duties and responsibilities of this position at any time for any reason.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Learning and Development Business Partner, to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will strengthen management capability and team effectiveness across EMED Group through practical, accessible learning. Working in partnership with operational leaders and People colleagues, deliver Management Acceleration Pathway (MAP) modules, bespoke local training and Insights-based development, while expanding and maintaining the online learning library.

This hands-on national role translates business and team development needs into learning that managers can apply every day, supporting consistent management practice, operational effectiveness and patient-centred service delivery.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual car allowance
  • Performance related bonus
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and deliver MAP modules nationally through face-to-face workshops, virtual sessions and blended learning.
  • Build managers’ practical skills in communication, coaching, constructive feedback, delegation, team development, managing change and everyday management conversations.
  • Tailor examples, exercises and resources to operational settings while maintaining agreed MAP learning outcomes and delivery standards.
  • Work with HR team and subject matter experts to keep management content accurate, relevant and aligned with organisational policies and priorities.
  • Partner with operational leaders and HR Business Partners to understand local priorities and identify management and team development needs.
  • Design and deliver bespoke workshops, team development days and targeted training, adapting relevant MAP modules to meet local needs.
  • Support teams to strengthen communication, collaboration, clarity of responsibilities and shared ownership of agreed actions.
  • Promote MAP, team development and online learning through clear communications that explain the benefits and encourage participation.
  • Equip managers to deliver effective team briefings, listening conversations and communication during change through targeted training and practical resources.
  • Coordinate and deliver Insights-based development sessions in accordance with the chosen tool’s requirements and applicable practitioner accreditation.
  • Help managers and colleagues understand working preferences, adapt communication and collaborate effectively, without labelling people or making assumptions about capability.
  • Support teams to agree practical actions and revisit progress after sessions.
  • Maintain a prioritised development plan for new online modules, informed by management learning needs, recurring local requirements and organisational priorities.
  • Design and build engaging digital modules with clear learning objectives, practical scenarios, knowledge checks and supporting resources.
  • Use evaluation findings to improve programmes and inform priorities, distinguishing the contribution of learning from other factors affecting operational outcomes.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Experience designing and delivering management development and team learning in a multi-site or geographically dispersed organisation.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to engage different audiences through face-to-face and virtual delivery.
  • Ability to identify learning needs with stakeholders and translate them into practical, proportionate development solutions.
  • Experience creating digital learning modules using authoring tools and working with learning management systems.
  • Understanding of adult learning, blended learning and methods for evaluating learning application.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder relationships and the confidence to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage a national delivery schedule alongside bespoke requests and content development deadlines.
  • Commitment to accessible learning, confidentiality, respectful working relationships and patient-centred service delivery.
  • Ability to meet the national travel requirements of the role.

Desirable experience and qualifications

  • Relevant learning and development, training, coaching or organisational development qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Accreditation in the Insights tool used by the organisation, or willingness to complete the required accreditation before independent delivery.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, patient transport, logistics or other operational, shift-based services.
  • Experience linking engagement feedback with team development and management learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

Remote/Hybrid

Job Overview

At Relativity, we build technology that helps people uncover the truth in complex data. Our software (SaaS) empowers legal professionals, governments, and organizations around the world to navigate high stakes matters with confidence, clarity, and integrity. By combining advanced AI, powerful analytics, and cloud-based technology, we help teams make sense of massive volumes of information and move critical work forward faster and more accurately. Every role at Relativity contributes to creating scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions with real-world impact—while fostering a culture where curiosity, collaboration, and inclusion thrive and where employees help shape the future of legal technology. 

Department Description:

The AI and Applied Sciences department at Relativity drives innovation by developing advanced AI solutions and applied research to solve complex legal and compliance challenges.

Job Summary:

The Legal Data Intelligence SME will bring expertise as a practicing litigator and deep knowledge of discovery. You’ll draw on this expertise to help us build and evaluate our key generative AI capabilities. You’ll interface with other litigators, both helping us explain how our technology operates to them and taking their feedback and providing it back to our applied science team, conveying the nuances of both the technology and the needs of the litigator persona as you do so. This role bridges legal expertise with technical innovation, guiding the design and deployment of solutions that optimize data intelligence for legal workflows.

Job Description and Requirements

Job Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to Relativity applied science strategy by leveraging your subject matter expertise to design, build and improve our tests, benchmarks, and other evaluation systems for our generative AI solutions.
  • Work internally with our applied scientists, product managers, designers, engineers, and customer enablement teams to provide internal feedback and suggestions on the enablement, performance, usability, and functionality of our generative AI solutions.
  • Work externally with our clients and our industry to explain how our generative AI systems work and to receive their feedback on the performance of our generative AI in analyzing and classifying documents, identifying information that needs to be protected, and extracting and curating knowledge.
  • Develop and deliver training and documentation for internal teams on legal data intelligence workflows and best practices.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • A Juris Doctorate and at least 3-5 years of experience as a practicing attorney; some but not all of this requirement may be satisfied by equivalent experience working for a legal service provider or legal technology vendor.
  • Deep interest in the use of generative AI to responsibly advance the practice of law and access to justice.
  • Strong and clear communicator, able to synthesize and communicate complex technical concepts and results to internal and external audiences.
  • Experience in discovery or legal technology platforms.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Significant litigation experience and deep understanding of the processes of investigations and litigation, including discovery and pre-trial practice
  • At least 5 years of experience as a practicing attorney
  • Strong understanding of the traditional EDRM and broader Legal Data Intelligence use cases and workflows.

Suggested Skills:

Business Intelligence (BI), Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Intelligence, Data Visualization, Information Security, Legal Practices, Legal Research, Risk Management, Structured Query Language (SQL)
