raw.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Opportunity at a Glance

We are interested in developing long-term relationships with superior instructors who have high professional standards, excellent communication skills, enthusiasm and a commitment to providing the finest practitioner-focused education. We are seeking primarily Industry Professionals to share their knowledge and experience with undergraduate students in a variety of fields. Commitment is on a course-by-course basis.

Human Biology with Lab (BIOS150)

In this introductory course students study the biological principles governing the normal state of the human body with an emphasis on the structure and function of major organ systems. Through virtual labs, case studies, discussions, and other learning activities, students explore core concepts in biochemistry, biology, genetics, anatomy and physiology to gain an understanding of how human body systems normally work together to maintain homeostasis and respond to disease. The course will also cover topics such as human development, fluid dynamics, reproduction, nutrition, and the body's defenses against illness.

Topics include:

  • Demonstrate how anatomical root words give rise to anatomical and medical terminology.
  • Describe the basic structure and function of human cells including cell transportation and cell division.
  • Explain the roles of the four common biological macromolecules.
  • Explain the basic structure, function and organization of tissues within the organ systems in the normal state.
  • Recall how various factors including nutrition, environment, and exercise influence the state of the human body.
  • Describe common disease states and disorders and their effects on normal function.
  • Describe the process of reproduction including the flow of genetic information and basic genetic calculations.

Responsibilities

  • Develops and provides students with an approved Covista/Chamberlain University syllabus that follows an established template, which includes the terminal course objectives.
  • Organizes, prepares, and regularly revises and update all course materials.
  • Conduct the course using our student focused coaching model, focused on proactive outreach using phone, email communication, and use of other communication technologies
  • Uses appropriate technological options for online technologies and course-related software, including Websites, e-mail, and online discussions for preparing the course and making it accessible to students.
  • Models effective oral and written communications that engage the students, provide clarity, and improve student learning.
  • Sets clear expectations for the course by publishing course terminal objectives, assignment/examinations dates, and weight the distribution of various evaluation categories.
  • Ensures that the content and level of material included on exams correspond to the course terminal objectives.
  • Demonstrates consistency and fairness in the preparation and grading of exams and provide timely feedback to students.
  • Performs/Completes other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards
  • Master's Degree is required for all faculty positions (with 18 graduate hours in the subject being taught for undergraduate teaching - Human Biology, Biology, Anatomy & Physiology or Microbiology). Required
  • Ability to provide unofficial and official transcripts for all earned degrees from a regionally accredited institution. (or a NACES approved US course-by-course equivalency evaluation for degrees earned and conferred outside of the US) Required
  • A minimum of 1-year online teaching experience. Preferred
  • Ability to recognize signs of disengagement or academic struggle and intervene early
  • Passion for student success and care for students
  • Faculty must have requisite subject matter expertise and outstanding communication skills.
  • Faculty must also have excellent motivational and instructional skills in a diverse and non-traditional environment.
  • Must be able to work in a collegial manner and facilitate the efforts of diverse groups.
  • Additional requirements driven by state licensing or accreditation considerations may apply. Required

Chamberlain Visiting Professor Position - Online:
In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is between $715/Earned Credit Hour to $1,950/Earned Credit Hour, depending on the candidate’s education and experience.

Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

About Chamberlain University

Chamberlain University has a 130-year history and the mission to educate, empower, and embolden diverse healthcare professionals who advance the health of people, families, communities, and nations. Our regionally accredited University is comprised of the College of Nursing and the College of Health Professions. Our College of Nursing offers a Bachelor of Science in Nursing (BSN) degree program at 23 locations and online post-licensure degree programs and certificates including RN to BSN, RN to MSN, a Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) with six Specialty Tracks, and a Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP). Our College of Health Professions offers online options with a Master of Public Health degree, Master of Physician Assistant Studies, Public Health Certificate programs, and a Master of Social Work degree. Learn more about Chamberlain University, part of Covista, at .

There is one very significant way Chamberlain is different than other Universities - Chamberlain Care®. Healthcare education is offered in a culture of service excellence and care in four ways: care for self, care for colleagues, care for patients/clients, care for all. By living Chamberlain Care®, we’ve built a culture in which colleagues and students thrive and we graduate extraordinary healthcare professionals who transform the health of people worldwide.

Chamberlain Care® is the guiding principle we provide to each other and to our students to help our students achieve their goals, reach their dreams and impact healthcare at a national level.
If you're ready to live Chamberlain Care®, we invite you to apply today!

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

We are looking for a Product Support Engineer to join our team. This is a Remote role, reporting to the Senior Manager, Customer Support in the Product Support department. At Zscaler, our Customer Success Organization is a global, customer-focused team dedicated to delivering high-impact experiences and identifying innovative solutions. Our high-performance radars work in all weather and are designed for autonomous vehicles, uncrewed aircraft & drones, and security of borders, critical infrastructure, and smart cities. The company combines the patented technology of metamaterials with powerful software to create a radar sensor with unprecedented performance at commercial price points. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

Echodyne is seeking a Federal Emerging Partner Business Developer (BD) to join our fast-growing team.

ROLE OVERVIEW

raw.title: Corporate Counsel
raw.excerpt: About DonorboxDonorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations.
raw.description:
About Donorbox

Donorbox is a leading fundraising platform and donor management system for nonprofit organizations. Our mission is to accelerate positive impact worldwide by helping nonprofits become highly effective at raising funds and managing their supporter base. Since 2014, we have powered more than 100,000 global organizations to raise over $4 billion in donations. 🚀

Our fast-growing company is profitable and bootstrapped with a healthy run rate. We have a fully distributed and diverse 150-person team based in 16+ states and 23+ countries. In 2026, Donorbox was named by Built In as one of the Best Places to Work in Washington, DC.

🏅 Donorbox is rated the #1 software for fundraising, donor management, and nonprofit payment on G2 based on hundreds of verified customer reviews — a reflection of the care our team puts into building products that nonprofits trust.

The Role

As Corporate Counsel, you’ll be Donorbox's in-house lawyer. You’ll own our day-to-day legal work, manage our outside counsel on specialized matters, and act as the legal partner to every team in the company: Sales, Partnerships, Product and Engineering, Customer Success, Finance and People. You’ll also manage our Senior Compliance Manager, setting priorities and partnering closely on regulatory, privacy and security compliance.

This is not a back-office or narrow specialist role. We are looking for a business partner who happens to be a lawyer: someone who uses legal as an advantage for the company, not only as a defense. You won't hand the business a bare "yes" or "no." You'll bring options, the risk level of each, and a recommendation, and you'll be comfortable standing behind that recommendation.

What You'll Own

1. Commercial Contracts & Revenue Enablement

  • Draft, review and negotiate complex enterprise and SaaS customer agreements, balancing risk with the commercial reality of winning and expanding business.
  • Set clear guardrails for pricing, discounts, custom terms and non-standard agreements, with defined fallbacks and approval thresholds.
  • Build a contract playbook and standard templates so most deals close without bespoke legal review.
  • Work with Finance to build the right financial mechanics into contracts (payment terms, multi-year commitments, renewals, termination rights) so they match how we model revenue.
  • Design collections and recovery terms, including clawback provisions.
  • Support customer procurement, privacy and security reviews, and partner with Sales and Customer Success to remove legal friction from closing and retaining customers.

2. Partnerships, Channel & Vendor Agreements

  • Create the frameworks, standards and templates that let our partnerships scale: technology and integration partners, payment providers, hardware and fulfillment vendors, denominational and network partners, and referral, ambassador and reseller programs.
  • Structure revenue share, exclusivity, liability allocation, data ownership, termination rights and joint branding.
  • Balance legal protection with commercially workable terms that preserve partner relationships.
  • Negotiate vendor agreements that protect Donorbox when we don't get what we pay for.
  • Resolve live contractual issues with technology, hardware and payment partners.

3. Product, Regulatory, Privacy & AI

  • Monitor the rules that govern our business: online fundraising, payments, platform fees and tipping, PCI, nonprofit regulation, and the growing set of state laws that regulate donation platforms directly.
  • Reason from first principles about what the law actually requires, separate real obligations from industry noise, and weigh the cost of compliance work against the risk it removes.
  • Own privacy compliance across GDPR, CCPA and state privacy laws.
  • Guide the responsible use of AI and customer data. You'll learn how our systems work under the hood, so your guidance protects private data without blocking the product.
  • Partner with Engineering on security governance, including SOC 2, audits and customer security requirements.
  • Lead regulatory work as we expand into new markets, and spot where the regulatory landscape creates an opening for Donorbox, not only a risk.
  • Divide legal and compliance work with the Senior Compliance Manager, so routine compliance runs without your direct involvement and escalations reach you quickly.

4. Customer Escalations & Disputes

  • Advise Customer Success on complex customer issues, including account suspension and termination decisions.
  • Set clear escalation paths for disputes, fraud, regulatory inquiries and threatened or active litigation.
  • Provide approved language for high-risk incidents, investigations and sensitive customer communications.
  • Manage litigation and disputes with outside counsel.

5. Employment & Corporate Risk

  • Draft and maintain offer letters, employment agreements and contractor agreements, and manage worker classification.
  • Give managers the confidence and process to address performance and conduct issues promptly, with clear documentation and one high standard applied consistently to everyone.
  • Advise on separations and lead legally sensitive employee investigations, bringing in outside counsel where the matter calls for it.
  • Partner with People on employment policies, and advise on international employment as we hire outside the U.S.
  • Own the company's insurance program, including D&O, E&O, cyber and general liability.

6. Corporate, Equity & IP

  • Own equity administration and the cap table (Carta) in partnership with Finance.
  • Support corporate governance and Board matters, and serve as a trusted legal advisor to the CEO and executive team.
  • Prepare the company for future financings and take on corporate work in-house where it makes sense, reducing reliance on outside counsel.
  • Manage our trademark portfolio, enforce our brand, and respond to competitor misrepresentation.
  • Protect our IP across product, technology, content and brand, with sound IP assignment from employees, contractors and partners.

Your First 90 Days

  • Map the landscape. Assess active matters, contracts, policies, outside counsel and compliance obligations, and deliver a prioritized legal roadmap.
  • Right-size outside counsel. Set a clear framework for when we use outside counsel and when we handle work in-house.
  • Close regulatory gaps. Assess Donorbox against the state donation-platform and fundraising laws that apply to us, and recommend fixes.
  • Unblock the business. Resolve the highest-priority partner, vendor and customer agreements that are slowing us down today.
  • Launch the playbooks. Ship the first commercial contract playbook and partnership templates, with standard positions, fallbacks and approval thresholds.
  • Set the operating rhythm. Make "options, risk levels, recommendation" the default for legal advice, with clear escalation paths for every team.

What We're Looking For

  • A U.S. law degree (J.D.) and active bar admission in at least one U.S. state.
  • 5+ years of legal experience, including at least 4 years in-house at a SaaS or high-growth technology company.
  • Experience as the sole or most senior lawyer at a company, or the #2 lawyer on a legal team of five or fewer.
  • Hands-on experience negotiating enterprise SaaS and partnership agreements.
  • Hands-on experience with employment matters, including terminations, investigations and employment agreements.
  • Working knowledge of privacy and compliance frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA and PCI.
  • Experience managing outside law firms and an outside counsel budget.
  • Curiosity about technology: you pick up technical concepts quickly, get the nuances right, and understand how AI and data systems work well enough to advise on them with confidence.
  • Sound business judgment, comfort making calls under ambiguity, and the ability to explain legal issues plainly to executives and non-lawyers.
  • Experience managing or mentoring another legal or compliance professional (preferred).

Especially Valuable

  • Payments or fintech
  • Nonprofit technology, online fundraising or faith-based organizations
  • Marketplace or platform regulation
  • Hardware or physical-product supply chains
  • International expansion
  • Equity administration, financings, or M&A

You'll Thrive Here If You

  • Think like a business operator, not only a lawyer.

Sprinkler Reviewer

Join a team that helps protect lives every day!

With offices in Phoenix, London, São Paulo, and Joinville, JEM is home to more than 350 professionals worldwide dedicated to delivering excellence in Life Safety engineering and design services. If you have a keen eye for detail, a passion for quality, and enjoy ensuring that engineering designs meet the highest standards of accuracy and compliance, this opportunity is for you.

Purpose & Impact

The Sprinkler Reviewer plays a critical role in ensuring the quality, accuracy, and compliance of fire sprinkler system designs. This professional is responsible for reviewing, correcting, and validating 2D sprinkler drawings developed in AutoCAD and AutoSprink, ensuring they meet project requirements, industry standards, and client expectations.

By identifying inconsistencies, improving design quality, and supporting continuous improvement within the design team, the Sprinkler Reviewer directly contributes to the successful execution of projects for our international clients.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and quality-check 2D fire sprinkler system drawings developed in AutoCAD and AutoSprink.
  • Verify design accuracy, completeness, and compliance with project specifications and applicable standards.
  • Identify, document, and correct drafting errors, omissions, and inconsistencies.
  • Review sprinkler layouts, pipe routing, equipment placement, and design details.
  • Provide technical feedback and guidance to design teams to improve drawing quality and efficiency.
  • Ensure project documentation and revisions are properly incorporated and tracked.
  • Support internal quality assurance processes and contribute to the development of design best practices.
  • Review Bills of Materials (BOM) and verify consistency with approved drawings when required.

Attitude & Background

For this role, we highly value a positive attitude, accountability, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence. As part of a growing team serving international clients, your ability to maintain high-quality standards and attention to detail will be essential.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Technical degree or Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Architecture, Construction Technology, or related fields.
  • Strong proficiency in AutoCAD 2D (3D experience is not required).
  • Strong proficiency in AutoSprink
  • Previous experience with fire sprinkler systems, fire protection design, or construction drawings.
  • Knowledge of NFPA standards, particularly NFPA 13, is highly desirable.
  • Experience reviewing executive/construction-level drawings is a strong advantage.
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, organization, and commitment to quality.
  • Ability to communicate technical feedback clearly and professionally.

Incentives

  • Heath/Dental/Vision Insurance (50% coverage for the employee and dependents)
  • 401k
  • PTO (2 weeks yearly)
  • Sick Leaves (5 days yearly)

Workplace & Infrastructure

  • Location: REMOTE
  • Work shift: 08:00 AM – 04:30 PM (Arizona time Zone).

Ready to Join Us?

Interested in becoming part of a team that helps protect lives every day? Send us your resume and let's talk. We'd love to learn more about you and hear how you can contribute to JEM's mission of delivering world-class fire protection solutions. 🚀

Job Category

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce

We're Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI + Data + CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. We empower you to be a Trailblazer, too, driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good, you've come to the right place.

The Role

Come join the Salesforce Analytics Solution Engineering team and become the senior technical voice of Tableau for our SMB customers across EMEA.

As a Senior Analytics Specialist Solution Engineer, you will partner with Account Executives, Analytics sales specialists, and customers to win and grow Salesforce's analytics business across Small Business and Growth Business accounts. You will cover the full analytics portfolio: Tableau Cloud, Tableau Server, Tableau Next, and CRM Analytics, plus the power of the Tableau platform on Data 360 and Slack. You will show customers how to see, understand, and act on their data, including through agentic experiences.

SMB is fast and high-velocity. You will run many conversations at once, move quickly from discovery to a live demo, and help customers reach value without long enterprise sales cycles. As a senior member of the team, you are expected to operate with little oversight, set the technical standard for the region, and help the people around you grow. You are not just supporting the deal. You are helping drive it, and you share ownership of the number.


What You'll Do

  • Own the technical sale for analytics in SMB EMEA. Lead discovery, define the technical strategy, and win the technical decision across Tableau Cloud, Server, Next, and CRM Analytics.
  • Drive revenue alongside your AEs. Help qualify and build pipeline, shape deal strategy, contribute to forecast accuracy, and move opportunities to close. You are accountable for results, not just activity.
  • Demo live and build hands-on. Deliver compelling, tailored demos and rapid prototypes for audiences from analysts to business owners to C-level executives. You are happiest with your hands on the keyboard.
  • Tell the story of the platform. Make complex architecture simple and engaging, showing how Tableau, Data 360, Slack, and agentic experiences connect to turn data into decisions and action.
  • Advise on data and analytics architecture. Understand each customer's data landscape and advise on how Salesforce and Tableau solutions fit into it.
  • Solve ambiguous problems. Take messy business challenges, define the problem, size the opportunity, and recommend practical next steps.
  • Bring clarity to customer decisions. Evaluate solution options, align stakeholders, and build consensus, including guiding customers between Tableau Cloud, Server, Next, and CRM Analytics.
  • Show agency. Spot gaps in process, content, demo assets, or a deal, and fix them before anyone has to ask.
  • Mentor and multiply. Coach newer SEs, share reusable demos and assets, run enablement sessions, and make the whole region better. Help shape how the SMB EMEA analytics team operates.
  • Partner across the business. Work with Sales, Product, Professional Services, and partners, and bring customer and field feedback back to Product.
  • Stay current. Complete the product, sales, and certification training needed to stay sharp on a fast-moving portfolio.
  • Travel occasionally for customer engagements and team events.

What We're Looking For


Required

  • A technical degree (Computer Science, Software Engineering, MIS, Data Science, or similar) or equivalent experience. We evaluate experience against the core competencies of the role, including work, leadership, military, and volunteer experience.
  • [6+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years in a solution engineering, sales engineering, BI/analytics consulting, or data analyst role]
  • Deep, hands-on experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or Tableau Next, including data visualization, dashboarding, and self-service analytics best practices, plus strong knowledge of relational databases, data modeling, and web technologies.
  • A track record of influencing and closing technical sales, with experience owning the technical win in a deal.
  • Agency: you see a problem and fix it before anyone schedules a meeting about it.
  • Builder mindset: deep technical aptitude and a strong preference for building, configuring, and demoing yourself.
  • Numbers focus: revenue belongs to SEs too. You are comfortable owning outcomes, working a pipeline, and being measured on results.
  • Storytelling: exceptional presentation and communication skills, including the ability to make complex architecture simple. You are a strategic problem solver, comfortable engaging technical, business, and executive audiences.
  • Team-first mindset: you collaborate well, lift up those around you, and are comfortable mentoring others.

* Fluency in English.

  • Valid passports and/or residency to travel occasionally across Europe for work.

Preferred

  • Additional languages: fluency in one or more of Spanish, French, or German (or another EMEA language) is a bonus.
  • Previous experience as a solution or sales engineer or consultant at a CRM, analytics, or BI company, or in a similar customer-facing technical role.
  • Current Tableau and Salesforce certifications (e.g. CRM Analytics, Data 360 / Data Cloud).
  • Experience across the analytics portfolio: Tableau Cloud, Server, Next, and CRM Analytics.
  • Familiarity with Data 360, Slack, and AI/agentic use cases in analytics.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML fundamentals and how analytics platforms surface AI-driven insights (e.g. predictive analytics and agentic AI).
  • Experience building with AI tools (e.g. Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT) as part of your demo and prototyping toolkit.
  • Experience with SQL and data modeling across structured and semi-structured data.
  • Basic programming or scripting experience (Python, JavaScript, HTML, or similar).
  • Experience with design thinking, persona-based discovery, or workshop facilitation.
  • Experience selling to SMB or in high-velocity, transactional sales motions.
  • Experience mentoring or leading enablement for a team.

How We Work

  • Builder mentality: we show up with working demos and real solutions, not just slides.
  • Customer obsession: we go deep on customer problems before prescribing solutions.
  • Peer teaching: we share what we learn, internally, with customers, and at industry events.
  • Ownership: we see problems and fix them, and we share responsibility for the number.

Why Join Us

Salesforce Analytics is a key innovation driver in the agentic world, and it is as much a philosophy as a suite of tools. We help people turn data into something visual and understandable so they can make better decisions. You will sit at the center of the customer lifecycle, working with customers, Product, and Professional Services, and your work will be visible. Our values (trust, customer success, innovation, equality, and sustainability) guide everything we do.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. raw.description:
About Plan A

Plan A, a Diginex Ltd company, is Europe’s leading corporate carbon accounting and decarbonisation software provider, helping companies turn emissions intelligence into financial performance. Its AI-powered, TÜV-certified platform, coupled with expert support, simplifies emissions accounting, target setting, and reduction planning in line with GHG, and SBTi standards.

We are looking for a hands-on and proactive Finance & Accounting Specialist to strengthen our European Finance team.

About the Role

In this role, you will take ownership of day-to-day accounting activities, support monthly closing and reporting, and help streamline accounting processes across our European entities.

You will work closely with the Finance Director, internal stakeholders and external accounting partners, with a particular focus on our German operations and the gradual integration of accounting activities in France.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys operational accounting, takes responsibility and wants to contribute to improving processes in an international environment.

Your Responsibilities

General Accounting & Month-End Closing

  • Manage day-to-day bookkeeping and general ledger accounting, primarily using DATEV.
  • Process and reconcile accounts payable and accounts receivable.
  • Review supplier invoices, employee expenses and payment transactions.
  • Perform bank, credit card and balance sheet reconciliations.
  • Prepare and support monthly closing activities, including accruals, prepayments and accounting adjustments.
  • Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.

European Accounting & Coordination

  • Support accounting activities across our European entities, particularly Germany and France.
  • Gradually take over selected operational bookkeeping tasks currently performed by external accounting providers.
  • Support intercompany accounting, reconciliations and transaction documentation.
  • Coordinate with external accountants and local service providers.
  • Assist with accounting-related questions and the preparation of information for group reporting.

Financial Operations & Process Improvement

  • Support billing reconciliations and ensure consistency between customer contracts, invoicing and accounting records.
  • Assist with payment preparation and supplier account reconciliations.
  • Identify discrepancies and follow up on outstanding accounting items.
  • Improve and standardise accounting workflows, reconciliations and internal controls.
  • Support audit preparation and documentation requirements.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • Several years of practical experience in financial accounting, bookkeeping or a comparable role.
  • Solid knowledge of German accounting principles (HGB) and general ledger processes.
  • Good hands-on experience with DATEV.
  • Experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliations and monthly closing.
  • Comfortable working with Excel and accounting data.
  • Good German and English communication skills.
  • Independent, structured and detail-oriented working style.
  • A proactive and pragmatic approach to solving problems.

What makes you stand out

  • Experience working in an international or multi-entity organisation.
  • Familiarity with accounting processes in France or other European countries.
  • Experience with Payhawk, Pennylane or comparable financial systems.
  • Experience improving or internalising accounting processes previously handled by external providers.
  • Exposure to SaaS businesses or recurring-revenue models.

What matters to us

We value practical experience, reliability and a willingness to take ownership over formal titles or conventional career paths.

We welcome applications from professionals with different backgrounds, including those returning to work after a career break.

You do not need to have worked in an international group before. What matters most is that you understand accounting, enjoy working hands-on and are motivated to learn.

Benefits

What you can expect from Plan A

  • A permanent position within an international Finance organisation.
  • The opportunity to take ownership of operational accounting processes.
  • Direct collaboration with the Finance Director.
  • Exposure to accounting activities across several European entities.
  • The possibility to work fully remotely from anywhere in Germany.
  • The opportunity to improve processes and help shape a more efficient Finance function.

Echodyne offers the world’s first compact solid-state true beam-steering radar for a wide range of industries and applications. Echodyne offers its radars to companies working in Automotive, Transportation, Critical Infrastructure Protection, Border Security, Smart Cities, Uncrewed Aircraft Systems (UAS), and Airspace Management including Urban Air Mobility (UTM).

raw.description:
Job Title:

Customer Success Manager

Description:

Home365 is an innovative InsureTech/PropTech company transforming residential real estate investment and property management. Our technology-driven platform simplifies property ownership and management while providing investors with a Net Operating Income (NOI) Guarantee designed to protect operating performance and support long-term investment success.

We are seeking a proactive, customer-focused Customer Success Representative to build and maintain strong relationships with property owners, deliver exceptional service, and ensure a seamless ownership experience. This role is responsible for managing day-to-day owner communications, resolving service-related concerns, and proactively identifying opportunities to improve customer satisfaction and retention.

Reporting to the Market Leader of the assigned region, the Customer Success Representative serves as a trusted point of contact for property owners, collaborating with internal teams to coordinate timely resolutions and ensure consistent follow-through. This is a non-licensed position, with matters requiring a real estate license escalated to the Market Leader.

The ideal candidate is a strong communicator, natural problem-solver, and relationship builder who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes ownership of customer needs, and is passionate about delivering an outstanding customer experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage day-to-day owner relationships, service questions, and issue resolution.
  • Maintain a consistent, scheduled owner communication cadence and follow through on outstanding concerns.
  • Coordinate owner escalations and homeowners association (HOA) administration.
  • Support owner exits through final accounting handoffs and documentation of churn reasons.
  • Receive and classify inbound owner questions, resolve service-related matters, and route licensed matters to the Market Leader.
  • Provide status updates, timelines, and communications about decisions already made, without making licensed determinations.
  • Receive owner notices and coordinate handovers and move-out service steps.
  • Support resident relations and onboarding activities as assigned, subject to final confirmation of the operating model.
  • Collaborate with Market Leaders, Maintenance Coordination, and Finance to ensure owners receive timely and accurate responses.
  • Document owner issues, escalations, handoffs, and follow-up actions consistently.

Role Boundaries and Escalations:

  • Refer lease terms, rent questions, accounting judgments, management agreements, rental advertising, rent quotations, and payment-plan negotiations to the licensed Market Leader.
  • Refer maintenance inquiries and vendor dispatch to Joanna’s team.
  • Refer delinquency and collections matters to Finance under Lior.
  • Do not independently perform licensed real estate activities; a personal license, if held, does not change the scope of this position.
  • Follow the written escalation and handoff procedure once finalized; until then, escalate uncertain licensing questions rather than answering independently.

Performance Measures:

  • Owner churn target: below 20% (proposed measure).
  • Compliance with the scheduled owner-contact cadence (proposed measure).
  • Reduction in the number of owners carrying negative balances, monitored as a directional churn-risk indicator.

Your personality:

Customer Obsession

We prioritize understanding your needs and exceeding expectations at every turn.

Radical Transparency

We believe in open communication and clear information.

Extreme Ownership

We take full responsibility for our actions and the results we deliver.

Teamwork

Our team of local specialists and technology experts works together seamlessly to ensure your property is well-managed.

Being a Doer

We don't wait for problems to arise. We actively work to resolve any issue and aren’t satisfied until the job is done—and done right.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

Job Title: Enterprise Account Executive

Reporting to: Director, Enterprise Sales

Location: Boston, MA or Remote US

Team: Enterprise Sales

The Opportunity
Quickbase is looking for a motivated, results-driven Enterprise Account Executive to grow revenue across a defined book of strategic enterprise accounts; building account strategies, developing relationships, and positioning Quickbase as the go-to work management platform for solving clients' biggest operational challenges.

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Account Management – Build and execute account plans for enterprise accounts aimed at hitting revenue targets, expanding Quickbase's footprint, and building long-term partnerships.

Relationship Building – Develop and maintain relationships with C-level execs, VPs, directors, and other key decision-makers in assigned accounts.

Solution Selling – Understand client business challenges and strategic priorities, and clearly communicate how Quickbase addresses their needs around collaboration, visibility, and efficiency.

Pipeline Generation & Forecasting – Proactively find and qualify new opportunities and accurately forecast sales activity.

Cross-functional Collaboration – Work closely with Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Marketing, and Product teams.

Qualifications

5–8+ years of full-cycle B2B sales experience, with at least 3–5 years specifically in Enterprise or strategic accounts

Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred.

Experience selling collaborative work management, project management, or similar platforms is a plus.

Strong presentation and demo skills for both technical and business audiences.


Important Notices
Recorded Interviews. Quickbase uses an interview recording tool to record and transcribe interviews for evaluation purposes in accordance with applicable privacy laws. By participating in an interview, you consent to this recording and transcription.
Interview Integrity. AI is part of how we work at Quickbase — we expect you to use it too. Your application and interviews should still reflect you and your own thinking. We'll tell you when AI is encouraged throughout the selection process. Misrepresentation at any stage may result in removal from consideration for this and future roles.
How We Review Applications We use AI throughout our hiring process to help review, screen, schedule interviews, and assess applications. These tools support our team's review; they do not replace it, and every hiring decision is made by a person.


Pay Range

$242,000.00 - $280,000.00

Compensation & Benefits:

At Quickbase, we believe in pay transparency and are committed to equitable pay practices.


The compensation range shown above reflects the total expected On-Target Earnings (OTE) for this role, which includes both base salary and target commission. The commission potential is equal to the base salary. OTE applies specifically to sales positions and represents the amount an employee can expect to earn when performance goals are met. The exact compensation offered will be based on experience, skills, and alignment with internal equity. Beyond salary, employees receive access to full benefits package including health insurance, retirement, paid time off, etc.


Incentive Compensation

This role is eligible to participate in our annual incentive plan. Incentives are earned based on employee performance against defined metrics and company goals.


Benefits

Full-time roles are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program which includes medical, dental and vision coverage. You may also contribute to our 401(k) plan that includes a company match.


Equal Opportunity Statement

Quickbase is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply – even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

In response to emerging industry needs, we expanded our services to include Scout Clinical, one of the top providers of clinical trial patient reimbursements and travel.

Scout is recognized as a leader in our field for innovation in service, attention to detail, our stellar team members, and making the complex easier.  If this interests you, we’d love to have you join our rapidly growing team! 

Position Summary:  

We are looking to hire a talented, eager, and skilled Bi-Lingual Patient Liaison to join our team in a remote position. The Patient Liaison provides customer support to patients and clinics involved in pharmaceutical research trials. You would be responsible for ensuring that customers (patients and clinics) of Scout Clinical receive excellent and consistent service. This includes reviewing travel and expense reimbursement requests, partnering with our vendors to fulfill services, and answering questions in a timely and courteous manner.

Schedule information
Fully remote position for the following shift:

  • Tuesday – Saturday | 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM (KST time)

Hours: 9-hour shift (including 1-hour lunch for a total of 8-hour shift)
Some holiday work will be required but will be compensated.

Responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited to: 

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for our patients, study sites, vendors, and other related parties. 
  • Scheduling travel and logistics requests for patients enrolled in clinical trials, including: 
    • Arrangements including flights, hotel, ground transportation, and special needs assistance, as well as assist with any additional issues that arise during travel
    • Interaction and management of vendors handling travel requests
    • Review travel requests against study parameters and seek approvals where necessary
  • Processing expense reimbursements to patients for approved expenses, including review against study parameters and seeking approvals where necessary of those expenses 
  • Responsible for training study site personnel on how to use the online portal including: 
    • Creating/entering requests in the portal if applicable
  • Complete all required initial and ongoing training within a reasonable or provided timeframe

The ideal candidate will have the following experience, skills, and knowledge: 

  • BS or BA degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum 3 years of experience within the customer service or life sciences industry preferred 
  • Fluency in English, Korean, and Japanese (spoken and written) is a must
  • Experience working with multiple independent vendors to achieve results on a deadline
  • Experience in the travel and/or hospitality industry is a plus
  • Strong computer skills (Excel, Word, Outlook, Internet Explorer) 
    • Ability to modify, edit, and create Excel spreadsheets, Word documents. 
    • Ability to conduct hotel, venue, and destination research online. 
  • Work with financial information, including basic knowledge and understanding of how to convert foreign currency to USD. 
  • Ability to track and manage key dates/deadlines
  • Timely, professional, courteous correspondence and communication with clients, vendors, and colleagues 
  • Well organized with an ability to prioritize and multitask. 
  • Customer service oriented 
  • Patient, flexible attitude 
  • Ability to work within and meet strict deadlines/time management. 
  • Thrive in fast-paced environments, maintaining performance under pressure
  • Self-motivated and results-driven, while following instructions to achieve optimal outcomes
  • Innovative problem solver, using critical thinking to address challenges proactively
  • Diplomatic and discreet
  • Collaborative team player, fostering positive relationships with colleagues and clients

Visit our website at or follow us on LinkedIn for other employment opportunities.

As a Senior Investigator in Coinbase’s Financial Intelligence Unit within Compliance (2LoD), you’ll help drive Coinbase’s financial crime investigations capability across multiple jurisdictions. This team leads complex reactive and proactive investigations, develops intelligence on emerging typologies and risk patterns, and translates investigative insights into high-quality SAR/STR decisions, escalations and programme improvements. You’ll work on high-impact matters across Coinbase’s global platform, partnering closely with MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and cross functional stakeholders to protect Coinbase and its customers from financial crime.

What you’ll do:

  • Own end-to-end investigations into complex AML/CFT matters, from alert review or referral, through case development, disposition and SAR/STR submission to relevant FIUs.
  • Conduct delegated MLRO reviews of Suspicious Transaction Reports and Suspicious Activity Reports prior to filing, ensuring accuracy, quality and regulatory defensibility.
  • Lead proactive investigations, using transaction data, on-chain activity, trading behaviour and cross functional intelligence and OSINT to identify emerging typologies, threat patterns and high-risk activity.
  • Develop actionable intelligence from casework and analytics to inform escalations, regulatory reporting, control enhancements and improvements to detection and investigation workflows.
  • Partner internally with Country MLROs, local compliance teams, operations teams and other stakeholders on high-risk matters, information sharing and investigation strategy.
  • Partner with law enforcement agencies and external stakeholders on suspicious activity reporting, information requests, and intelligence sharing.
  • Support investigation quality through case review, structured feedback and contributions to policies, procedures, training and programme maturity.

Required Skills and Experience:

  • 4+ years conducting and reviewing complex crypto financial crime investigations including experience across a range of products such as retail and institutional transfers, spot trading and derivatives.
  • Experience preparing, reviewing and filing SARs/STRs with strong understanding of multi-jurisdiction AML/CTF regulatory obligations and reporting expectations.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform data-driven investigations using SQL, blockchain analytics tools and other research techniques to extract investigative insights, identify suspicious behaviour and develop defensible conclusions.
  • Strong investigative judgement and the ability to produce clear, structured long-form reports tailored to technical, compliance, leadership, and cross-functional audiences.

raw.description:
Alimentiv is a global CRO with a singular focus: advancing therapies for patients with gastrointestinal diseases. GI is our WHY and for more than 30 years that purpose has driven our scientific rigour, operational excellence, and deep therapeutic expertise, including supporting more than 70% of IBD compounds in development.
We operate as a private, profit-with-purpose company, channeling our commercial success back into scientific research, technology, and our people. With approximately 700 people across multiple countries and three service lines, we are growing deliberately, and the capability of our leaders and our organization is central to how we get there.

If you want to do meaningful work, build something real, and invest back in research that changes lives — we want to meet you!

What We Offer

    In addition, as an Alimentiv Employee, you’re also eligible for the following programs:

  • Education Reimbursement program for full-time employees
  • Monthly Cell Phone and Remote Work Allowance (dependent on role eligibility)
  • One time office setup allowance (can be used to purchase a scanner/printer, extra monitor, office furniture, etc.)
  • Working while visiting program – up to 4 weeks per year!
  • Flexible Summer Hours Program from May – September
  • Employee referral incentive – we know great people know other great people, and we think that warrants recognition!
  • Full-time employees also become beneficiaries of the Alimentiv Trust after one year of employment, and permanent members after 5 years of employment
  • Optional formal mentorship program (Alimentorship); country/region annual social events in person; leadership development programs for people leaders in accordance with your seniority; social committee and several other optional initiatives designed to support you in feeling like part of the Alimentiv team!

    • Additional benefits may be available depending on the country of employment and are subject to local policies and eligibility.

Our Services

  • End-to-end GI clinical trial services, from protocol design through submission support
  • Central medical imaging management and endoscopic reading
  • Precision medicine and biomarker solutions
  • Real-world evidence and clinical consulting
  • Histopathology and lab services through AcelaBio

How to Apply

    To apply for this position, please submit your resume through the Alimentiv Careers Portal or via LinkedIn’s Easy Apply. Resumes must be submitted in English.

Equal Opportunity and Accessibility

    Alimentiv is committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, national origin, religion or belief, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital or family status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
    Accommodations are available upon request for persons with disabilities throughout the recruitment and selection process. Requests can be directed to .

About the Role

  • Lead the planning, execution, monitoring, and successful completion of assigned clinical research projects, ensuring delivery against timelines, budgets, quality standards, and project objectives.

  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional project teams, ensuring clear accountability, effective collaboration, and timely completion of project deliverables.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors and clients throughout the project lifecycle, managing expectations, providing regular updates, and proactively resolving issues.

  • Oversee project activities to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, clinical research guidelines, and corporate policies.

  • Manage project documentation, tools, and resources, ensuring appropriate development, maintenance, and delivery of essential study materials and records.

  • Monitor project performance, identifying risks, addressing operational challenges, and implementing solutions to maintain project quality and timelines.

  • Coordinate key project activities, including site monitoring, data management, patient safety, statistical analysis, and final reporting, in collaboration with functional experts.

  • Support project planning and execution through effective stakeholder communication, project meetings, training, and vendor coordination as required.

What we're looking for

  • Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline with 1–3 years of related experience, or a college diploma/degree with 4–6 years of related experience.

  • Required Language Skills: English and Mandarin required.
  • Highly Desirable: Medical Imaging exposure and expertise

    • Other:

  • Background in Health Sciences, Life Sciences, or Clinical Research is preferred (Equivalent combinations of education and relevant experience, supported by ongoing job-related training, will be considered)
  • Experience with project or financial resource management, including budget oversight and expenditure management.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage diverse internal and external stakeholders, navigate complex discussions, and appropriately escalate issues.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and prioritize competing responsibilities in a dynamic project environment.
Stay Alert to Recruitment Scams

Alimentiv is aware of a continued increase in phishing scams, which use various methods of attack via email, text, voice and social media, including individuals posing as our recruiters and contacting candidates with fraudulent opportunities. Our hiring process always includes direct engagement with a recruiter or hiring manager, and we will never ask for sensitive personal information early in the process.

Official communication will only come from company email addresses containing "@alimentiv.com". If you are contacted about an open job at Alimentiv, please verify the domain of the sender's email address and confirm that you are being asked to apply on this website. If something doesn't feel right, we encourage you to verify before responding. If you believe you have been the victim of a phishing scam, please contact your local government cyber authority to report it.

raw.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

Peraton is seeking an experienced Core Services Mobility Lead to oversee the architecture, engineering, operations, and support of enterprise mobility services. This individual will provide technical leadership for the mobility environment, with a primary focus on BlackBerry Unified Endpoint Management (UEM), Apple device management, Microsoft Intune integration, identity services, and mobile security.

The Core Services Mobility Lead will serve as the technical authority for mobility architecture and engineering decisions, ensuring solutions align with enterprise requirements, security standards, and operational objectives. The ideal candidate will bring extensive experience in enterprise mobility management, Microsoft technologies, mobile device security, and technical team leadership.

Location: This position is fully remote.

Day to Day Responsibilities

Technical Leadership and Architecture

  • Own the enterprise mobility architecture and approve technical changes involving identity management, Public Key Infrastructure (PKI), Microsoft 365, and Apple technologies.

  • Lead, mentor, and provide technical direction to the Core Services engineering team.

  • Establish engineering standards and best practices while promoting collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as the primary technical representative for mobility services across TSA, Peraton, and external vendors.

  • Provide technical guidance and serve as the final escalation point for complex Unified Endpoint Management (UEM) issues.

Mobility Engineering and Operations

  • Lead the design, implementation, upgrades, and ongoing support of BlackBerry UEM and BlackBerry Enterprise Mobility Server (BEMS).

  • Maintain existing zero-touch iOS enrollment capabilities using Apple Business Manager (ABM), Automated Device Enrollment (ADE), and Apple Push Notification service (APNs) certificates.

  • Coordinate with End User Services (EUS) to support required Apple enrollment and certificate updates.

  • Maintain the Microsoft Intune integration, including App Protection Policies and Compliance Partner integration with UEM through Microsoft Graph. Intune supports application protection and compliance integration and is not the primary Mobile Device Management (MDM) platform.

  • Design and maintain certificate delivery solutions for mobile devices using Simple Certificate Enrollment Protocol (SCEP) and Public Key Cryptography Standards (PKCS).

  • Identify opportunities to improve mobility services, infrastructure performance, operational efficiency, and service delivery.

Security and Compliance

  • Map Defense Information Systems Agency (DISA) mobile Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) to applicable mobility policies and configurations.

  • Review each new iOS release to assess security implications, compatibility, and required policy updates.

  • Ensure mobility engineering solutions align with established security requirements, enterprise policies, and applicable compliance standards.

  • Identify, assess, and mitigate technical and operational risks affecting the mobility environment.

Infrastructure Operations and Service Delivery

  • Support the operations, maintenance, and engineering of enterprise IT infrastructure, including Microsoft Windows Server environments.

  • Ensure engineering activities align with established change, release, and configuration management processes.

  • Monitor ongoing work, resolve technical issues, and communicate operational status and risks to management.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to coordinate infrastructure and mobility activities.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree and 12 years of experience or a Masters degree and 10 years of experience or a Associates degree and 14 years of experience or a High School diploma/equivalent and 16 years of experience.
  • U.S. Citizenship, must have the ability to obtain / maintain a DHS Entrance on Duty (EOD) clearance.
  • 10+ years of experience supporting, managing, or engineering enterprise IT infrastructure.
  • 10+ years of experience with Microsoft Windows Operating Systems, serving as a Subject Matter Expert (SME).
  • Demonstrated experience with enterprise mobility architecture, engineering, and operations.
  • Experience with BlackBerry UEM and BEMS administration, engineering, upgrades, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience supporting Apple device management, including Apple Business Manager, Automated Device Enrollment, and APNs certificates.
  • Experience integrating Microsoft Intune with enterprise UEM solutions, including application protection and compliance management.
  • Strong understanding of identity management, PKI, and mobile device certificate delivery.
  • Experience with SCEP and/or PKCS certificate enrollment and delivery methods.
  • Knowledge of mobile security requirements and experience implementing security policies and compliance controls.
  • Strong understanding of change, release, and configuration management processes and how they interact within an enterprise IT environment.
  • Experience providing technical guidance, mentoring engineers, or leading technical teams.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to assess technical challenges, exercise sound judgment, and develop effective solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate technical information to management, customers, and stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a distributed team environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Active or previously held Public Trust or higher security clearance

  • Experience working with TSA or other federal government mobility environments.

  • Experience mapping DISA mobile STIG requirements to enterprise mobility policies and configurations.

  • Knowledge of Microsoft Graph and its use in UEM and Intune integrations.

  • Experience with ServiceNow and enterprise IT service management processes.

  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring tools such as SolarWinds or Microsoft System Center Operations Manager (SCOM).

  • Experience supporting Microsoft Exchange, Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Active Directory, and account management.

  • Experience supporting iOS, Android, BlackBerry, macOS, Unix, or Linux environments.

  • Knowledge of IT security fundamentals, networking, and cloud operations.

  • ITIL 4 Foundation certification

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

EEO: Equal opportunity employer, including disability and protected veterans, or other characteristics protected by law.

About Extend:

Extend is revolutionizing the post-purchase experience for retailers and their customers by providing merchants with AI-driven solutions that enhance customer satisfaction and drive revenue growth. Our comprehensive platform offers automated customer service handling, seamless returns/exchange management, end-to-end automated fulfillment, and product protection and shipping protection alongside Extend's best-in-class fraud detection. By integrating leading-edge technology with exceptional customer service, Extend empowers businesses to build trust and loyalty among consumers while reducing costs and increasing profits.

Today, Extend works with more than 1,000 leading merchant partners across industries, including fashion/apparel, cosmetics, furniture, jewelry, consumer electronics, auto parts, sports and fitness, and much more. Extend is backed by some of the most prominent technology investors in the industry, and our headquarters is in downtown San Francisco.

About the Role:

As a Claims Adjudication Specialist, you will play a critical role within our Operations Department, focused on evaluating and servicing claims related to our Product and Shipping Protection plans, which are offered by over 1,000+ Merchant Partners. You’ll serve as a subject matter expert, supporting our Customer Support and Service Technician partners to ensure accurate and timely service of complex claims that require deeper investigation.

This position requires strong analytical skills, critical thinking, and the ability to interpret multiple policies across a wide range of product categories. On a daily basis, you’ll review complex claim submissions, manage escalations, and investigate unusual claim patterns. Success in this role relies on meticulous attention to detail, evidence-based decision-making and ability to adapt to frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment.

You'll collaborate closely with customers, service partners, and internal teams to deliver accurate claim decisions while ensuring an exceptional customer experience. The role involves inbound and outbound calls, as well as written communications with customers, service providers, and internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Serves as the escalation point of contact from outsourced partners, customer support teams and service technician partners.
  • Investigate and resolve complex claim situations, ensuring decisions align with contract terms and internal policies.
  • Troubleshoot delays in claims processing, ensuring timely resolutions and enhanced customer satisfaction.
  • Coordinate service technician dispatching and parts ordering when necessary to support claim resolution.
  • Resolve escalated customer issues by proposing fair resolutions within policy guidelines and clearly communicating outcomes to the customer.
  • Maintain detailed and organized documentation of all customer and partner interactions.
  • Investigate suspected fraudulent claims and report findings as needed.
  • Recommend process improvements and opportunities to automate routine tasks.
  • Provide timely responses to claim inquiries via phone and email, in line with established SLAs.
  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to troubleshoot and escalate unresolved claim issues.
  • Stay up to date on product offerings, service workflows, and policy updates to better support customers.
  • Identify and communicate training needs for front-line support teams to improve service quality.
  • Keep internal systems current with relevant technical issues, customer feedback, and insights.

Preferred Experience, Skills, and Knowledge:

  • Active adjuster licenses (preferred).
  • 3-5 years of technical customer service, claims management/adjudication, insurance adjusting, or contact center experience. Claims adjudication preferably in a protection plan environment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written with the ability to convey complex claim details and supporting rationale for decisioning in a clear and concise way both to customers and internal system notations.
  • Embraces frequent change in processes and technology within a fast-paced environment, demonstrating flexibility and resilience in managing evolving challenges.
  • Experienced with claims management systems, contact center platforms, and Google suites of products.
  • Proven ability to to navigate and work effectively across various software systems simultaneously.
  • Ability to analyze complex issues, identify solutions, and make decisions efficiently.
  • Thrive in environments of high claim volumes with exponential company growth while maintaining excellent performance and accuracy.

Estimated Pay Range: $45,000 - $55,000 per year salaried*

*The target base salary range for this position is listed above. Individual salaries are determined based on a number of factors including, but not limited to, work location and job-related knowledge, skills and experience.

Extend does not provide immigration-related sponsorship for this role.

Life at Extend:

  • Working with a great team from diverse backgrounds in a collaborative and supportive environment.
  • Competitive salary based on experience, with full medical and dental & vision benefits.
  • Stock in an early-stage startup growing quickly.
  • Generous, flexible paid time off policy.
  • 401(k) with Financial Guidance from Morgan Stanley.

About Benefitfocus:

Benefitfocus, Inc., a Voya company, is a leading provider of cloud-based benefits software solutions for consumers, employers, insurance carriers and brokers. Benefitfocus has served numerous consumers on its platform that consists of an integrated portfolio of products and services enabling clients to shop, enroll, manage and exchange benefits information more efficiently. With a user-friendly interface and consumer-centric design, the Benefitfocus Platform provides one place for consumers to access all their benefits. Benefitfocus solutions support the administration of all types of benefits including core medical, dental, and other voluntary benefits plans as well as wellness programs.


Get to Know the Opportunity:

The Client Relationship Manager (CRM) is responsible for developing high-trust relationships with Benefitfocus customers, measured through customer satisfaction, relationship health and customer retention. The CRM provides continuity and ensures a seamless experience spanning all stages of the customer lifecycle. This role requires a strong understanding of benefits administration, technology (particularly SaaS), business process outsourcing and strategic planning. The Client Relationship Manager is an extension of his/her customer’s team, helping them to drive their desired outcomes while maximizing the value of their Benefitfocus solution.


The Large-Market CRM is responsible for maintaining larger, more complex customer accounts, including triaging and promoting the resolution of occasional technical issues.


Please Note: Work location for this role is flexible! This position allows 100% remote work from home or allows work to be performed in any of our major office locations with a hybrid schedule.


The Contributions You’ll Make:

  • Build and maintain relationships with a portfolio of Employer customers through all stages of the customer lifecycle; Manage customer relationships to maximize desired outcomes for the customers while increasing customer satisfaction and retention.
  • Stay abreast of industry and technology trends; Educate and advocate for customers on the basis of these trends.
  • Demonstrate effective command of Benefitfocus governance and decision-making processes, products/solutions, organizational structures, and technology infrastructure.
  • Demonstrates extensive knowledge of the platform and file processes.
  • Demonstrates fundamental communication skills to facilitate client calls and resolve escalated interactions.
  • Lead the internal Benefitfocus team on behalf of the customer, motivating the team, coordinating across departments, anticipating and addressing needs, and ensuring the highest possible quality of work generated by the team.
  • Drive annual open enrollment success with customers, partnering with each customer to develop actionable steps with assigned owners, timelines and measurements while anticipating and removing roadblocks and orchestrating multiple resources.
  • Serve as a leader and mentor on the Channel Partners team championing Benefitfocus core values and acting as a positive influence on peers.
  • Manages program-level and team-wide projects, including the development and documentation of new processes/process improvements for the CSM team.
  • Host internal training sessions as needed and regularly share best practices to facilitate growth across the team.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Minimum Knowledge & Experience:

  • 10+ years’ experience in Customer Success, Account Management or related roles.
  • Successful experience managing a portfolio of customers consisting of companies with a high-level of complexity, focus and intensity.

Preferred Knowledge & Experience:

  • B.S. or B.A. required.
  • MBA
  • PMP Certification and/or GBA/CEBS
  • Industry knowledge and experience highly preferred: Insurance, Benefits Administration, Benefits Consulting, SaaS, Healthcare, and/or BPO.

Success Measures: The success of a Client Relationship Manager is ultimately measured by their ability to drive the desired outcomes of our customers while maximizing the value of their Benefitfocus solution.

  • Have a firm understanding in the principles of electricity. Must be able to apply these principles in the troubleshooting of drives.

  • Ability to respond to inquiries from customers and communicate effectively in English, both verbal and written. Must be computer-literate.

ABB Drive Products serves the industries and infrastructure segments with world-class drives and programmable logic controllers (PLC). With its products, global scale and local presence, the Division helps customers to improve energy efficiency, productivity and safety.
