raw.description:
About the team

The Workforce Planning team sits at the center of Zillow’s customer-facing operations, helping ensure we have the right plans, tools, and insights in place to deliver a seamless experience for customers and sellers. We partner closely with leaders across operations, sales, finance, and technology to shape forecasting, capacity planning, scheduling, and real-time performance strategies that support both business outcomes and a strong colleague experience. The team is organized into Command Center, Resource Planning, and Capacity Planning, each led by a dedicated leader. This team plays a key role in building scalable, data-informed frameworks that help Zillow grow thoughtfully while keeping our customers and employees at the heart of every decision.

About the role

The Director, Workforce Planning leads the strategy, planning, and execution of enterprise workforce management for Zillow’s customer-facing operations, ensuring the right people are in the right place at the right time to deliver an exceptional experience. This leader of leaders sets the vision for long-range capacity planning, forecasting, scheduling, and real-time performance management across contact center environments, using data-driven insights to optimize service levels, productivity, and colleague experience. The Director collaborates closely with senior business, operations, finance, and technology leaders to design scalable frameworks, challenge the status quo, and enable sustainable growth.


  • Set the enterprise workforce management strategy for contact center operations, aligning capacity planning, staffing, and service level targets with Zillow’s business objectives and customer experience goals.
  • Lead long-range and annual workforce planning, including demand forecasting, hiring plans, and budget inputs across sites, lines of business, and channels to support growth while managing cost and risk.
  • Design and govern standardized WFM policies, frameworks, and KPIs (e.g., forecast accuracy, schedule adherence, occupancy, service levels) to ensure consistent practices and performance visibility across teams.
  • Oversee the workforce management operating model and teams, including forecasting, scheduling, and real-time management functions, providing leadership, coaching, and development to team leaders and analysts.
  • Partner with Operations, Sales, Finance, HR, and vendor partners to align staffing strategies with volume trends, productivity goals, and workforce initiatives, enabling data-informed decisions on hiring, training, and deployment.
  • Champion the roadmap for WFM tools and technology, including AI, collaborating with Product, Engineering, and vendor partners to implement and optimize workforce management systems, telephony routing, and reporting solutions.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance forecast accuracy, schedule efficiency, shrinkage management, and intraday execution, using analytics and experimentation to test and scale best practices.
  • Provide executive-level insights and recommendations through clear storytelling, dashboards, and operational reviews, highlighting risks, opportunities, and trade-offs in staffing and performance.
This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $142,500.00 - $227,600.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $135,400.00 - $216,200.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Operations Management, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in workforce management, contact center operations, or a closely related field, including 5+ years in a people leadership role leading multi-function teams.
  • Demonstrated experience owning enterprise or large-scale workforce planning, forecasting, and scheduling for high-volume, multi-channel environments (e.g., service or support), including BPO vendor partners.
  • Proven success using data and analytics to diagnose performance drivers, improve forecast accuracy, and optimize staffing, productivity, and customer or sales outcomes.
  • Track record of influencing senior leaders and cross-functional partners with clear, data-driven recommendations in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Working knowledge of WFM platforms such as Aspect, Genesys, or NICE, and related telephony or CRM tools.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.


How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Job Description

At GSK, we have bold ambitions for patients, aiming to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade. Our R&D focuses on discovering and delivering vaccines and medicines, combining our understanding of the immune system with cutting-edge technology to transform people’s lives. GSK fosters a culture ambitious for patients, accountable for impact, and committed to doing the right thing, making sure that we focus our efforts on accelerating significant assets that meet patients’ needs and have the highest probability of success. We’re uniting science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.


Job Purpose

US Local Delivery Lead Director provides leadership, oversight and manages the activities of local delivery leads (LDLs) to ensure the delivery of all clinical studies, across all therapy areas (Rx and Vx) to the required quality standards, GSK written standards and ICH GCP. Operates independently and effectively in a highly complex, high volume, strategic market.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Leads a team of LDLs operating in a highly complex environment due to scale (number of subjects/sites per study) and volume (number of studies assigned to country) of studies conducted, providing training, coaching, mentoring, line and performance management.
  • Responsible for effectively managing capacity utilization of LDL resources and contributes to resourcing solutions including multi-country support by LDLs, ensuring alignment of capabilities with study requirements, resource availability and business priorities. Contribute to overall management of clinical research within the LOC via involvement in applicable leadership teams to ensure consistency and utilization of resources and best practice.
  • Accountable for ensuring the completion of all project management deliverables for all studies assigned to the LOC to agreed timelines, budget and quality standards. The LDL manager works with the LDLs to identify and resolve or escalate risks and issues that may impact study delivery.
  • Responsible for identifying and sharing best practices, standardizing across the LOC / region and representing local/regional clinical operations on global and cross functional initiatives. Ability to understand and respond to unique challenges in managing workload due to size and scale of studies.
  • Recruits and develops LDLs. Evaluates capabilities and competencies of internal staff, identifies and coordinates implementation of personal development plans for direct reports.
  • Partners with local and central teams to ensure robust study feasibility with reference to study complexity, clinical facilities and monitoring resource.
  • Establishes and manages key strategic relationships with external vendors to ensure clinical studies are appropriately resourced and executed as necessary.
  • Ensures that critical study timelines related to study activities are accurately forecasted and achieved and that recruitment targets, patient recruitment cycle times, data and audit quality and site related milestones are met. Provides trouble-shooting and problem resolution support for LDLs to ensure productive, efficient study delivery.
  • In collaboration with Clinical Operation Director and Local/Regional Quality, Capability & Risk Manager identifies management monitoring process checks linked with LDL activities that require inclusion in the local quality plan to ensure quality and integrity of clinical studies conducted in the LOC.
  • Assists with audits/inspections of local clinical operations department & study / sites in the country, as required.
  • Continuous development of knowledge in the areas of GCP, internal company guidelines, SOPs, new monitoring technologies and capabilities. Serves as an expert in ICH GCP and GSK written standards for LDLs.
  • Leads or participates in regional/global clinical operations projects (as appropriate).
  • Available and willing to travel as job requires.

Why You?

Basic Qualifications:

  • University degree in Sciences (Medicine, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, Biology or related fields) or equivalent demonstrable professional experience in the area
  • At least 10 years of experience in clinical operations delivery within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, including leadership of complex, multi‑site clinical studies in the US.
  • At least 5 years of experience leading and developing clinical operations leaders or managers (e.g., LDLs, study managers, CTMs) in a high‑volume, high‑complexity environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated accountability for study delivery to timelines, quality standards, and regulatory requirements, including risk identification, issue escalation, and problem resolution.
  • Strong working knowledge of ICH‑GCP, GSK written standards, and US regulatory expectations.
  • Experience delivering oncology clinical trials in the US, including studies with large site networks, complex protocols, and competitive enrollment environments.
  • Experience leading delivery across late phase and/or registrational oncology studies is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with oncology specific operational challenges, such as:
    • High protocol complexity and amendment frequency
    • Specialized site types and networks
    • Competitive enrollment and site capacity constraints
  • Experience operating across multiple oncology indications or programs within a portfolio.


Skills

Agile Thinking, Business Acumen, Clinical Data Management, Clinical Development, Clinical Research, Clinical Trials, Communication, Creativity, Decision Making, Pharmaceutical Industry, Project ManagementThe US annual base salary for new hires in this position ranges from $169,500 to $282,500. The US salary ranges take into account a number of factors including work location within the US market, the candidate’s skills, experience, education level and the market rate for the role. In addition, this position offers an annual bonus and eligibility to participate in our share based long term incentive program which is dependent on the level of the role. Available benefits include health care and other insurance benefits (for employee and family), retirement benefits, paid holidays, vacation, and paid caregiver/parental and medical leave. If salary ranges are not displayed in the job posting for a specific country, the relevant compensation will be discussed during the recruitment process.

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

OR

• Ability to respond rapidly and decisively
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

Benefits:

Our benefits are designed to make health happen for our people. Viva is our global wellbeing programme and includes all aspects of our health – from mental and physical, to financial, social and environmental wellbeing. We support flexible working and have a range of family friendly benefits.

About the Business:

LexisNexis Risk Solutions is the essential partner in the assessment of risk. Within our Business Services vertical, we offer a multitude of solutions focused on helping businesses of all sizes drive higher revenue growth, maximize operational efficiencies, and improve customer experience. Our solutions help our customers solve difficult problems in the areas of Anti-Money Laundering/Counter Terrorist Financing, Identity Authentication & Verification, Fraud and Credit Risk mitigation and Customer Data Management. The Strategic Financial Services Sales team partners with leading Canadian financial institutions to address complex risk, fraud, identity, and compliance challenges. About the Job:

The Strategic Account Manager is responsible for growing revenue within a defined portfolio of named, Canadian-headquartered financial services accounts through the sale of LexisNexis Risk Solutions products and solutions. This role develops strategic account plans, builds executive-level relationships, and coordinates cross-functional resources to maximize customer value and revenue opportunities.

  • Scheduling and hosting quarterly business reviews with clients to assess performance, align on priorities, and identify growth opportunities.

Thank you for considering a career at Ensemble!

Ensemble is a leading provider of technology-enabled revenue cycle management solutions for health systems, including hospitals and affiliated physician groups. They offer end-to-end revenue cycle solutions as well as a comprehensive suite of point solutions to clients across the country.

Ensemble keeps communities healthy by keeping hospitals healthy. We recognize that healthcare requires a human touch, and we believe that every touch should be meaningful. This is why our people are the most important part of who we are. By empowering them to challenge the status quo, we know they will be the difference!

O.N.E Purpose:

  • Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

  • Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

  • Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

The Opportunity:

Client Provisioning Manager

Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)

Position Summary

The Client Provisioning Manager - Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) leads client access provisioning operations supporting the revenue cycle workforce and healthcare client environments. This role is accountable for delivering secure, timely, accurate, and scalable access throughout the user lifecycle while ensuring client readiness, operational control, and a strong service experience.

The Manager leads the Client Provisioning team and partners closely with IAM, RCM Operations, Information Technology, Security, Implementation teams, application owners, and client stakeholders. The ideal candidate combines people's leadership, operational excellence, healthcare/RCM knowledge, strong client partnership, and an automation-first mindset.


Key Responsibilities

Client Provisioning Operations

  • Lead day-to-day client provisioning and access administration operations across multiple healthcare clients.
  • Oversee onboarding, access changes, transfers, client assignments, terminations, and deprovisioning activities.
  • Manage service performance, including SLAs, request volumes, backlog, aging, quality, escalations, and workload.
  • Ensure provisioning activities follow established security, authorization, documentation, and compliance requirements.
  • Serve as the management escalation point for complex provisioning and client access issues.
  • Balance operational priorities and team capacity while maintaining a strong client and employee experience.

Client Implementation & Access Readiness

  • Represent Client Provisioning throughout new RCM client implementations, transitions, and go-live activities.
  • Partner with implementation and operational teams to identify provisioning requirements early in the client lifecycle.
  • Ensure access models, application requirements, approval processes, client documentation, escalation paths, and knowledge transfer are established before transition to steady-state operations.
  • Identify provisioning dependencies, readiness gaps, and operational risks and engage the appropriate stakeholders for resolution.
  • Support structured handoffs from implementation teams into ongoing operational support.

Standardization & Continuous Improvement

  • Establish consistent and repeatable provisioning processes across clients while maintaining documented client-specific requirements where necessary.
  • Maintain operational procedures, SOPs, access matrices, client documentation, and escalation processes.
  • Identify manual, repetitive, and high-volume processes that can be simplified or automated.
  • Partner with IAM Engineering and technology teams to improve identity lifecycle and access-delivery processes.
  • Reduce unnecessary manual handoffs, rework, and dependency on individual or undocumented knowledge.

Team Leadership & Capacity Management

  • Lead, coach, and develop Client Provisioning team members.
  • Establish clear responsibilities, performance expectations, and accountability.
  • Manage workload and capacity based on client demand, complexity, priority, and available resources.
  • Build cross-training, backup coverage, and knowledge-sharing practices across the team.
  • Promote a culture of collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, exceptional service, and innovation.

Performance & Governance

  • Establish and monitor key operational metrics, including provisioning volume, SLA performance, backlog, aging, quality, capacity, and automation opportunities.
  • Use operational data to identify trends, risks, resource constraints, and improvement opportunities.
  • Provide transparent reporting to IAM leadership and key business partners.
  • Support access governance, audit, security, and compliance requirements related to client provisioning
  • Ensure access-removal and termination processes receive appropriate operational priority.

Required Qualifications

  • Leadership experience within Revenue Cycle Management, Identity & Access Management, Client Provisioning, Healthcare IT Operations, Access Administration, or a related operational function.
  • Demonstrated experience leading and developing teams in a high-volume, service-oriented environment.
  • Understanding of identity lifecycle processes, including onboarding, access changes, transfers, terminations, provisioning, deprovisioning, approvals, and access management.
  • Experience managing operational performance, SLAs, workload, capacity, and escalations.
  • Strong client-facing, stakeholder-management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Ability to establish and improve operational processes, controls, documentation, and accountability.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a complex, multi-client environment with changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting healthcare Revenue Cycle Management operations.
  • Experience supporting healthcare client implementations, onboarding, or operational transitions.
  • Familiarity with enterprise IAM and workflow technologies such as SailPoint, ServiceNow, Microsoft Entra ID, SSO, SCIM, security-group-based access models, workflow automation, or RPA.
  • Experience partnering with technical teams to automate or streamline access-management processes.
  • Experience working in a regulated environment with security, access governance, audit, or compliance requirements.

Success in This Role

  • Deliver consistent, reliable, and measurable provisioning services across RCM clients.
  • Ensure new clients have clearly defined access requirements and operational readiness before transition to steady-state support.
  • Improve visibility into provisioning demand, SLA performance, backlog, capacity, risks, and trends.
  • Increase standardization across client provisioning processes and reduce manual effort through automation and process improvement.
  • Strengthen cross-training, team coverage, operational resiliency, and partnerships across IAM, RCM Operations, IT, Security, implementation teams, and client stakeholders.
  • Create clear ownership and accountability so Client Provisioning can deliver an efficient, scalable service.

Leadership Profile

  • Client-focused: Balances service excellence with operational and security controls.
  • Data-driven: Uses metrics to identify issues, prioritize improvements, and inform decisions.
  • Automation-minded: Continuously seeks opportunities to eliminate unnecessary manual work.
  • Accountable: Establishes clear ownership, expectations, and follow-through.
  • Collaborative: Works effectively across business, technology, security, and client teams.
  • People-focused: Coaches, develops, and empowers the team.

  • This position pays between $92,400 – $138,600 based on experience
  • Must be inquisitive and demonstrate openness to innovation including AI to explore better processes and ways to alleviate friction and improve patient and client experiences.
  • This is a remote position; however, candidates must be willing and able to travel to and work onsite at client, temporary, or corporate office locations as business needs require.



Join an award-winning company

22 Healthcare Financial Management Association (HFMA) MAP Awards for High Performance in Revenue Cycle 2019-2024

POSITION SUMMARY: With general direction, utilizing an understanding of accounting principles, the Area Accountant performs accounting activities to record, analyze and monitor financial information. The incumbent prepares financial reports in a manner that ensures accuracy and compliance with company accounting policies. The Area Accountant may act as a resource for accounting and general administrative staff and is responsible for a broad array of accounting duties.

PRINCIPAL RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Compiles and analyzes financial information to prepare journal entries and document business transactions. Prepares monthly and quarterly operational performance reports. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

  • Assists the Area Controller in ensuring there are proper internal controls in place including compliance with company policies and procedures, Sarbanes Oxley and all other statutory requirements. In doing so, utilizes discretion and judgment as to matters of significance.

  • Reconciles balance sheet accounts and statistical data and fully analyses financial statements in accordance with the Generally Accepted Accounting Principals (GAAP) and Company policy.

May provide direction to the different accounting functional areas (invoice processing, billing, cash receipts, work order processing, credit analysis, receivable collections, month-end close, journal entries, statistical data, and payroll).

  • Supports the accounting aspects of capital expenditures, transfers and retirements.

For any concerns relating to Republic Services’ commitment to equal opportunity employment, you may contact the AWARE Line at 1-866-3-AWARE-4.

ABOUT THE COMPANY

Republic Services, Inc. (NYSE: RSG) is a leader in the environmental services industry. We provide customers with the most complete set of products and services, including recycling, waste, special waste, hazardous waste and field services. Our industry-leading commitments to advance circularity and support decarbonization are helping deliver on our vision to partner with customers to create a more sustainable world.


In 2025, Republic’s total company revenue was $16.6 billion, and adjusted EBITDA was $5.3 billion. We serve 13 million customers and operate more than 1,000 locations, including collection and transfer stations, recycling and polymer centers, treatment facilities, and landfills.


Although we operate across North America, the collection, recycling, treatment, or disposal of materials is a local business, and the dynamics and opportunities differ in each market we serve. By combining local operational management with standardized business practices, we drive greater operating efficiencies across the company while maintaining day-to-day operational decisions at the local level, closest to the customer.


Our customers, including small businesses, major corporations and municipalities, want a partner with the expertise and capabilities to effectively manage their multiple recycling and waste streams. They choose Republic Services because we are committed to exceeding their expectations and helping them achieve their sustainability goals. Our 42,000 team members understand that it's not just what we do that matters, but how we do it.


Our company values guide our daily actions:

  • Safe: We protect the livelihoods of our colleagues and communities.
  • Committed to Serve: We go above and beyond to exceed our customers’ expectations.
  • Environmentally Responsible: We take action to improve our environment.
  • Driven: We deliver results in the right way.
  • Human-Centered: We respect the dignity and unique potential of every person.

We are proud of our high employee engagement score of 86. We have an inclusive and diverse culture where every voice counts. In addition, our team positively impacted 5.1 million people in 2024 through the Republic Services Charitable Foundation and local community grants. These projects are designed to meet the specific needs of the communities we serve, with a focus on building sustainable neighborhoods.


STRATEGY

Republic Services’ strategy is designed to generate profitable growth. Through acquisitions and industry advancements, we safely and sustainably manage our customers’ multiple waste streams through a North American footprint of vertically integrated assets.

We focus on three areas of growth to meet the increasing needs of our customers: recycling and waste, environmental solutions and sustainability innovation.

With our integrated approach, strengthening our position in one area advances other areas of our business. For example, as we grow volume in recycling and waste, we collect additional material to bolster our circularity capabilities. And as we expand environmental solutions, we drive additional opportunities to provide these services to our existing recycling and waste customers.


Recycling and Waste

We continue to expand our recycling and waste business footprint throughout North America through organic growth and targeted acquisitions. The 13 million customers we serve and our more than 5 million pick-ups per day provide us with a distinct advantage. We aggregate materials at scale, unlocking new opportunities for advanced recycling. In addition, we are cross-selling new products and services to better meet our customers’ specific needs.


Environmental Solutions

Our comprehensive environmental solutions capabilities help customers safely manage their most technical waste streams. We are expanding both our capabilities and our geographic footprint. We see strong growth opportunities for our offerings, including PFAS remediation, an increasing customer need.

Sustainability Innovation

Republic’s recent innovations to advance circularity and decarbonization demonstrate our unique ability to leverage sustainability as a platform for growth.


The Republic Services Polymer Center is the nation’s first integrated plastics recycling facility. These innovative sites process rigid plastics from our recycling centers, producing recycled materials that promote true bottle-to-bottle circularity. We also formed Blue Polymers, a joint venture with Ravago, to develop facilities that will further process plastic material from our Polymer Centers to help meet the growing demand for sustainable packaging. We are building a network of Polymer Centers and Blue Polymer facilities across North America.


Our customers are increasingly looking for decarbonization solutions, and we are leveraging our network of landfills to meet that need. Republic is committed to harnessing landfill gas, a natural byproduct of decomposing waste, and converting it to energy. Republic has partnered with renewable gas developers to construct Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) plants at our landfills, expanding beyond the 77 projects we currently have to make progress towards our goal to beneficially reuse 50% more biogas by 2030 (2017 baseline year).

POSITION SUMMARY:

Conducts CPT and ICD-10 coding reviews by detailed examination of each line item in the physician medical record and charge session. Performs chart audits to ensure correct coding and charge capture have been applied appropriately. Works closely with key revenue cycle stakeholders to understand reasons for denials, root cause analysis, and feedback to providers.

Position: Physician Practice Coder

Department: BUMG Corporate PBO General

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

Coding support

  • Reviews patient medical records and abstracts medical data that identifies all diagnoses and procedures. Codes diagnoses, procedures, and appropriate modifiers from the medical record documentation using ICD-10-CM, CPT4/HCPCS classification systems. Refers to a computerized encoding system, written coding aids and other reference materials to ensure accurate coding for billing.

  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, CPT-4, and the Uniform Hospital Discharge Data Set (UHDDS); adheres to the Official Guidelines for Coding and Reporting, Coding Clinic guidelines and other regulatory guidelines as appropriate. Consults with the CDCI team to request appropriate physician or appropriate medical staff to clarify medical record information.

  • Maintains productivity standards set forth in Departmental Policies and procedures.

  • Maintains knowledge of coding and professional skills, including maintaining yearly coding credentials through attendance at in-service programs, conferences, workshops, review of current literature and other educational programs.

  • Utilizes hospital’s cultural values as the basis for decision making and to facilitate the hospital’s goals and mission.

  • Follows established Hospital infection control and safety procedures.

  • Review and respond to coding questions.

  • Ensure billed service is being accurately coded.

  • Perform random chart audits.

  • Provide continual coding updates.

  • Research coding issues that arise.

  • Codes diagnoses and procedures from the medical record using ICD-10-CM and CPT-4/HCPCS classification systems.

  • Sequences diagnoses, procedures and complications by following ICD-10-CM, Medicare, Medicaid, and other fiscal intermediary guidelines.

  • Reviews charts for documentation and signature.

  • Performs other duties as needed.

  • Must adhere to all of BMC’s RESPECT behavioral standards.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • Associates Degree (or direct work experience equivalent to at least 2 years)

CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS REQUIRED:

  • CPC – Certified Professional Coder

  • CPC-A – Certified Professional Coder Apprentice

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2-5 years experience required in a multi-specialty physician coding environment to include coding, compliance, and billing processes.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Work requires in-depth knowledge of medical terminology, ICD-10-CM and CPT-4 Work also requires basic concepts of human anatomy, physiology and pathology.

  • Strong knowledge of health records, computerized billing and charging systems, Microsoft applications, data integrity, and processing techniques required.

  • Excellent organizational skills, including ability to multi-task, prioritize essential tasks, follow-through and meet timelines.

  • Ability to work with accuracy and attention to detail

  • Ability to solve problems appropriately using job knowledge and current policies/procedures.

  • Ability to work cooperatively with members of the healthcare delivery team and staff, ability to handle frequent interruptions and adapt to changes in workload and work schedule and to respond quickly to urgent requests.

  • Must be able to maintain strict confidentiality of all personal/health sensitive information and ensure compliance of HIPAA rules and regulations.

Compensation Range:

$24.04- $33.65

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. Senior Frontend Technical Lead — React & Integrations

Location preference: Denver, CO (Open for Remote)

Position Summary

  • We are seeking a highly skilled Lead Web Developer – React / Node.js to take ownership of web application architecture, hands-on development, and technical delivery for a high-impact web team. This is a hands-on coding role requiring deep expertise in React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Express, along with the ability to guide developers, make sound architecture decisions, and deliver scalable, production-grade web applications.
  • In this role, you will lead the design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of web applications integrated with restaurant technology ecosystems, while partnering closely with clients, product teams, IT leadership, marketing, and engineering teams.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and ongoing enhancement of scalable web applications.
  • Own and drive the overall web application architecture, frontend strategy, and technical roadmap.
  • Actively code features and user stories, review code, resolve defects, and provide hands-on support throughout delivery.
  • Develop and maintain multiple pages and application experiences using React.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, Node.js, and Express.
  • Design scalable React applications using modern frontend architecture principles, including headless architecture, atomic design, state management, API integration, error handling, and performance optimization.
  • Integrate web applications with restaurant technology ecosystems, including:
  • Online ordering platforms
  • POS systems
  • Payment providers
  • Loyalty and rewards platforms
  • Customer identity and authentication solutions

  • Identify technical gaps, challenge assumptions, guide developers, review designs and code, and make decisions based on the complete solution.
  • Assess delivery risks, manage technical dependencies, coordinate testing, and prepare applications for production releases.
  • Partner effectively with IT Directors, Product Management, Marketing, and development team members to plan roadmaps and deliver solutions.
  • Establish and promote coding standards, development best practices, architecture patterns, documentation practices, and technical guidelines.
  • Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code with a focus on consistency and long-term maintainability.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, upgrade, and optimize existing applications.
  • Ensure application performance, quality, responsiveness, availability, and customer experience.
  • Monitor application performance, crashes, availability, and customer experience metrics using tools such as DataDog, Splunk, App Insights, New Relic, or similar platforms.
  • Support CI/CD practices and contribute to efficient release processes.
  • Develop and maintain unit testing frameworks and quality practices.
  • Apply knowledge of application security and networking to build reliable, secure solutions.
  • Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and modern engineering practices to support continuous innovation.
  • Bring a consulting mindset, strong client communication, and effective presentation skills to technical discussions and delivery engagements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of professional software or web development experience, including significant experience building production-grade web applications.
  • 5+ years of recent hands-on coding experience with React.js; coding assessment will be conducted.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • 4+ years in a Lead Web Developer, Tech Lead, or similar technical leadership role.
  • 3+ years of experience with Node.js and Express.
  • 3+ years of experience leading and mentoring Developers and Senior Developers.
  • 2+ years of experience with Microsoft Azure.
  • Strong hands-on experience creating and maintaining multi-page applications in React.js.
  • Full stack familiarity, including backend technologies such as Node.js and related services.
  • Strong experience with HTML5, CSS, and CSS preprocessors such as LESS and SASS.
  • Advanced knowledge of command line build utilities and task runners such as npm, webpack, grunt, and gulp.
  • Advanced knowledge of accessibility standards.
  • Real-time working experience with asynchronous requests, API integrations, partial page updates, SEO optimization, SSR, and page performance troubleshooting and optimization.
  • Expert-level understanding of version control systems, including Git.
  • Proven experience with CI/CD practices.
  • Track record developing unit testing frameworks.
  • Competency in application security and networking.
  • Familiarity with Azure Cloud Functions.
  • Experience working in Agile teams and planning technical roadmaps.
  • Ability to assess risks, manage dependencies, coordinate testing, and support successful production releases.
  • Strong documentation discipline, commitment to consistency and reusability, and the ability to see the big picture.
  • Strong consulting, client communication, and presentation skills.
  • Practical judgment, attention to scope management, and a collaborative approach to solving delivery challenges.
  • Experience integrating restaurant POS platforms is a plus.
  • Experience in restaurant technology, retail, hospitality, or e-commerce is a plus.

  • Ability to develop and execute strategies aligned with regional and market business objectives.
  • Experience in workforce planning and resource management to ensure appropriate staffing and workload distribution.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through change, drive innovation, and implement process improvements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced degree in a related field.

raw.description:
About us

Dyson is a global technology enterprise. We solve the problems others choose to ignore, with surprising new inventions that defy convention and simply work better. We’re growing fast and our ambition is huge – more categories, more locations, and more people.
From its beginnings in cyclonic vacuums, Dyson’s portfolio has grown to include five main areas of technology: Cord-free and corded vacuum cleaners, hand dryers, lighting, environmental control machines (purifying fans, heating and cooling fans and humidifiers) and hair styling tools, which are sold in more than 82 countries across the world. We are on a mission to improve our customer’s lives: whether that be by making the the air they breathe safe and clean, or connecting them to high performing machines, which keep their homes clean.

About the role

Role Overview

The Social Commerce Content Specialist supports the execution and optimization of Dyson Singapore's social commerce content across TikTok Shop and other platforms. The role plans, creates, publishes and optimizes social commerce-native content that supports discovery, engagement, qualified traffic and commerce contribution, while exploring AI-enabled workflows to improve creative speed and production efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

1. Always-On Content Planning

  • Support the development of weekly content plans and publishing schedules based on commercial priorities and campaign requirements.
  • Recommend content themes, product focus areas and campaign support ideas for Dyson's owned social commerce channel.
  • Maintain a strong base bank of planned content while protecting capacity for reactive trends and timely cultural moments.
  • Balance product education, demonstration, problem-solution, creator-led, entertainment and conversion-oriented formats.
  • Plan sufficient content depth to support multiple daily posts during launches and key commercial periods without compromising quality or accuracy.

2. End-to-End Content Creation

  • Spot relevant social trends, behaviors, sounds, formats and hooks; translate them into ideas appropriate for a premium technology brand.
  • Develop concepts, hooks, scripts and shot lists for organic and commerce content, with guidance from the wider team where required.
  • Shoot and edit content using mobile-first workflows and collaborate with internal stakeholders; create platform-native cuts, captions, graphics and sound treatments.
  • Publish content accurately and on time, with correct product naming, claims, links, tags and social commerce Shop product anchors.
  • Explore AI-enabled tools to improve ideation, scripting, editing, localization and content versioning.

3. Content Re-Purposing and Capture

  • Rework suitable global and regional assets into local, social-native edits.
  • Identify and repurpose high-performing material from affiliates, owned livestreams, experts, stylists, launches and events, subject to usage rights.
  • Create content briefs and capture plans for colleagues, creators, and talent, so usable footage is generated efficiently.
  • Maintain an organized content library with clear status, usage rights, product, format, and tags.

4. Trend-Jacking and Reactive Execution

  • Identify reactive opportunities that are relevant to Dyson products, audiences and brand standards.

5. Performance Optimization

  • Track views, watch time, completion, engagement, shares, saves, profile visits, product clicks and video-attributed GMV.
  • Identify winning hooks, formats, products and creators; create follow-up variations and retire approaches that are consistently weak.
  • Provide a concise weekly content readout with insights, next tests and recommended changes, not only a list of posts published.
  • Work with the Social Commerce Lead and Marketing to identify high-performing organic content suitable for paid boosting.

6. Brand and Content Governance

  • Ensure all content meets brand, legal, product-claim, music-rights and platform-compliance requirements.
  • Maintain Dyson's premium positioning while creating content that feels current and native to TikTok.

* Key Performance Indicators

  • Output and Consistency:Agreed owned-channel publishing cadence delivered; planned base content and reactive content produced on time.

  • Speed: Time from trend identification or commercial brief to approved publication.

  • Attention Quality:Average watch time, completion rate, shares, saves and engagement versus benchmarks.

  • Commerce Contribution: Product clicks, click-through rate, video-attributed GMV and qualified content passed for boosting.

  • Learning Velocity​:Number and quality of structured tests, repeatable winning formats and performance-led iterations.

About You

  • 1-2 years' experience in short-form video, social content, creative production or creator-led marketing.
  • Demonstrable social media-native portfolio with strong hooks, pacing, storytelling, product demonstration and editing judgement.
  • Able to concept, script, shoot and edit independently using tools such as CapCut, Premiere Pro or equivalent.
  • Fast and resourceful, with strong trend judgement and discipline to protect premium brand standards.
  • Curious and hands-on with AI content tools, with the ability to test new workflows responsibly and turn successful experiments into repeatable production processes.
  • Strong attention to detail in product claims, captions, tagging, links, file management and publishing accuracy.
  • Able to work with employees, creators, experts and stylists to capture natural, useful content efficiently.

Dyson is an equal opportunity employer. We know that great minds don’t think alike, and it takes all kinds of minds to make our technology so unique. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and employment decisions are made without regard to race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other any other dimension of diversity.

POSITION SUMMARY:


About SafeSpot: SafeSpot is a service of the Grayken Center for Addiction at Boston Medical Center and provides critical support, resources, and assistance to individuals at risk of overdose. Our hotline operates 24/7, offering confidential and compassionate assistance to callers seeking help, information, and referrals to local treatment and support services. SafeSpot aims to reduce overdose deaths and improve access to addiction treatment and support across the state of Massachusetts.


The Hotline Operator plays a critical role at SafeSpot as the frontline point of contact with our callers. They will be responsible for managing incoming calls and talking with callers using a harm reduction framework. Hotline calls are opportunities to engage people who use drugs in meaningful conversation and the ideal candidate would be comfortable talking to people who are actively using drugs and who come from diverse backgrounds and experiences. The ideal candidate should possess excellent communication skills, a calm demeanor in potentially challenging situations, and a strong dedication to saving lives through prompt and compassionate actions. This role is “pay per call” and has monthly call requirements in order to stay active on the team.


Provides hotline support for the State resource center at BMC for opioid dependence. Answer calls, collects data for the State on callers to assist in service needs, provide callers with names and numbers for treatment. Assists patients from the community settings and BMC to access treatment, assists with set up of appointments. Works with the Opioid treatment nurses and providers on program improvements, dissemination of information, and collaboration. Coordinates with Department of Public Heath Bureau of Substance Abuse Services, and HIV/AIDS Bureau. Performs phone screener on patients interested in accessing treatment, provides back up to medical assistant.



Position: Hotline Operator

Department: Research - GIM (SafeSpot)
Schedule: Part Time, Remote


JOB RESPONSIBILITIES


  • Primarily responsible for providing Hotline support for State support resource center for opioid dependence.
  • Provide consistent and supportive crisis intervention; provide consistent and accurate referral services.
  • Responsible for coordination of various OBOT (Office-based Opioid Treatment) Program activities
  • Manages collection and data entry of pertinent information for statistical purposes and for reporting purposes.
  • Assists clients to linkages to addiction services; detox programs, Methadone maintenance, outpatient services, etc.
  • Triages walk-in patients accessing opioid treatment; resource, education, and support.
  • Screens potential patients
  • Back up support to medical assistant
  • Maintains wait list in compliance within federal regulations.
  • Ensures ongoing resource updates and development of resources for clients and family members
  • Disseminates resource materials to clients, family members, support systems, and providers
  • Collaborates with Department of Public Health Drug and Alcohol hotline support staff.

raw.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As Manager, SOX PMO - Business Process, you'll lead Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) compliance for assigned business processes as part of GitLab's second line. This is advisory work, not repeatable testing: you'll deeply understand how processes work, evaluate risks as the business changes, and help control owners design and remediate controls that hold up to audit. Judgment matters more than procedure. You'll form well-supported conclusions, align with control owners and Internal Audit, and defend positions to external auditors. GitLab already uses AI extensively, and the next phase brings AI agents into our SOX processes. You'll help teams adopt them with confidence, finding creative ways to enable new ways of working while maintaining compliance. You'll also partner with the information technology (IT) SOX PMO on readiness for new systems and applications. This role reports to the Senior Director, SOX PMO, within the Chief Accounting Officer's organization.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead SOX compliance for assigned business processes as the second-line subject matter expert, advising control owners who own and operate the controls. Deeply understand each process, its systems and data flows, and resolve open questions and assumptions early.
  • Monitor risks from new and changing processes, products, and systems. Help control owners design, strengthen, or right-size controls, and contribute to the annual SOX risk assessment and scoping.
  • Evaluate control deficiencies individually and in aggregate, identify root causes, and prepare well-supported severity assessments. Work with management to develop, implement, and monitor remediation plans.
  • Prepare auditor-ready technical memos on sampling methodology, scoping, and control rationalization, using independent analysis and sound conclusions. Prepare reports and presentations on SOX compliance status for leadership.
  • Lead business walkthroughs and stakeholder meetings, and coordinate with Internal Audit and external auditors throughout the audit. Anticipate questions, support positions with data and judgment, and escalate risks and auditor comments promptly with a recommended path forward.
  • Advise on controls for AI-enabled processes and processes that use AI agents. Find opportunities to automate SOX work using AI tools, and validate their output.
  • Partner with the IT SOX PMO to assess new systems and controls, including application controls and key reports.
  • Develop and maintain accurate process narratives, flowcharts, and risk and control matrices as processes change. Collaborate with Finance, Operations, Legal, Human Resources, Sales, Engineering, and IT leaders to help them design and maintain effective business controls.

What You’ll Bring

  • Hands-on SOX and internal controls experience in control design, remediation, and deficiency evaluation, beyond testing alone. Experience in the software or technology industry is required; SOX PMO, Big Four risk advisory, or assurance experience is a strong plus.
  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field; an active Certified Public Accountant (CPA) credential (strongly preferred) or Certified Internal Auditor (CIA) credential.
  • A strong understanding of SOX requirements and internal control frameworks, such as the Committee of Sponsoring Organizations of the Treadway Commission (COSO) framework.
  • Professional judgment and skepticism: verifying facts against source documents, testing the reasonableness of data and conclusions, and recognizing missing information.
  • A track record of independently solving ambiguous, novel problems, from defining an approach through overcoming obstacles and driving resolution. Curiosity to understand how processes actually work and keep learning as the business changes.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including concise, accurate, auditor-ready memos and actionable recommendations. Confidence partnering with senior stakeholders and external auditors, including working through pushback.
  • A practical, innovative approach to helping the business adopt new technologies, products, and ways of working while maintaining compliance. Experience using AI tools to improve efficiency and validating their output.
  • Experience with usage-based billing or AuditBoard is a plus.

About the team

The SOX PMO is part of the Chief Accounting Officer's organization. In this role, you'll advise business control owners and partner with the IT SOX PMO, Internal Audit, and external auditors to keep GitLab compliant as processes, systems, and AI use evolve. GitLab is an all-remote company, with flexibility to work from home or wherever you're most productive. You'll need to be available to collaborate with teammates during core US Pacific (PT) and Eastern (ET) business hours.

Join the growing Warfare Systems Business Group at HII Mission Technologies! We are seeking a Data Engineer / Reporting Developer to support the Defense Security Cooperation Agency (DSCA) mission by developing enterprise reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions that enable informed decision-making across Building Partner Capacity programs and initiatives.

In this role, you will leverage data from the War Data Platform (WDP) and other authoritative data sources to create dashboards, reporting products, and data visualizations that provide actionable insights to mission stakeholders. You will be responsible for data pipeline development, data transformation, warehouse-based reporting solutions, and ensuring the quality and integrity of enterprise data assets. The selected candidate will collaborate closely with analysts, business users, and technical teams to deliver accurate, scalable, and impactful data products in support of mission objectives.

  • Experience integrating data from multiple source systems into reporting and analytical solutions.
  • Understanding of data quality, data validation, and data reconciliation methodologies.

When a member is seeing several providers, it’s easy for a referral, medication question, or follow-up appointment to get lost between offices. As an RN Care Coordinator, you’ll look at the full picture with the member, help determine what needs attention first, and make sure everyone involved in their care has the information they need.

AlediumHR is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client, which supports Medicaid, Medicare Advantage, and Dual Eligible Special Needs Plan (D-SNP) members. You’ll manage your own caseload and work with members by phone and text, including people with complex medical and social needs.

Responsibilities

  • Manage a high-volume caseload with outbound calls and texts. Set follow-up priorities and keep track of outstanding needs across your caseload.
  • Assess each member’s medical and social needs and develop a care plan with them that reflects their goals and circumstances.
  • Use your nursing judgment to identify concerns that need a provider’s attention and communicate the relevant information clearly.
  • Coordinate with providers, health plans, pharmacies, and community organizations to arrange appointments, referrals, and services.
  • Explain available programs and benefits. Use patient education and motivational interviewing to help members understand their options and take part in decisions about their care.
  • Help members address barriers such as transportation or access to medication, and follow up to find out whether the services they needed were put in place.
  • Document assessments, member contacts, care plans, and follow-up in the care management platform. Complete required correspondence.

raw.description:
En Imagemaker estamos en búsqueda de un líder de Observabilidad. Este rol existe para traducir las exigencias regulatorias y de negocio en una arquitectura de monitoreo end-to-end aprobable por el banco, garantizando que toda la telemetría (logs, trazas y eventos de negocio) se ingeste, correlacione y mida con exactitud antes de salir a producción.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar la arquitectura de observabilidad end-to-end (HLD/LLD) aprobada por SRE Central.
  • Definir el catálogo de SLIs, SLOs, error budgets y journeys transaccionales críticos.
  • Especificar la instrumentación de trazas, logs y business events con reglas de privacidad.
  • Desarrollar dashboards ejecutivos y alertas automáticas como código mediante Terraform y Monaco.
  • Auditar la calidad técnica y los pull requests del equipo de observabilidad.
  • Liderar la planificación, el backlog y los riesgos técnicos frente al cliente.
  • Entregar el paquete de promoción a producción.

Requisitos

Imprescindibles (Must-Have)

  • Ingeniería en Dynatrace SaaS (3ª Generación): Dominar el ecosistema nativo en la nube, incluyendo Grail (almacén de datos unificado para logs y eventos), DQL (Dynatrace Query Language o lenguaje de consultas),Notebooks, Dashboards y Business Events (eventos de negocio), descartando perfiles que solo operen versiones clásicas on-premise.
  • Arquitectura de Observabilidad End-to-End: Diseñar soluciones de extremo a extremo bajo la metodología de "diseño antes que construcción", definiendo catálogos de SLIs (Service Level Indicators o indicadores de nivel de servicio), SLOs (Service Level Objectives u objetivos de nivel de servicio), error budgets (presupuestos de error) y mapas de flujos críticos entre sistemas desacoplados.
  • Instrumentación y Telemetría Distribuida: Especificar y validar la captura de trazas distribuidas, logs y métricas mediante Dynatrace OneAgent y estándares de OpenTelemetry, asegurando que las respuestas de los microservicios incluyan los campos del diccionario de datos transaccional.
  • Monitoring as Code (MaC) y Control de Versiones: Desarrollar, versionar y desplegar configuraciones de monitoreo como código (alertas, tableros y objetivos) utilizando Terraform y Monaco (Dynatrace Monitoring as Code) sobre repositorios Git y Bitbucket mediante flujos de aprobación de Pull Requests.
  • Seguridad, Privacidad y Cumplimiento Regulatorio: Implementar reglas estrictas de enmascaramiento y ofuscación de datos sensibles bajo normativas PII (Personally Identifiable Information o información personal identificable) y PCI (Payment Card Industry o industria de tarjetas de pago), garantizando mediciones auditables para entes reguladores.
  • Entornos Cloud Native y Sistemas Operativos: Comprender la arquitectura e ingesta de telemetría sobre clústeres de contenedores en Kubernetes y OpenShift (incluyendo distribuciones Atlas o Anthos), así como entornos base Unix/Linux y consumo de APIs (Application Programming Interfaces o interfaces de programación).

Deseables (Nice-to-Have)

  • Capacidades Avanzadas de IA y Automatización en Dynatrace: Configurar motores de inteligencia artificial causal (Davis AI) para detección automática de anomalías, así como diseñar flujos automatizados (Workflows) y pruebas de monitoreo sintético (Synthetics) para simular transacciones de punta a punta.
  • Certificaciones Oficiales de Dynatrace: Contar con la acreditación Dynatrace Associate (exigida en el pliego formal pero flexibilizada por el cliente frente a experiencia comprobable) o el nivel superior Dynatrace Professional.
  • Experiencia en Banca o Medios de Pago en Tiempo Real: Haber instrumentado ecosistemas financieros de alta criticidad y baja latencia, comprendiendo el ciclo de vida de transferencias interbancarias, cámaras de compensación y reportes regulatorios ante bancos centrales.
  • Inglés Técnico Avanzado: Poseer capacidad de lectura técnica fluida para interpretar documentación oficial de plataformas SaaS y notas de lanzamiento (release notes), complementando el dominio nativo o fluido del español requerido para la operación diaria.

Beneficios

Ser Maker es cool!

✨ Permiso sin goce de sueldo para cumplir tus sueños.

💰 Bonificaciones que dan respiros: Fiestas patrias, navidad, matrimonio/AUC, nacimiento/adopción de hijos, etc.
💳 Convenios y precios preferenciales con bancos.

As a Customer Success Manager (CSM) at Lone Wolf, you will own the ongoing success of a portfolio of MLS and Association customers and help them achieve meaningful business outcomes through our solutions. You will serve as a trusted advisor, customer advocate, and internal orchestrator across the post-sale journey. Your role is to understand what success means for each customer, translate those goals into a clear plan, drive adoption and value realization, identify risk early, and coordinate the right resources to keep the customer moving forward. This is not simply a relationship-management or issue-escalation role. Our CSMs are expected to take accountability for the customer experience, lead with insight, maintain strong operational discipline, and ensure customers and internal teams have a clear understanding of goals, progress, risks, and next steps.

Our MLS and Association customers serve thousands of real estate professionals, and their success is measured both by their own organizational health and by the value they deliver to their members. You will work with executive leaders, staff, and board members to align our solutions to their strategic priorities.

Responsibilities:

  • Own Customer Outcomes: Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business, priorities, workflows, stakeholders, and desired outcomes, including their governance structure, member needs, and strategic goals. Translate those objectives into clear success criteria, milestones, and an actionable customer Success Plan.
  • Drive Adoption and Value: Use product knowledge, customer conversations, usage data, and business context to identify adoption gaps and opportunities across the organization and its membership. Guide customers toward the workflows and behaviors that will help them realize greater value from Lone Wolf solutions.
  • Lead Proactive Engagement: Conduct regular, proactive virtual and in-person meetings (1:1 or group) based on customer needs, segment, risk, and opportunity. Lead purposeful conversations with staff, executives, and, as needed, boards and committees to share updates and insights, provide best practices, address obstacles, and ensure customers are deriving ongoing value from their investment.
  • Manage Customer Health and Risk: Continuously assess customer health indicators and usage data to proactively identify potential risks early, diagnose root causes, and lead documented recovery plans with clear actions, owners, timelines, and communication.
  • Orchestrate the Customer Experience: Coordinate effectively across Support, implementation, Product, Sales, and other teams to deliver a connected customer experience. While you may not personally perform every action, you will maintain ownership of customer communication, internal alignment, and follow-through.
  • Build Renewal Readiness: Ensure customers are positioned for renewal by helping them achieve measurable value, maintaining strong alignment with executive and board-level stakeholders, and surfacing risks well before the renewal date, accounting for governance processes, budget cycles, and formal review timelines. Partner closely with Sales or the appropriate commercial owner to provide an accurate, evidence-based view of account health, outcomes, and renewal risk.
  • Contribute to Team Excellence: Share knowledge, contribute ideas, strengthen playbooks and best practices, and help build a culture of accountability, learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Customer-first mindset with a passion for driving customer outcomes and delivering value through every interaction
  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing Success role (Customer Success, Account Management, or similar) in a SaaS environment
  • Demonstrated ability to understand customer business needs and connect software adoption to measurable outcomes
  • Strong consultative skills, including discovery, active listening, problem diagnosis, and the ability to guide or challenge customers constructively
  • Experience managing a portfolio of customers with competing priorities, risks, and deadlines
  • Executive presence and comfort engaging senior leaders and presenting to boards, committees, or other group audiences
  • A vocal team player and emerging leader: you speak up, contribute ideas, and help lift the team through positivity, initiative, and knowledge-sharing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills: you know how to simplify complex topics and tailor your message to your audience
  • Solid problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to managing customer needs and resolving issues
  • Collaborative and resourceful: you know when to own it and when to loop in teammates or other departments
  • A keen interest in technology and helping customers adopt software to improve their business
  • Preferred: Experience with MLS, REALTOR® associations, or other membership-based or governance-driven organizations, or a strong working knowledge of the real estate industry
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% for customer meetings and industry events

You will also be a builder of systems, creating playbooks, approval matrices, and deal desk processes, and bringing an AI-first approach to legal work. You will report to the VP, Legal and play a central role in shaping the legal team's strategic impact and operational excellence.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the senior legal partner to the CRO, CFO, and Procurement leadership, advising on deal strategy and balancing speed against risk.

  • Support international expansion, including local entity setup, regional partners and distributors, localized contract frameworks, and coordination with local counsel across the EU, UK, APAC, LATAM, and other regions.
  • Lead procurement and supply chain legal for technology, manufacturing, and logistics vendors.
  • Build and manage a team of attorneys and contract managers.
  • Actively mentor and develop junior attorneys through coaching, delegation, and regular feedback, setting clear career paths and growing the next generation of legal leaders.
  • Create and maintain contract playbooks, fallback and approval matrices, templates, and deal desk processes that let the business scale efficiently and consistently.

Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. We are looking for an Account Executive-Majors to join our Sales team in Hong Kong. Reporting to the Regional Sales Director, you will be the driving force behind Zscaler’s growth. Team Summary

We specialise in securing Linux edge devices operating in live customer environments. Our DevSecOps engineers collaborate directly with client architects, software developers, and cloud engineering teams.

Job Summary

We are looking for a Senior DevSecOps Engineer with deep Linux and security expertise and strong AWS skills. You will own a workstream end to end, from hardened OS images and secure updates to device identity and secure CI/CD, and will be ready to support other AWS initiatives when needed.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Contribute to architecture and design decisions for secure device management, identity, and updates
  • Build and maintain hardened Linux OS images and configuration baselines aligned with security standards
  • Design and implement secure, reliable update mechanisms for a fleet of edge devices, including offline sites
  • Implement device identity, certificate management, and secure remote access
  • Run containerized workloads on edge devices securely
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines with built-in security: scanning, SBOM, and artifact signing
  • Develop and support cloud services and infrastructure on AWS using infrastructure-as-code
  • Set up monitoring, logging, and alerting for devices and cloud services
  • Automate testing of OS, update, and security changes before they reach production

  • Collaborate with fellow DevSecOps engineers and the client's teams; document solutions and hand them over to the internal team

Qualifications & Skills

  • Use AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, or similar) as the primary development workflow; review, test, and own all generated code
  • 5+ years of commercial experience in DevSecOps, DevOps, and Linux systems engineering including with a strong security focus
  • Expert knowledge of Linux (Ubuntu/Debian) internals and administration
  • Hands-on experience with Linux hardening (CIS benchmarks, AppArmor or SELinux, auditd, firewalls)
  • Practical experience with PKI, TLS, and certificate management
  • Hands-on experience with containers and container security
  • Experience building secure CI/CD pipelines (SAST, SCA, image scanning, SBOM, signing)
  • Strong AWS experience, including IAM, networking, and security services

We Are:


Accenture LearnVantage is Accenture's enterprise learning business, purpose-built to help organizations develop the technology skills their workforce needs to compete. We deliver high-impact, project-based learning programs at scale across topics like cloud, AI, data, programming, and cybersecurity. We partner with leading global enterprises to close skill gaps and drive measurable business outcomes. As our client portfolio grows and our programs scale, delivering a consistently excellent learner experience is of the utmost importance.


You Are:


Customer Experience Managers are internal operational leads for enterprise clients. They know how to deliver the full range of deal types smoothly, whether a deal is a private instructor-led delivery, a multi-week upskilling or reskilling program, on-demand learning, an accelerator, or a blend of several different services. They bring expertise in how each offering is designed, staffed, run, and maintained, and they put that expertise to work with clients, from kickoffs through regular program syncs. They act as a central operational point of contact for complex client programs, coordinating with cross-functional teams and client stakeholders. Behind the scenes, they turn what they hear from clients into clear plans, early risk signals, and improved operational processes.


The Work:


  • Lead assigned client upskilling and reskilling programs, coordinating Sales, Courseware Development, Technology, Operations Delivery, and client stakeholders from planning through completion.
  • Serve as the operational lead for private instructor-led deliveries for clients, partnering with the account's sales lead on client requirements and with Operations Delivery and other teams to make sure every delivery item is completed.
  • Plan and implement delivery for deals that combine instructor-led training, on-demand learning, accelerators, and other offerings, sequencing each component so the client experiences one cohesive program that addresses their needs.
  • Participate in meetings with clients to bring a clear point of view on program design, delivery options, and tradeoffs.
  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with client program owners and sponsors in partnership with Customer Success Managers, so clients collaborate with a consistent, knowledgeable delivery partner.
  • Translate what clients need into clear internal requirements, plans, and decisions for the delivery team.
  • Own program reporting for clients, covering progress, learner engagement and completion, risks, and next steps.
  • Track commitments against delivery, surface risk early, and manage escalations.
  • Drive process improvement and standards for private instructor-led deliveries and programs, turning recurring client feedback into repeatable playbooks.

Here's what you need

  • Minimum of 3 years of project and program management experience
  • Minimum of 1 years of experience working in ed tech, enterprise learning, or learning operations
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points If:

  • PMP certification
  • Familiarity with technical subject areas such as cloud, AI, data, or programming, enough to speak credibly with client technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with project management tools and a track record of using them.
  • Familiarity with online learning platforms, LMS systems, or enterprise training programs.

Professional Skills Requirements

  • Demonstrated comfort communicating with clients and senior stakeholders .
  • Builds trust with client stakeholders and maintains a professional, solutions-oriented relationship.
  • Communicates and influences across client stakeholders, internal teams, and leadership.
  • Proficient with AI tooling
  • Brings delivery and operational expertise into client conversations and advises with confidence on program design, sequencing, and tradeoffs.
  • Understands how instructor-led, on-demand, accelerator, and blended offerings work and fit together, and knows what each need to successfully launch to clients.
  • Drives delivery amid ambiguity and is comfortable unblocking without waiting for perfect clarity.
  • Anticipates slippage, stays organized, and is proactive.
  • Sees patterns behind repeated problems and helps fix them at the process level.

Join a leading pharmaceutical transformation program and play a key role in shaping complex non-SAP landscapes during large-scale carve-out, divestiture, and business transformation initiatives. We are seeking an experienced Non-SAP Architect with a strong background in the pharmaceutical/life sciences sector to lead application separation, integration, and customer development activities across global operations.

The Opportunity

As a Non-SAP Architect, you will be responsible for designing and delivering solutions across enterprise applications outside the SAP ecosystem while ensuring compliance with stringent pharmaceutical regulations and quality standards. You will work closely with business stakeholders, IT leadership, quality teams, and external partners to support strategic transformation and carve-out programs.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and govern the target architecture for non-SAP applications in a global pharmaceutical environment.
  • Lead non-SAP workstreams during carve-out, divestiture, merger, and acquisition projects.
  • Assess application dependencies and develop separation, migration, and transition strategies.
  • Design integrations between SAP and non-SAP platforms.
  • Support customer development initiatives, including custom applications, interfaces, reporting, and automation solutions.
  • Drive data migration, application rationalization, and system decommissioning activities.
  • Collaborate with Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and R&D functions.
  • Ensure compliance with GxP, CSV, Data Integrity, and cybersecurity requirements.

Required Experience
