Job Description


At Penguin Random House, our Publishing Operations division has experienced tremendous growth and is seeking an Inventory Operations Analyst to join our collaborative and dynamic Inventory Operations team!

With a focus on efficiencies and progress for the Inventory Management team, this role is data-focused, with strong communication, organizational, and analytical aspects. It is a key role within the Inventory Operations group with significant visibility and opportunity for growth.

As Inventory Analyst, you’ll be the Inventory Management point person on a variety of initiatives and a nexus between multiple teams and departments. You’ll be responsible for developing and maintaining operational best practices for the Inventory Management team and analyzing performance against established KPI’s. Additionally, this role will have an impact on strategic initiatives and daily operations critical to Publishing Operations at PRH.

Specific responsibilities include:

  • Development and support of ongoing cost-savings initiatives critical to the Inventory Management team and wider Publishing Operations group
  • Support of non-traditional inventory programs, including automated printing and print on demand
  • Daily management of titles at remote locations, including recently established UK warehouse, through local printing and transfer programs
  • Ownership of data flows from external vendors into Inventory maintained reports and dashboards
  • Development and maintenance of operational best practices for the Inventory Management team, including regular updates to sales and returns status, stock review and clean-up, and reporting against established KPIs
  • Special projects as needed

Qualifications


  • 1-2 years’ experience in data analysis or equivalent role
  • Excellent analytical skills; comfortability with numbers and data
  • Ability to proactively and creatively problem solve
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to work independently as well as part of a team
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel; PowerBI and SQL experience a plus but not required
  • No publishing experience required

The salary for this position is $70,500.  All positions are currently eligible for an annual profit award or bonus, subject to Company results.

Applications for this role will be accepted through November 16, 2026, or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. raw.excerpt: CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success.
raw.description:
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.
Visit our website at www.cleanspark.com.

Job Overview

The Senior Director, Data Center Design & Engineering – AI Data Centers serves as CleanSpark’s owner-side engineering authority, setting standards and technical direction for power, cooling, resilience, and facility performance from design through commissioning and operational handover. This role partners across teams to deliver reliable, buildable facilities and strengthen CleanSpark’s in-house engineering capabilities.

Reporting to the VP, Projects, the Senior Director provides technical leadership to the Director, Data Center Design, who manages external consultants and design deliverables. The Senior Director owns engineering standards, system architecture, and technical decisions, partnering with project and construction leadership on matters affecting cost, schedule, or contractual commitments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own and maintain CleanSpark’s AI data center engineering standards, Basis of Design (BoD), and design criteria across electrical, mechanical, civil, structural, controls, telecom, and site infrastructure disciplines
  • Define and approve system architecture for medium-voltage and low-voltage electrical distribution, generation and backup power, UPS, and mechanical cooling (air and liquid) for high-density AI/HPC loads, including redundancy and resilience targets (e.g., N, N+1, 2N) and associated trade-offs
  • Lead engineering interfaces with utilities and substation owners: load studies, interconnection requirements, substation and switchyard design, protection and coordination, metering, and energization sequencing in support of path-to-power planning
  • Provide technical direction to the Director, Data Center Design and external design consultants; review and approve technical studies, calculations, single-line diagrams, equipment selections, and design deliverables at each stage gate
  • Lead constructability, value engineering, and design-for-schedule reviews with Construction and Pre-Construction; resolve technical issues, RFIs, and design conflicts that exceed consultant or project-team authority
  • Own the owner-side commissioning program: define commissioning scope and levels, approve commissioning agents and test scripts, witness integrated systems testing, and sign off on energization and turnover readiness
  • Lead operational readiness from an engineering standpoint: handover documentation, as-builts, O&M requirements, spare parts and maintainability criteria, and alignment of design intent with Operations’ requirements
  • Evaluate and recommend equipment vendors, long-lead procurement specifications, and standard equipment platforms; support procurement with technical bid evaluations and scopes of work
  • Assess engineering risk across the portfolio; identify design, power, cooling, and integration risks early and drive mitigation into standards and project plans
  • Support tenant and customer technical requirements, including design review responses, change evaluations, and technical representation in customer and partner forums
  • Drive standardization and repeatability across sites so designs scale across the portfolio with predictable cost, schedule, and performance
  • Build and mentor the in-house engineering team; define roles, technical competencies, and development paths as the organization grows
  • Provide clear technical recommendations and updates to project and executive leadership

    • This role requires professionalism, respect, strong communication, and the ability to work well with others in a team-oriented, inclusive environment.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline
  • 15+ years of progressive experience in the design and engineering of data center, mission-critical, or large-scale power and industrial facilities, including at least 5 years in a senior technical leadership role
  • Deep working knowledge of data center electrical infrastructure (MV/LV distribution, generation, UPS, protection and coordination) and mechanical infrastructure (chilled water, air and liquid cooling, heat rejection) for high-density compute
  • Demonstrated experience defining redundancy and resilience topologies and translating availability targets into design criteria
  • Hands-on experience with utility interconnection, substation design, and energization planning for large loads
  • Experience leading commissioning (Levels 1–5 / integrated systems testing) and facility turnover on mission-critical projects
  • Proven ability to lead engineering consultants, contractors, and internal technical staff, and to make and defend technical decisions with executives, customers, and partners
  • Strong constructability judgment and experience partnering with construction teams through design, procurement, and field execution
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

  • Professional Engineer (PE) license strongly preferred
  • Experience with AI, HPC, or hyperscale data center design, including liquid-cooled and high-density rack deployments
  • Owner-side experience with a hyperscaler, colocation provider, or large infrastructure developer
  • Experience developing and governing engineering standards or Basis of Design programs across multiple sites
  • Familiarity with Uptime Institute Tier concepts, ASHRAE TC 9.9 guidelines, NEC/NFPA 70 and NFPA 70E, IEEE power system standards, and applicable energy codes
  • Master’s degree in engineering or an MBA
  • Experience in a fast-growth owner organization building in-house technical capability
This position may involve duties that require operation of a company vehicle or travel between job sites. As such, candidates must be insurable under CleanSpark's vehicle insurance policy.

Proven ability to successfully manage global projects

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned Engine recognition as TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), a spot on Inc.'s Power Partners list (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission

We value our individuality, and we also understand that together, we thrive. Most importantly, we know we're not for everyone! Complacency doesn't live here. We're focused on finding the right people who are energized by our culture and bring diverse experiences and backgrounds that will help us unlock our full potential.

Engine is redefining how businesses experience travel — and the strategic partnerships that power our growth are central to that mission. As Director, Strategic Partnerships, you will own our most consequential partnerships from first conversation through long-term scale. This is a full-cycle role: you source it, negotiate it, close it, and grow it. You will build deep executive relationships across the landscape, structure complex high-value deals, and ultimately build and lead a team beneath you as this vertical scales. If you thrive at the intersection of strategic thinking and relentless execution — and you want to build something that matters at a category-defining company — this is your role.

Here's What You'll Do

  • Full-Cycle Partnership Ownership: Own the end-to-end lifecycle for partnerships — from initial outreach and qualification through negotiation, close, onboarding, and long-term growth. You bring it in, you scale it.
  • Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and build a high-value pipeline of partnerships, each with the potential to reach $50M+ in annual volume. Manage a named account list, tier opportunities strategically, and self-source with creativity and urgency.
  • Executive-Level Negotiation: Lead complex, multi-stakeholder deal negotiations with C-suite and VP-level decision-makers at industrials organizations. Craft compelling partnership structures that drive durable mutual value.
  • Vertical Expertise & Market Intelligence: Develop and maintain deep knowledge of the landscape — key players, buying dynamics, competitive forces, regulatory considerations, and partnership models that unlock distribution or revenue at scale.
  • Post-Close Relationship Leadership: Serve as Engine's primary executive relationship owner for the largest partners post-close. You decide which accounts to retain and which to pass onto the partner success organization. Drive retention, expansion, and partner satisfaction across your portfolio.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Product, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Finance to craft tailored proposals, support partner onboarding, and ensure Engine's platform capabilities match industrial partner needs.
  • Industry Representation: Represent Engine at relevant conferences, industry events, and executive forums. Build Engine's brand and credibility in the market.
  • Pipeline Rigor & Forecasting: Maintain a well-organized, accurate pipeline in Salesforce. Forecast clearly, communicate progress to leadership, and leverage AI & sales tools to drive efficiency.
  • Team Building: As the vertical matures and scales, recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing BD team beneath you. You're not just a dealmaker — you're building a business within a business.

What You'll Bring to Engine

  • Expertise: 10+ years of strategic BD, partnerships, or enterprise sales experience with a Deep network and established credibility within the industrials ecosystem.
  • Partnership Track Record: Proven history of sourcing, structuring, and closing complex B2B partnerships at significant scale — not just transactional deals. You've managed high-value portfolios and know what it takes to win and keep strategic accounts.
  • Executive Presence: Strong executive presence with the ability to navigate complex organizations, build trust with senior stakeholders, and lead high-stakes conversations at the C-suite level.
  • Builder's Mindset: You create the playbook as you go. You thrive in environments without a defined script, identify the right path forward independently, and turn ambiguity into momentum.
  • Leadership Orientation: Experience building, managing, or mentoring BD or sales teams — and a genuine drive to scale a high-performing team as this vertical grows.
  • Commercial Acumen: Ability to model and communicate the commercial value of complex deals. Comfortable with deal economics, partnership structures, and cross-functional alignment on contract terms.
  • Industry Bonus: Experience in travel, fintech, SaaS, or marketplace platforms is a strong plus. Familiarity with the corporate travel ecosystem is an advantage.

Applications for this role will be accepted through January 20, 2027 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$195,000—$230,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

Overview

Multi-Line Claim AdjusterLocation: RemoteSchedule: Core business hoursSalary Range: $75,000 - $85,000

Build Your Career With Purpose at CCMSI

At CCMSI, we partner with global clients to solve their most complex risk management challenges, delivering measurable results through advanced technology, collaborative problem-solving, and an unwavering commitment to their success. We don’t just process claims—we support people. As the largest privately-owned Third Party Administrator (TPA), CCMSI delivers customized claim solutions that help our clients protect their employees, assets, and reputations. We are a certified Great Place to Work®, and our employee-owners are empowered to grow, collaborate, and make meaningful contributions every day. Job Summary The Multi-Line Claim Consultant position is responsible for the investigation, evaluation, negotiation, and resolution of premises liability, product liability, auto liability, bodily injury, and property damage claims, including litigated matters. The position requires the ability to evaluate liability, assess injury and damages exposure, manage defense counsel, negotiate settlements, establish appropriate reserves, and effectively communicate with clients and stakeholders throughout the claim lifecycle.

Responsibilities

  • Investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex commercial liability claims from assignment through closure.
  • Analyze coverage, determine liability, establish appropriate reserves, and evaluate damages exposure.
  • Manage litigated claims, including oversight of defense counsel and review of litigation strategy.
  • Negotiate settlements within authority and recommend resolutions on higher-exposure matters.
  • Maintain timely and accurate claim documentation, action plans, and client reporting.
  • Communicate effectively with clients, claimants, attorneys, vendors, and other stakeholders.
  • Identify and escalate claim trends, exposure concerns, and coverage issues as appropriate.
  • Deliver responsive service while maintaining quality, compliance, and claim handling standards.

Qualifications

Required:
  • Minimum 5 years of experience handling commercial liability claims with bodily injury exposure.
  • Experience independently handling premises liability claims from inception through resolution.
  • Experience handling auto liability claims involving bodily injury exposures.
  • Experience managing litigated liability claims.
  • Demonstrated ability to investigate, evaluate, negotiate, and resolve complex liability claims.
  • Experience establishing reserves, assessing liability, evaluating damages, and managing claim outcomes.
  • Active adjuster's license required.
  • Strong written, verbal, and client communication skills.
Nice to Have:
  • Experience handling complex commercial casualty claims and coverage issues.
  • Experience working within a Third Party Administrator (TPA), insurance carrier, or self-insured program environment.
  • New York adjuster's license.
  • Experience supporting high-profile national accounts with significant communication and reporting expectations.
Bilingual (Spanish) proficiency — highly valued for communicating with claimants, employers, or vendors, but not required.How We Measure SuccessSuccess in this role is measured through effective claim resolution, accurate liability and damages evaluation, sound reserve management, timely claim handling, quality file documentation, litigation management performance, client satisfaction, and consistent adherence to CCMSI claim handling standards.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • 4 weeks (Paid time off that accrues throughout the year in accordance with company policy) + 10 paid holidays in your first year
  • Comprehensive benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
  • Retirement plans: 401(k) and Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP)
  • Career growth: Internal training and advancement opportunities
  • Culture: A supportive, team-based work environment
This is where we shine, and we hire adjusters who want to shine with us.

Compensation & Compliance

The posted salary reflects CCMSI’s good-faith estimate in accordance with applicable pay transparency laws. Actual compensation will be based on qualifications, experience, geographic location, and internal equity. This role may also qualify for bonuses or additional forms of pay.CCMSI offers comprehensive benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance. Our Core Values

At CCMSI, we believe in doing what’s right—for our clients, our coworkers, and ourselves. We look for team members who:
  • Lead with transparency We build trust by being open and listening intently in every interaction.
  • Perform with integrity We choose the right path, even when it is hard.
  • Chase excellence We set the bar high and measure our success. What gets measured gets done.

raw.description:
JoinphData, a remote-first data and AI consultancy company with employees across the United States, Latin America, and India. We partner with industry leaders, including Snowflake, AWS, Anthropic, Glean, and dbt, to solve the complex data and AI challenges that slow large enterprises.

We're growing fast, and we give our people real ownership over their work. We hire top performers and trust them to deliver results.

Why phData?

  • Snowflake Implementation Partner of the Year — 7 consecutive years, and 2026 Snowflake AI Partner of the Year
  • AWS Premier Tier Services Partner — the highest tier of recognition in the AWS Partner Network
  • 2025 Fivetran Partner of the Year (4th consecutive year)
  • 2025 dbt Labs Partner of the Year (3x winner) with Visionary partner status
  • 2026 KNIME Customer Excellence Partner of the Year
  • Preferred Partner in the Anthropic Claude Partner Network
  • #1 Partner in Snowflake Advanced Certifications
  • 600+ Expert Cloud Certifications (Sigma, AWS, Azure, Dataiku, and more)
  • Recognized as an award-winning workplace in the US, India and LATAM

About the Role

Snowflake is the partnership that built phData's reputation, and you will help lead it, working hand in hand with a dedicated commercial leader and a services leader who co-own the relationship. When we show up in front of Snowflake's customers and sellers, we carry their product, brand, and reputation with us, and every interaction is a chance to strengthen the trust we have built together. You'll turn what matters most to Snowflake- the priorities that create real value for their business and their customers- into a go-to-market plan we can execute, while holding our own revenue and budget to account. You'll do it through cross-functional collaboration with our sales, solutions, and revenue leaders, as well as their counterparts at Snowflake. If the relationship goes stale, or we make a commitment we can't keep, that lands on you.

You are strengthening a partnership that is already one of the most decorated in Snowflake's ecosystem, and the job is to help it evolve to the next level by continuously pursuing value for both Snowflake and phData. Seven straight years of recognition is the foundation, and the next chapter is yours to help write.

The Partnership You'll Lead

  • 7x Snowflake Partner of the Year, including 2026 Global Snowflake Services AI Partner of the Year and 2026 AMER Snowflake Services Implementation Partner of the Year, announced at Snowflake Summit 2026.
  • Snowflake Elite Services Partner, the highest services tier Snowflake awards.
  • #1 partner in advanced Snowflake certifications, with 367+ SnowPro Core and 139+ SnowPro Advanced certifications.
  • 300+ Snowflake projects delivered, with roughly 497 tracked use cases in production.
  • Elite across the modern data stack: one of only two partners at the elite level with Snowflake, Fivetran, and dbt.
  • A Strategic Collaboration Agreement with Snowflake built around executive AI workshops, mutually invested offerings, and a focused set of priority engagements.
  • An AIM launch partner, delivering Cortex Code-first migrations with our own Toolkit and Forge accelerators.

About You

Read this section like a mirror, not a checklist. Some of it is meant to make you nod. Some of it is meant to make you uncomfortable. Both reactions are useful, to you and to us.

  • You've been accountable for a revenue or consumption number you didn't control. Sellers on another team owned the quota and the deals, yet you were still held accountable for the results.
  • You've inherited a partnership that was already winning, and you refused to coast on it.
  • You've told a partner executive no, and the relationship came out stronger.
  • You've told your own CEO or CRO that a commitment wouldn't be met before they heard it from the partner.
  • You listen longer than is comfortable, then say it in one sentence. Your partner's priorities, and ours, fit on a page you can write and say out loud.
  • You treat a tier requirement or a funding commitment as a promise, not a target to negotiate down. You track it every month, not only when the QBR is coming.
  • You know who the right person is on each side before the problem arrives. You build the enterprise-to-enterprise network in advance, so you don't scramble to do so during an escalation.
  • You've led a small team through a partner program while peers in other orgs held the levers you needed, and you got it done through influence.

If none of that landed, this probably isn't your role, and that's fine. If more than a couple did, keep reading.

What You'll Own

Overview

Apogee is seeking a Senior Systems Engineer to be located remotely or in Omaha, NE, in support of the Air Force Life Cycle Management Center (AFLCMC) Weather Systems Branch (AFLCMC/ESAW) Numerical Weather Modeling (NWM) program.

This position will provide Systems Engineering support to the NWM program, directly supporting the planning, procurement, testing, implementation, operations, and sustainment of Information Technology (IT) components and systems to support data ingest, numerical models, and dissemination of products to the AF Weather Enterprise. As our program office transitions to the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), this role will play an integral part in aligning engineering practices, backlog management, and collaborative cross-functional workflows using the Atlassian tool suite (Jira and Confluence).

This is a full-time position and can be fully remote.

Responsibilities

Agile & SAFe Transformation:

  • Support the NWM team’s adoption of the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), participating in Program Increment (PI) planning, sprint iterations, backlog grooming, and Agile Release Train (ART) syncs.
  • Facilitate and streamline tracking, reporting, and lifecycle traceability using Atlassian Jira and Confluence.

Systems Analysis & Engineering:

  • Perform system analysis and develop comprehensive system specifications.
  • Provide technical reviews of design and development specifications of software applications, systems, and other engineering artifacts; develop and maintain these artifacts throughout the systems engineering lifecycle.
  • Assess technical and architectural changes for impact to IPT-specific software, other command-level systems, and the broader enterprise.
  • Integrate user community requirements and desired operational capabilities into requirements/capability generation and planning documents.
  • Provide analyses of interface requirements for applications based on recommendations from modernization initiatives.

Software Testing, Integration, & Delivery:

  • Support the certification, maintenance, and testing of software applications as well as the integration of complex software systems, providing status, risk analyses, and actionable recommendations.
  • Support the delivery of software, installation, configuration, testing, problem resolution, and maintenance procedures/timelines required to achieve approval to test and promote software to production environments.
  • Support the development, analysis, and implementation of an Agile DevOps, CI/CD model of software development, integration, and deployment; Cloud technologies; and microservice architectures.

Governance, Standards, & Acquisition:

  • Advise the Government to ensure compliance with applicable engineering and configuration management directives; participate in developing new standards and improving existing processes.
  • Use approved processes (e.g., Systems Engineering Plan (SEP)) and prepare technical and briefing materials for program management reviews and technical milestones.
  • Support the Security Technical Implementation Guide (STIG) process for placing new software deliveries into production, assisting in the security evaluation of program information and hardware.
  • Assist in reviewing or proposing inputs to Requests for Proposal (RFP) artifacts, Acquisition Plans, Life Cycle Management Plans (LCMP), and Acquisition Strategies.
  • Provide direct systems engineering support to the NWM program, collaborating closely with the PM, Financial Manager (FM), and Program Lead Engineer.

Qualifications

Citizenship: Must be a US citizen Clearance: Must possess and maintain a Secret clearance

Possess one of the following education/experience combinations:

  • Advanced Degree (MA/MS) and a minimum 10+ years of years of relevant experience (12+ years preferred), 5 years of which must be in the DoD
  • OR, BA/BS degree and a minimum of 12+ years of relevant experience (15 years preferred), 5 years of which must be in the DoD
  • OR, 18+ years of relevant experience (20 years preferred), 8 years of which must be in the DoD

Preferred Qualifications:

Certifications:

  • Current Atlassian Certification (e.g., Atlassian Certified Associate/Professional in Jira or Confluence) is highly desired.
  • Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) certification (e.g., Certified SAFe Agilist, SAFe Practitioner, or SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager) is strongly preferred.

raw.description:
Principal Forward Deployed Engineer

DryvIQ | Nasuni

Location: Hyderabad, India | Remote (Hyderabad preferred)
Department: Customer Experience / Professional Services
Working Hours: US Eastern business hours (9 a.m.–5 p.m. ET) (7:30pm IST to 3:30am IST)

Role Overview

Be the engineer customers trust to solve their most complex enterprise data challenges—and build solutions that scale beyond a single deployment.

As a Principal Forward Deployed Engineer at DryvIQ, part of Nasuni, you will provide hands-on technical leadership across complex enterprise customer implementations. You'll work directly with customers to understand their challenges, design scalable solutions, write production-quality C#/.NET code, and guide secure deployments through successful operation.

Enterprises need to discover, classify, protect, and govern growing volumes of unstructured content before they can confidently activate that information for AI. DryvIQ helps organizations manage these challenges across cloud and on-premises repositories.

We're looking for an experienced engineer who combines deep software development expertise with sound architectural judgment, customer consulting skills, and the ability to influence technical outcomes across multiple engagements.

This is a hands-on engineering and customer-delivery role, not a pre-sales-only or purely advisory position.

Your Scope and Impact

You will establish technical direction for complex, high-impact customer solutions while developing reusable engineering approaches that improve delivery across engagements.

You'll independently navigate difficult architecture decisions, guide senior technical contributors, resolve critical implementation challenges, and influence product improvements through insights gained from customer environments.

Your success will be measured through production outcomes, customer confidence, engineering quality, and the broader impact of the solutions and standards you establish.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical architecture and implementation across complex enterprise customer engagements, from discovery through validation, and production handoff.

  • Facilitate customer workshops with IT, security, and business stakeholders; translate requirements into scalable solution designs, implementation plans, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design, develop, test, and troubleshoot C#/.NET integrations, REST APIs, services, and supported workflows across Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes environments.

  • Establish reusable integration, testing, security, and troubleshooting patterns that improve reliability and delivery consistency.

  • Guide complex technical decisions involving supported configuration, customization, integrations, platform limitations, and long-term maintainability.

  • Architect and optimize solutions for enterprise content discovery, classification, lifecycle management, governance, migration, and policy-driven automation.

  • Lead resolution of critical issues involving connectors, authentication, permissions, distributed processing, performance, and environments.

  • Establish validation approaches for content classification, including representative sampling, precision and recall, false-positive and false-negative analysis, and business-owner review.

  • Partner with Professional Services, Project Management, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to assess delivery risks, guide technical estimates, and identify product improvements.

  • Mentor engineers, review complex designs and code, and share technical knowledge that raises delivery standards across teams.

  • Develop and promote responsible AI-assisted workflows for engineering, testing, troubleshooting, and technical analysis, with appropriate security controls and human validation.

Expected Outcomes and Impact

  • Successful, secure, and supportable production environments that meet agreed customer acceptance criteria.

  • Reduced implementation complexity and faster resolution of recurring technical issues.

  • Reusable engineering assets that improve delivery consistency and shorten time to customer value.

  • Improved solution reliability, classification quality, and production readiness.

  • Stronger alignment between customer implementation needs and Nasuni's product capabilities.

What You'll Bring

Must-Have Qualifications

  • Deep hands-on C#/.NET engineering experience, including modern .NET (.NET 8 or later), REST API development, integration design, and production troubleshooting.

  • Demonstrated technical ownership of complex enterprise software implementations, including architecture, coding, testing, and operational support.

  • Production experience with Linux, Docker, and Kubernetes or comparable container orchestration environments.

  • Ability to make and explain architectural tradeoffs involving scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.

  • Experience resolving complex integration or production issues across multiple systems and stakeholders.

  • Strong customer-facing technical communication, documentation, problem-solving, and collaborative leadership skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with enterprise content management, information governance, content classification, or large-scale data migration.

  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint, OneDrive, Purview, or other enterprise content repositories.

  • Experience with hybrid cloud architectures, distributed workloads, and large-scale file processing.

  • PowerShell or Python automation experience.

  • Practical use of AI-assisted engineering tools with clear methods for validating generated code, analysis, and recommendations.

Ideal Candidate Differentiators

  • Has established reusable technical architectures or engineering standards across multiple customer implementations.

  • Demonstrates measurable improvements in deployment reliability, customer outcomes, or implementation efficiency.

  • Has influenced engineering or product priorities through recurring enterprise customer challenges.

  • Builds the capabilities of other engineers while remaining an effective hands-on contributor.

  • Has developed repeatable, responsibly governed AI-assisted engineering workflows.

Experience Guidelines

Typically 9–12 years of relevant software engineering, enterprise implementation, or technical consulting experience, including substantial hands-on customer-facing delivery and demonstrated technical leadership across complex engagements.

Equivalent experience demonstrating comparable ownership, technical depth, and results is welcome. Prior DryvIQ experience is not required.

AI at Nasuni

AI is used to improve efficiency, decision-making, and engineering outcomes across Nasuni. In this position, you'll apply AI-assisted development, analysis, testing, and automation where they add value, while ensuring that outputs meet security, correctness, quality, and maintainability standards.

We value engineers who use AI with context, sound judgment, validation, and accountability.

Location and Working Model

This position is remote within India, with a preference for candidates based near Hyderabad.

Regular collaboration with global teams and US customers during US Eastern business hours is required. Local working hours vary with US daylight saving time. Periodic customer-site travel to the United States is expected.

About Nasuni

Nasuni is the unstructured data foundation for enterprise teams—and the AI that supports them. We manage, protect, and activate the world's unstructured data so organizations can work smarter, spend wisely, and create safely without limits.

As a Vista Equity Partners-backed SaaS data infrastructure company, Nasuni is transforming how enterprises manage file data with a next-generation, AI-ready platform.

Our cloud-native technology combines enterprise file services, protection, and data intelligence, enabling organizations to unify information, strengthen security, simplify infrastructure, and activate trusted data for AI.

With DryvIQ's content intelligence and governance capabilities, we're expanding how enterprises discover, classify, protect, and manage information across complex environments.

Why Work at Nasuni

Join a global team working at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, software engineering, enterprise data governance, and AI readiness.

You'll have the opportunity to solve meaningful technical challenges for enterprise customers, influence how complex implementations are delivered, and build solutions that improve outcomes beyond individual engagements.

Our Hyderabad Innovation Center connects talented engineers with global Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience teams. Through Vista Equity Partners' software ecosystem, Nasuni employees can benefit from cross-company learning, professional development, and opportunities to explore AI-driven innovation.

We value collaboration, accountability, technical curiosity, and continuous improvement. At Nasuni, your work can directly contribute to making enterprise data more accessible, secure, and useful for teams and the AI that supports them.

This privacy notice relates to information collected (whether online or offline) by Nasuni Corporation and our corporate affiliates (collectively, “Nasuni”) from or about you in your capacity as a Nasuni employee, independent contractor/service provider or as an applicant for an employment or contractor relationship with Nasuni.

raw.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.

This is a dual-mandate role that pairs strategic account ownership with deep Workforce Management (WFM) domain expertise. As a Client Advisor, you own the post-sale relationship, adoption, retention and growth of a portfolio of strategic accounts. As TTEC Digital’s WFM domain expert in-region, you are the go-to authority whenever a client is implementing, optimising or scaling a workforce management capability. You may carry profit-and-loss (P&L) accountability for the portfolio and take on leadership in aspects of larger and multiple concurrent client engagements and projects — interpreting complex client business issues and recommending best-practice solutions beyond WFM alone.

This is a remote role for someone based in Australia, Sydney or Melbourne, reporting to the Director, Client Service Desk with some domestic travel to metro and interstate client sites.

TTEC Digital is a leading global customer experience (CX) consulting and technology services firm. This role brings together two capabilities the business is scaling in Australia — trusted-advisor customer success and specialist WFM knowledge — so that our most important clients get both a single accountable relationship owner and credible, hands-on WFM leadership

What you will be doing

    1. Customer Success & Strategic Account Leadership

    • Own the portfolio. Act as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor across key strategic accounts, accountable for satisfaction, retention, renewal and growth.
    • Drive value realisation. Build and maintain account success plans mapped to each client’s business outcomes and CX objectives, and demonstrate measurable value against them.
    • Run the cadence. Lead regular business reviews (QBRs), maintain account health scores, and proactively surface risks and opportunities before they escalate.
    • Grow the relationship. Partner with sales and pre-sales to identify and progress renewal, expansion and cross-sell opportunities within the portfolio. Lead the negotiation of strategy, scope and statements of work with senior and executive client stakeholders.
    • Orchestrate delivery. Coordinate managed-services, delivery and support teams to ensure SLA commitments are met and clients realise the outcomes they were sold.
    • Own escalations. Serve as the senior escalation point for client issues, driving timely resolution and protecting CSAT / NPS.
    • Lead within engagements. Take on leadership in aspects of larger and multiple concurrent client engagements and workstreams, working independently with little or no day-to-day guidance and owning quality and delivery outcomes.
    • Own the commercials. Hold profit-and-loss (P&L) accountability for the portfolio — managing engagement economics, margin and commercial governance to the parameters defined in each engagement agreement.

    2. Workforce Management (WFM) Domain Expertise

    • Be the WFM SME. Act as the recognised WFM subject-matter expert for the Australian client base — the person delivery, pre-sales and clients turn to for any workforce management need.
    • Lead on implementations. Provide domain leadership across the WFM lifecycle: forecasting, scheduling, intraday management, adherence, capacity planning, shrinkage and reporting.
    • Advise across platforms. Guide clients on WFM best practice across leading platforms including Genesys, Calabrio, NICE and Verint.
    • Shape solutions. Support pre-sales and delivery with WFM scoping, requirements gathering, configuration guidance and solution design.
    • Translate operations to configuration. Convert contact-centre operational needs into practical WFM process design, configuration and ways of working.
    • Enable and transfer knowledge. Lead WFM workshops, enablement sessions and knowledge transfer for both clients and internal teams.
    • Stay ahead. Track WFM platform roadmaps and emerging capabilities (e.g. AI-assisted forecasting and omnichannel scheduling) and bring that thinking to clients.

    3. Collaboration & Practice Building

    • Work across the business. Partner closely with Client Advisory, Managed Services, Pre-Sales and Delivery to join up the client experience.
    • Build reusable capability. Lead the development of TTEC Digital’s WFM practice — playbooks, accelerators and reusable assets that scale expertise beyond one person.
    • Uplift the team. Mentor and upskill account and delivery colleagues on WFM fundamentals.

Skills and experience you will bring

    • 8+ years in customer success, account management or client advisory within CX, contact centre, SaaS or managed-services environments, including demonstrable experience leading aspects of client engagements or projects.
    • Degree qualified, with a post-graduate or advanced degree desired.
    • Demonstrable, hands-on Workforce Management expertise — as a WFM practitioner (analyst / planner / RTA) and/or implementing or configuring WFM platforms.
    • Working knowledge of one or more leading WFM platforms (Genesys, Calabrio, NICE or Verint).
    • Strong understanding of contact-centre operations and the metrics that matter (service level, occupancy, shrinkage, adherence, AHT).
    • Excellent stakeholder management, including credibility with senior and executive client contacts.
    • Demonstrated experience leading aspects of projects and/or managing multiple concurrent client engagements, with commercial or profit-and-loss (P&L) exposure.
    • Based in Australia with current rights to work, and able to travel domestically to client sites as needed.

    Preferred skills and experience:

    • Experience across more than one WFM vendor / platform.
    • Background in a CX consulting, technology-services or BPO / outsourced contact-centre environment.
    • Relevant platform certifications (e.g. Genesys, Calabrio, NICE, Verint).
    • Familiarity with cloud contact-centre platforms (e.g. Genesys Cloud, Amazon Connect, NICE CXone, Microsoft).
    • Project or change-management exposure supporting WFM rollouts.

raw.description:
About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.
Requisition #: 2001
Job Title: Security Engineer
Location: Remote
Clearance Level: Ability to Obtain and Maintain a Public Trust Clearance

Job Description

    SUMMARYWe are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Security Engineer to support and enhance our cybersecurity operations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining security solutions that protect enterprise systems, applications, networks, and data. This role requires a strong technical background, a proactive approach to problem-solving, and a commitment to supporting mission and customer objectives.

    JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • A Security Engineer is responsible for designing, implementing, maintaining, and improving security solutions that protect an organization's systems, networks, applications, and data from cyber threats.
  • This role involves monitoring security tools and alerts, conducting vulnerability assessments, supporting incident response and remediation efforts, implementing security controls, and ensuring compliance with organizational and regulatory requirements.
  • Security Engineers collaborate closely with SOC analysts, system administrators, developers, and stakeholders to identify risks, strengthen security posture, and support mission objectives.
  • They also develop security documentation, support audits and assessments, analyze emerging threats, recommend process improvements, and stay current on evolving cybersecurity trends and technologies to enhance operational effectiveness and reduce organizational risk

Education and Years of Experience

  • Bachelors Degree, 7 years of experience

Required Skills

  • Engineering, deploying, and sustaining the enterprise network security infrastructure-next-generation firewalls, SASE/ZTNA, and SD-WAN-to ensure availability, performance, and a defensible security posture.
  • Operating and maintaining defensive platforms day-to-day, including configuration management, policy tuning, software/firmware lifecycle and patching, capacity planning, and health monitoring.
  • Leading engineering projects end-to-end-requirements, design, testing, and implementation-for new and upgraded capabilities such as SASE/ZTNA and SD-WAN across enterprise and hybrid (on-premises and cloud) environments.
  • Developing and maintaining secure configuration baselines, standard operating procedures, and engineering documentation, and automating repeatable configuration and operational tasks to improve consistency and reduce manual effort.
  • Translating threat intelligence and detection findings into infrastructure-level defensive improvements-firewall policy, segmentation, access control, and traffic inspection-to harden the environment against current adversary tactics.
  • Collaborating with the SOC, logging and observability, and network operations teams, and with product vendors, to integrate capabilities, resolve issues, and align infrastructure with operational and mission requirements.
  • Operating and supporting intrusion detection sensor infrastructure to ensure reliable security telemetry delivery to the SOC and logging/observability teams.
  • Identifying gaps in defensive coverage, resilience, and operational processes; recommending and implementing improvements; and providing technical input to architecture and roadmap decisions.

Preferred Skills

  • Security Engineering Certifications
In addition, Agile Defense invests in its employees beyond just compensation. Agile’s benefits offerings include, dependent upon position, Health Insurance, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, Holiday Pay, short-term and long-term Disability, Retirement and Learning and Development opportunities as well as other optional benefit elections.

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
  • Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
  • Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.

  • Hungry - Be Eager.Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.

raw.excerpt: Why Mozilla? Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years.
raw.description:
Why Mozilla?

Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people.

The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.

About the OS Integration team:

The OS Integration team ensures Firefox works well with the host operating system and environment. We’re a distributed team with expertise in Windows, macOS, and Linux-based operating systems. Our responsibilities include developing fixes and improvements for Firefox related to Windows, macOS, and Linux environments. This might include integration with a new OS feature or fixing an OS-specific user interface bug. Other responsibilities include native crash reporting, OS abstraction layers, sandboxing, hardening, updater, and enterprise DLP support.

About the role:

As a member of the OS Integration team, you’ll develop fixes, improvements, and new features for Firefox. In many cases work may be cross-platform or have a cross-platform component. This role will include maintenance and development of the installer and updater of Firefox. You’ll contribute to the team through code review and discussion.

What you’ll do:

  • Improve the quality of Firefox and other Mozilla products by debugging and fixing software defects, improving the browsing experience for hundreds of millions of users.
  • Contribute to new features and improvements.
  • Break down tasks and work with others to deliver solutions.
  • Collaborate with experienced software engineers.
  • Perform code reviews and provide technical direction.
  • Work with a geographically-distributed development team.
  • Interact with teams throughout the organization.

What you’ll bring:

  • 5+ years of overall software engineering experience
  • Strong knowledge of C and C++
  • Experience with desktop application development on Windows, macOS, or Linux with C++.
  • Knowledge of web technologies such as Javascript and HTML.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and memory safety concerns.
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills.
  • Written and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset.
  • Willingness to work effectively in a distributed team environment.
  • Commitment to our values:
    • Play to win
    • Build for People first
    • Engage Evidence over Ego
    • Decide and Deliver
    • Ship, learn and repeat

Bonus Points for experience with:

  • Installer and/or Updater development on any OS
  • Windows internals like the BITS server or MSIX packages
  • Open-source contributions or personal engineering projects

What you’ll get:

  • Generous performance-based bonus plans to all eligible employees - we share in our success as one team
  • Rich medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Generous retirement contributions with 100% immediate vesting (regardless of whether you contribute)
  • Quarterly all-company wellness days where everyone takes a pause together
  • Country specific holidays plus a day off for your birthday
  • One-time home office stipend
  • Annual professional development budget
  • Considerable paid parental leave
  • Employee referral bonus program
  • Other benefits (life/AD&D, disability, EAP, etc. - varies by country)

About Mozilla

Mozilla exists to build the Internet as a public resource accessible to all because we believe that open and free is better than closed and controlled. When you work at Mozilla, you give yourself a chance to make a difference in the lives of Web users everywhere. And you give us a chance to make a difference in your life every single day. Join us to work on the Web as the platform and help create more opportunity and innovation for everyone online.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

Mozilla understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge are crucial to and enrich the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, persons with disabilities, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities, and expressions.

We will ensure that qualified individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, as appropriate. Please contact us at to request accommodation.

raw.title: Partner Marketing Programs Manager
raw.excerpt: About Versapay 🚀Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.
raw.description:
About Versapay 🚀

Versapay is the platform that rewires AR by removing barriers from collecting and reconciling B2B payments, providing end-to-end cash flow clarity and ensuring businesses can manage working capital on their terms.
By closing the loop for finance teams and their business systems, customers, and payment activity into a single intelligent ecosystem, Versapay transforms money matters into a data-driven advantage. With 10,000 customers and 5M+ companies transacting, Versapay facilitates 110M+ transactions and processes $300B+ in payments volume annually.
Think you might be the next Veep to join? Read on!!
The Opportunity

Partners are an important part of how Versapay reaches the market. Our ERP/VAR, ISV, and Financial Institution partners help us reach new customers, create new routes to market, and drive pipelines.

We're looking for a Partner Marketing Programs Manager to help us get more out of these relationships.

This role sits within Partner Marketing and will help turn partner strategy into marketing programs that partners can use. You'll work across our partner channels to build campaigns, create partner-ready content and enablement, support partner events, and help launch programs that generate demand.

The role will also provide marketing support for select programs outside of Partner Marketing, particularly webinars and other pipeline-focused initiatives.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys taking an idea and figuring out how to make it happen.

The Role

    The Partner Marketing Programs Manager will work closely with Partner Marketing, Partner Sales, Events, Demand Generation, Content, Product Marketing, and other teams across Versapay.

    You'll help build and execute programs across our ERP/VAR, ISV, and Financial Institution channels, while also supporting the marketing activation around key partner events and broader marketing programs.

    The role is intentionally broad, but the focus is consistent: create scalable marketing programs and assets that help our partners and internal teams generate pipeline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner Marketing Programs: Build and execute marketing programs for our ERP/VAR, ISV, and Financial Institution partners, including campaigns, partner communications, campaign-in-a-box programs, and other demand generation initiatives.
  • Partner Content: Create and adapt content for specific partners and audiences, including emails, landing pages, one-pagers, presentations, sales materials, and campaign assets.
  • Partner Enablement: Develop materials that help our partners understand and sell Versapay, including partner decks, solution overviews, battlecards, playbooks, talking points, and campaign-specific enablement.
  • FI Sales Training & Product Knowledge: Work closely with Partner Sales and Product Marketing to build and maintain sales training and product education for Financial Institution partners. Translate Versapay product capabilities, positioning, use cases, and updates into clear, practical training that helps FI partner teams confidently identify opportunities, explain the value of Versapay, and support effective customer conversations.
  • FI Enablement Support: Provide focused support to Financial Institution partners in two critical areas: strengthening sales readiness through repeatable training, and improving product knowledge through current, easy-to-use materials and access to the right internal subject-matter experts.
  • Partner Events: Run the marketing execution around key partner events, including Microsoft, NetSuite, Sage, and other strategic ecosystem events. This includes event promotion, landing pages, email campaigns, partner communications, speaker support, collateral, and post-event follow-up.
  • Webinars & Marketing Programs: Run webinars and other marketing programs that contribute to pipelines across the broader business. This may include program development, promotion, content, execution, and follow-up.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Work with Partner Sales, Events, Demand Generation, Content, Product Marketing, and other teams to bring programs to life and keep projects moving.
  • Program Scalability: Look for ways to turn one-off partner requests and programs into repeatable plays that can be used across multiple partners and channels.
  • Measurement: Track program performance and use results to improve future campaigns and partner activation.

Qualifications

  • 3–6+ years of experience in B2B marketing, partner marketing, field marketing, demand generation, or a related role.
  • Experience building and executing marketing programs from planning through launch.
  • Strong writing and content development skills, with the ability to adapt messaging for different audiences.
  • Experience creating marketing materials such as presentations, one-pagers, campaign assets, emails, and landing pages.
  • Experience developing sales training, product education, or enablement materials that help partner-facing teams communicate product value and use cases.
  • Ability to learn product capabilities and positioning quickly, work with subject-matter experts, and translate technical information into practical partner-facing guidance.
  • Comfortable working across multiple teams and managing several programs at once.
  • Strong project management skills and a bias toward getting things done.
  • Experience working with channel, partner, field, or ecosystem marketing is a plus.
  • Experience supporting Financial Institution partners, or working in banking, fintech, payments, ERP, or enterprise technology, is a plus.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment where priorities can change, and you're expected to figure things out along the way.

Why This Role Matters

    Partners are a significant growth channel for Versapay, and we're investing in the programs and resources that help them succeed.

    This role will help us move faster by giving our partner teams more marketing support, our partners more resources to take to market, and our broader marketing organization additional capacity to execute high-impact programs.

    For our Financial Institution partners in particular, this role will strengthen the sales training and product knowledge they need to represent Versapay effectively, engage customers with confidence, and create more consistent pipeline opportunities.

    It's an opportunity to work across a wide variety of businesses while developing deep experience in partner marketing, demand generation, enablement, and events.

raw.description:
Graphic and Information Designer (Asia-based, Remote, Full-time)

The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA) is seeking a Graphic & Information Designer to join our dynamic team in Asia to create high-quality, engaging, and interactive content that supports our research and communications work.

The Graphic & Information Designer will be a creative and analytical professional with strong design capabilities and a solid understanding of digital marketing and audience engagement. They will have a proven ability to translate complex technical and financial data into clear, visually compelling, and platform-optimized content that supports IEEFA’s research, communications, and impact. They will work closely with research analysts and communications professionals to ensure insights are presented in a clear, accessible, and impactful way across reports, presentations, media, and digital channels.

We are looking for a self-motivated multitasker who can work independently without continuous supervision. Working as part of a remote team in Asia, the ideal candidate will be expected to be able to communicate effectively with other members of the team over a variety of mediums (Zoom, G-suite, ClickUp, etc.), be comfortable with raising issues or questions along the way, and provide insights into their work.

The Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis (IEEFA) is a global NGO/non-profit think tank that produces a significant volume of original independent public interest research and analysis on issues related to sustainable energy markets, trends, regulations, and policies. Our mission, major research reports, daily commentaries, press coverage, and other resources can be found on our website:

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Create clear, compelling data visualizations, including charts, graphs, infographics, and hero visuals that turn complex technical and financial findings into accessible visual outputs
  • Design and format reports, briefing notes, fact sheets, and presentations in InDesign and Word, delivering polished, near-publication-ready drafts that need minimal revision
  • Collaborate with IEEFA analysts and the communications team to identify key insights from research, and proactively advise on how layouts, data, and findings are best presented visually
  • Develop templates and design assets for social media, newsletters, and other formats
  • Manage the design, layout, and distribution of email newsletters using HubSpot and Canva with attention to audience engagement and performance
  • Produce engaging digital content, including social media carousels, short-form videos, and interactive elements for the Asia section of the IEEFA website, such as story scrolling and Flourish visuals
  • Contribute to organizational impact reporting, and global and regional communications projects as required

Required Qualifications

  • A Bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience) in data visualization, graphic design, information design, or a related field
  • 4 to 7 years of demonstrated professional experience designing charts, graphs, reports, data visualizations, and digital content, ideally for research, policy, or financial organizations
  • A portfolio demonstrating the ability to translate complex data into clear, compelling, and well-designed visualizations across a range of formats
  • Ability to explain visual design decisions clearly to non-design audiences
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to work effectively under pressure and manage competing priorities and deadlines
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and deliver on-brand first drafts with minimal supervision or revision
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud (InDesign, Illustrator) is essential; experience with video production is strongly preferred
  • Experience in programming tools and design platforms such as Flourish and Canva
  • Commitment to IEEFA’s mission to accelerate the transition to a diverse, sustainable, and profitable economy

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a research organization or in sectors such as energy, climate, or finance
  • Strong interest in current affairs, particularly in the energy and finance sectors

Compensation and Benefits

Full-time 12-month fixed-term employment contract with the option of extension by mutual agreement and a market competitive remuneration. Pay rates are also based on education, skill, experience level and internal equity.

Work Schedule

Full-time, 5 days/week, with occasional evening or weekend work as required.

Travel

Some travel is required. All team members attend IEEFA’s annual conference and team retreat.

Physical Demand and Work Environment

Must be able to work for prolonged periods at a computer. Computer work can involve repetitive motion, eyestrain, back and neck strain.

EOE Statement

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at IEEFA. All members of under-represented groups are especially encouraged to apply. We are committed to providing all team members with a work environment free from discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, pregnancy/parental status or disability status.

Reasonable Accommodation Statement

IEEFA provides reasonable accommodation to applicants with disabilities. Applicants requiring reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process should contact the Office of Human Resources at +254716710509. Determinations will be made on a case-by-case basis.

To Apply

Qualified applicants should submit a resume, cover letter and portfolio of their work. Applications will be accepted until the position is filled. Please be sure to add to your contact list to ensure delivery of all correspondence from us. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a graphic design test.
