raw.description:
Department: Marketing

Location: Home-based in the UK, with occasional travel to the London office

Reports to: Marketing Director

Hours: 37.5 per week

Please note: this role is open to UK-based candidates only. We do not employ remote staff overseas and cannot offer relocation support. Candidates must already have the right to work in the UK; visa sponsorship is available only in exceptional circumstances.


Role Overview

Cambridge Spark is building a modern B2B marketing function to match an ambitious new direction: helping large, complex organisations build the capability to adopt AI and prove the results. We're investing in editorial, research, video, community and events to earn the attention and trust of senior leaders. The Head of Growth Marketing makes sure that trust turns into pipeline and revenue.

You'll own how marketing wins new clients: finding, engaging and converting the organisations most likely to buy from us. The right accounts, the right people within them, the right message, at the right time. That means building an account-based, data-led demand generation programme from the ground up, with a written playbook and clear measures. It covers our core business and the newer areas where we're growing: new markets, new propositions and new lines of business where pipeline has to be built from scratch.

Two partnerships sit at the heart of the role. With our Marketing Operations Lead, you'll build a best-in-class, technology-enabled and data-enabled demand engine, turning intent signals, scoring and account data into targeted action. With our highly skilled New Business sales team, you'll run joint plays on target accounts, agree what a qualified opportunity looks like, and build the feedback loop that tells us what actually converts.

This is a founding role. It suits someone who can set the strategy and run the programmes themselves, who is comfortable being measured on pipeline, and who wants to build something properly. As the programme proves its return, we expect to build a growth team around it.


Key Responsibilities

Growth strategy and targeting

  • Own the growth marketing strategy and annual plan, tied to company revenue targets and our priority sectors
  • Define, with New Business and Marketing Operations, our ideal customer profile, target account list, account tiering, and the personas and buying groups within those accounts
  • Write it down: build and maintain a shared growth playbook that marketing and sales both work from
  • Design account-based programmes across one-to-one, one-to-few and one-to-many tiers

New business and new markets

  • Focus on new logos: winning the organisations that don't yet work with us
  • Build pipeline for our newer propositions and markets as well as our core business, and help shape how each one goes to market
  • Direct the wider marketing team's work towards one goal: qualified account opportunities for New Business to convert. That means events that move accounts forward, customer proof points that build confidence, PR and earned media that open doors, email nurture that keeps accounts warm, and answer-engine optimisation (AEO) so we show up when buyers ask AI tools

Building the demand engine with Marketing Operations

  • Work hand in hand with the Marketing Operations Lead to build a best-in-class, tech-enabled, data-led demand generation capability across intent data, scoring, qualification, routing and attribution
  • Turn the signals and data that system produces into action: which accounts to prioritise, who to reach, when and with what
  • Partner with the Marketing Operations Lead on selecting and rolling out our account-based and intent platform. Marketing Operations owns the platform; you're its lead commercial user
  • Use AI tools to work faster and smarter, and help set the standard for how the wider team uses them in demand generation

Partnering with New Business

  • Run coordinated account plays with the New Business team, sequencing marketing and sales activity on priority accounts
  • Agree qualification definitions and handover with sales leadership, and run a regular rhythm of pipeline review and feedback
  • Equip sellers with timely account insight and relevant content for their conversations
  • Build a relationship of trust with sales, grounded in shared targets and honest data

Campaigns and channels

  • Plan and run demand campaigns across paid social, account-based advertising, search, email and nurture, events and partner channels
  • Select and package our editorial, research, video and community content for in-market audiences
  • Own the growth budget, run a disciplined test-and-learn approach, and move spend to what works

Measurement

  • Own the number that matters most: qualified account opportunities delivered to New Business, along with the measures behind it (target account engagement, pipeline created and influenced, velocity, conversion and win rates)
  • Set the benchmarks: in your first 90 days, establish baselines and agree realistic targets with the Marketing Director
  • Report clearly to the Marketing Director and leadership team on what is working, what isn't and what we'll change


Candidate Specification

Essential

  • Significant B2B marketing experience (typically 7+ years), including senior ownership of demand generation, account-based or growth marketing and a track record of building qualified pipeline
  • Experience marketing a considered, high-value purchase with long sales cycles and multiple stakeholders in the buying decision
  • Has designed and run an account-based programme end to end, with measurable pipeline and revenue impact
  • Proven, close partnership with sales teams, and credibility with sales leaders
  • Hands-on experience with marketing automation and CRM (HubSpot preferred) and with account-based or intent data platforms
  • Commercially minded and numerate: confident with funnel metrics, attribution, budgets and forecasting
  • Able to set strategy and execute it, and comfortable working in a growing team where you'll build as well as run
  • A clear communicator and a strong writer
  • Actively uses AI tools in their own work

Desirable

  • Experience selling into large enterprises, regulated sectors (such as financial services, pharmaceuticals or health) or the public sector
  • Background in EdTech, learning and development, professional services or consultancy
  • Experience selecting, implementing or getting value from an ABM or intent platform
  • Experience building pipeline for a new market, proposition or line of business
  • Experience building or leading a team
  • Interest in AI and how organisations adopt it



Background to our Organisation

We are an education technology company that enables corporate and government organisations to achieve their business goals by educating their workforce with critical digital transformation skills to succeed in the AI era.

We deliver unique and innovative professional education that is accelerating the digital transformation of our clients, advancing the careers of their employees, helping people get into work and closing the digital skills gap. We are in a sector that is crucial to the economy and workforce, with a lot of opportunity for change and innovation. We are at the cutting edge of teaching applied data and digital skills, with our unique patented learning platform EDUKATE.AI offering our clients and learners a unique learning experience. EDUKATE.AI was developed with support from Innovate UK and provides all of our learners with 24/7 immediate feedback on their work, helping accelerate the learning process and providing a sandbox environment to experiment on real world datasets.

Since 2016, we have supported more than 15,000 learners across four continents with nearly 550,000 pieces of code submitted for feedback on EDUKATE.AI. We are trusted by some of the most recognisable brands in the world to educate their workforce, including Microsoft, the NHS, GSK, easyJet, the BBC and John Lewis. Our focus on applied learning to create business impact sets us apart - individual learners have reported applying their skills at work to generate recorded value of up to £40m.


Our Values

At the centre of the way we work together and inspire each other to achieve success are these core values:

Entrepreneurial

We take initiative and show entrepreneurial spirit which fuels innovation at Cambridge Spark. This includes identifying opportunities for improvement, taking ownership for implementing solutions effectively and driving improvement by using proof of concepts to demonstrate the feasibility and value of their work.

Team Spirit

Everyone is part of building an open and transparent culture, communicating effectively to raise issues, discuss improvements and share the evidence used to make decisions.

Customer-focused

Our customers are at the centre of everything we do, inspiring us to create great work. We strive to build friendly, professional and lasting relationships with them to better understand and anticipate their needs.

Gold Standard

We are experts in our field and are constantly developing our technology and offering. We set the benchmark in our industry: both in what we offer customers and in how we deliver it.

Cambridge Spark is an Equal Opportunities Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. Cambridge Spark is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunities for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Cambridge Spark are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, colour or ethnicity, ability or disability, gender or gender reassignment, sexual orientation, marital status, religion, age or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Cambridge Spark will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Cambridge Spark encourages applicants of all ages.

raw.description:
The Field Sales Engineer (FSE) is the technical sales lead for IQSIGHT video solutions in an assigned territory. The FSE augments the sales function by providing presales technical support for project work, often at the customer's location, and designs complete solutions that integrate IQSIGHT hardware and software to meet customer requirements.

The FSE partners closely with territory and vertical sales leaders to qualify, advance, and win complex video security opportunities. The FSE owns the technical win: system design, demonstrations, proofs of concept, and the confidence of the integrator and end user that the solution will perform.

Focus customers are system integrators (SIs), SI key accounts, and end users, along with the consultants and A&E firms who specify their projects.

Essential Functions

  • Provide presales technical support for project opportunities in the assigned territory, working on-site at customer locations as needed.
  • Lead technical discovery with SIs and end users to define requirements, constraints, and success criteria.
  • Design complete video solutions, including camera selection and placement, video analytics, recording and storage, network requirements, and VMS integration.
  • Fulfill customer requirements for integrating IQSIGHT hardware and software with proprietary and third-party platforms, including Genetec Security Center, Milestone XProtect, and BVMS.
  • Coordinate deliverables from other IQSIGHT departments, such as Product Management, Engineering, and Technical Support, to build full system solutions for the customer.
  • Demonstrate products and software and develop and deliver proof-of-concept demonstrations.
  • Produce system designs, bills of materials, and technical content for proposals and RFP responses.
  • Support the sales team on target accounts and keep internal tracking systems and processes current.
  • Build relationships with consultants and A&E firms to drive IQSIGHT specifications.
  • Train and enable SI technicians and engineers, rep firms, and internal sales staff on products, analytics, and system design, and create application notes, how-to guides, and demo content.
  • Maintain territory demo kits.
  • Maintain expert-level knowledge of the IQSIGHT video portfolio, including product specifications, hardware, and software, and stay current on new technology.
  • Support trade shows, partner events, and regional training sessions.
  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, or a related technical field preferred, or equivalent experience.
  • Requires 5 years of security industry (IP video) experience in a customer-facing technical role such as sales engineering, system design, or field applications, preferably from the manufacturer or integrator level.
  • Hands-on experience designing and deploying IP video systems, including camera selection, field-of-view planning, and bandwidth and storage calculations.
  • Working knowledge of IP networking, including switching, VLANs, PoE, multicast, and basic cybersecurity hardening.
  • Familiarity with Windows Server environments and cloud platforms such as AWS and/or Azure.
  • Preferred experience with at least one enterprise VMS (Genetec, Milestone, or BVMS). Video analytics configuration experience also preferred.
  • Proven ability to solve complex technical problems for customers.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills. Must possess strong presentation and demonstration skills.
  • Requires self-motivated individual with strong organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Willingness to travel within the territory 50-70% of the time, including on-site customer work.
  • Industry certifications a plus, such as Genetec or Milestone certifications, ASIS PSP, or networking accreditations.
  • Proven ability to work collaboratively across sales, product, and technical support teams.
  • Proficiency with Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required.

The US based salary range for this position is $120,000-135,000. This role is also eligible for commission. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.

In addition to base salary, full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group's (US) Health and Welfare Benefit Plans—including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance—as well as the company’s 401(k) plan, subject to the terms and conditions of the respective plan documents. raw.description:
At NVIDIA, we're solving the world's most exciting problems with our unique approach to accelerated computing. We're looking for a passionate scientist at the intersection of quantum device physics and advanced physics simulation and modeling. This role will path-find the future of high-fidelity, real-time models for fault-tolerant quantum hardware.

At NVIDIA, we want to help accelerate the entire quantum ecosystem. As a Sr. Quantum Applied Research Scientist, you will help design and build high-fidelity models grounded in device physics, calibration experiments, decoding, and system performance. You will develop physics-informed data generation pipelines, advanced physics models, and advanced noise models. Your research will translate qubit physics into performant, accelerated modeling systems for fault-tolerant quantum computing for both offline and real-time use. You will collaborate with teams across Product, Engineering, and Applied Research to push the frontier of Accelerated Quantum Supercomputers! Do you love developing new technology, enjoy working with people and teams around the world, and operating at the speed of light? If yes, we would love to hear from you!

What you'll be doing:

  • Research and develop advanced physics-based models and scalable simulation frameworks.

  • Build physics-informed synthetic data generation pipelines that leverage quantum device models, noise channels, and Hamiltonian characterization to produce high-quality datasets.

  • Develop detailed noise models of quantum hardware that capture device physics, decoherence, and drift behavior, enabling accurate performance prediction and parameter inference without full experimental overhead.

  • Develop GPU-accelerated implementations to ensure the full simulation and modeling pipeline scales.

  • Communicate research findings and collaborate with academic and industry partners to advance the field, while championing rapid innovation, technical depth, and creative problem solving.

What we need to see:

  • Masters Degree in Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field (Ph.D. strongly preferred); or equivalent experience.

  • 8+ years of combined experience and high impact in quantum systems, physics-based modeling, simulation, or related research areas.

  • Hands-on expertise in developing high-fidelity models of physical systems, including numerical simulation and model validation.

  • Strong background in quantum device physics and information science, including noise models, error mechanisms, and fault-tolerant quantum systems across one or more qubit modalities.

  • Broad understanding of quantum control, such as pulse-level hardware interfaces and classical feedback through software abstractions.

  • Experience with scalable computing or accelerated systems for simulation, numerical methods, or modeling workflows.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Hands-on experience developing simulation frameworks or digital twins of quantum systems and deploying them in calibration or control workflows, with awareness of fidelity, latency, and scalability tradeoffs.

  • Deep expertise in modeling, extracting, and validating noise processes, including system identification, parameter estimation, and uncertainty quantification.

  • Experience with physics-informed or generative approaches to synthetic data generation, including noise simulation, Hamiltonian learning, or data augmentation for scientific workflows.

  • Experience with modeling of more than one qubit modality, including neutral atom qubits.

  • Proficiency with CUDA and NVIDIA GPU programming for accelerating quantum simulation, numerical modeling, or large-scale scientific workloads.

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family

raw.description:
Make Every Experience Matter

Viseven is an AI-native Intelligent Experiences Enabler for life sciences, helping pharma and biotech organizations move from fragmented content operations to connected, compliant, and measurable omnichannel engagement with HCPs and patients. By combining proprietary technology — eWizard, eVa, Kheiron, and Lexi — with agentic AI and strategic consulting, we support the full content lifecycle: from creation and MLR validation to localization and omnichannel publishing. Our clients include Top 50 life sciences, pharma, biotech, and medtech companies around the globe. 
Mission:Lead the company's Finance, Accounting, Legal, and Compliance functions, driving financial performance, commercial and pricing discipline, supporting strategic decision-making, and ensuring effective resource allocation, sustainable growth, and long-term profitability.

Responsibilities:

  • Strategic and Financial Planning:Partnering with the CEO and leadership team to shape company strategy, evaluate business opportunities, and translate strategic objectives into financial plans, targets, and resource allocation decisions; overseeing the company's financial plans, budgeting, and forecasting processes, ensuring alignment with business objectives and effective resource allocation.
  • Business Performance Management: Establishing and managing the company's business financial performance management framework, including KPIs, management reporting, variance analysis, and corrective action planning in partnership with business leaders.
  • Commercial Finance and Pricing: Owning the financial terms of the commercial offer: reviewing commercial contracts and statements of work, and supporting Sales and Delivery on the financial part of client proposals, including prices, discounts, payment terms and commercial risk; building pricing and commercial models for new services; leading the periodic review of global price lists together with the commercial organization.
  • Funding and Investment: Managing capital allocation, financing, and fundraising activities, and overseeing M&A transactions where applicable
  • Financial Systems and Processes: Developing and implementing financial systems and processes that are efficient, accurate, and scalable, ensuring timely, accurate, and actionable financial and business performance reporting to support data-driven decision-making across the company.
  • Financial Analysis:Conducting financial analysis, identifying trends and variances to evaluate the company's financial performance, identifying and implementing opportunities for improvement; evaluating business performance drivers, profitability, cost efficiency, investment returns, and proactively recommending actions to improve business results.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Liaising regarding financial results, forecasts, risks, and recommendations to internal and external stakeholders, including executive leadership, investors, and board members, as applicable.
  • Tax and finance compliance: Overseeing financial, accounting, and tax complianceensuring appropriate governance and management of legal and regulatory risks.
  • Legal and Contract Management: Overseeing the Legal function: client, supplier and partnership contracting and the contract register; employment, subcontractor and relocation legal support; corporate governance and the holding structure; counterparty due diligence; and the data privacy, ethics, IP and ESG programmes, including the related certifications and audits.
  • Risk Management: Identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating financial risks, incl. currency risk, market risk, credit risk, and operational risk.
  • Cash Flow Management: Monitoring financial runway and developing financial scenarios to support business planning and ensure sufficient liquidity. Owning liquidity forecasting and day-to-day liquidity management, including the payment schedule and the working capital position; managing banking relationships and mandates across all group entities; sourcing, negotiating and operating trade and supply chain finance facilities, including early payment programmes with clients.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience in corporate finance, accounting, auditing, controlling, or a related field, including relevant experience managing financial processes or teams.
  • SaaS business experience (desirable): Experience in a SaaS or subscription-based business, with a strong understanding of recurring revenue metrics, unit economics, and growth and profitability drivers.
  • Strong understanding of financial frameworks, accounting principles, financial controls, and core finance processes.
  • Proven experience in developing or improving finance functions, financial processes, and reporting systems.
  • Business partnering: proven ability to influence strategic and operational decisions, challenge business assumptions, and drive performance improvements through cross-functional collaboration.
  • International experience: Experience managing finance, accounting, and tax matters across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Commercial finance: experience in pricing, deal structuring and commercial contract review, and in partnering with a sales organisation on proposals, discounts and payment terms.
  • Treasury and banking: experience managing bank relationships and mandates in several jurisdictions, and securing working capital, trade finance or debt facilities.
  • Legal function oversight: experience leading or directly overseeing an in-house legal and compliance team in a multi-jurisdiction group.
  • Excellent analytical, strategic thinking, communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and organizational skills.
  • Strong leadership capabilities and experience managing teams, driving change, and improving operational effectiveness.
  • Resilience, adaptability, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Strategic, critical, and holistic thinking, with a focus on business value and sound financial decision-making.
  • Upper-intermediate to advanced English proficiency.
  • Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field, or an equivalent qualification.

Why Viseven?

Purpose in Every Service

Your work will contribute to solutions that help pharmaceutical companies bring innovations to market faster and improve how healthcare information reaches people globally. We build technology with purpose — because better communication can lead to better health outcomes.

Care and Connection

We believe great work happens when people feel supported, trusted, and connected. At Viseven, collaboration, knowledge sharing, and genuine care are part of everyday work — for our teammates, clients, and communities. From charity and sustainability initiatives to an inclusive and supportive environment, we grow stronger together.

Grow and Go Beyond

We encourage bold ideas, ownership, and continuous growth. Whether it’s leading new initiatives, shaping products, or expanding your expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to make a visible impact and evolve alongside a global organization.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation with performance-based salary reviews

  • Professional and career growth opportunities in a global environment

  • Flexible work format with remote opportunities

  • Paid time off (18 business days) and sick leave according to company policy

  • Family leave (3 paid business days) for important life moments

  • Comprehensive medical insurance coverage

  • English language courses

  • Professional development through forums, conferences, and learning programs

  • Team-building activities and corporate events

  • A collaborative international team where your ideas matter

Grow your expertise while shaping communication for the world’s leading pharma brands. Over 50% of our team has been with Viseven for 5+ years. Join us!

raw.description:
Salary:£65,000 - £75,000
Location: Remote, but within the UK
Please note: We are unable to sponsor international visas at this time.

About Nexus Mods
Established in 2001, Nexus Mods is the largest video game modding platform on the internet - a household name in the PC gaming ecosystem.
  • 80M+ registered members
  • 980K+ mods for 5,500+ games
  • 26B+ mod downloads
We’re currently focused on product modernisation, driving growth and building infrastructure for the next 10 years of community-powered modding.

Our Role
We’re looking for x4 Senior Full Stack Engineers to join our Engineering team, working on Vortex, Nexus Mods’ flagship desktop mod manager. You’ll help build and improve an application used by millions of gamers, powering downloads, deployments, and conflict resolution across our supported games.

Vortex is a desktop app, currently Windows-first with Linux on the roadmap. You’ll join our existing product-led teams, making sure each pod has engineers who can actively deliver and build features.

What You’ll Be Working On
  • Developing and improving Vortex on Windows, supporting the wider gaming industry
  • Tackling practical engineering challenges around game support, Vortex functionality, and desktop development
  • Improving the functionality and user experience of our existing application

Role Requirements

Must-haves:
  • A genuine passion for gaming and an understanding of gaming culture (a hard requirement).
  • Strong full-stack JavaScript / TypeScript experience in production.
  • Strong React experience, including state management.
  • Solid Node.js and wider JavaScript ecosystem experience, including async patterns, streaming I/O, and child processes.
  • Experience developing desktop applications, and a genuine interest in desktop over purely web-based products.
  • Experience with our current technology stack.
  • Senior-level experience on substantial, consumer-facing systems at scale. Desktop, gaming, or creator tooling is ideal, but other backgrounds are welcome.
  • Solid system design and API design skills, with an eye for backwards compatibility.
  • Experience debugging production software on machines you don’t control.
  • Hands-on CI/CD experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and comfort working cross-functionally.
  • Ability to balance speed, quality, and pragmatism in a long-lived codebase with active community contributors.
Bonus Skills:
  • Hands-on Electron experience (less onboarding, faster ramp-up), including Windows and Linux platform behaviour.
  • Modding experience or familiarity with Nexus Mods. Not essential, as we provide internal training.
  • Packaging, code signing, and auto-update experience (electron-builder, NSIS, Flatpak, or equivalent).
  • Client-side authentication and download/distribution experience.
  • Background in launchers or content distribution clients (Steam, Epic, GOG Galaxy, Battle.net, modding tools).
  • Experience taking a Windows-first app to Linux, or maintaining parity.
  • Open source or external community contributor experience.
  • Understanding of gaming ecosystems: file formats, save management, load orders, plugin systems.
  • Familiarity with Bethesda Creation Engine, FOMOD, Wabbajack, or similar standards.

Role Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain features across the frontend, backend, and integration layers of a desktop app used by tens of millions of users on varying hardware and OS configurations.
  • Work across the delivery lifecycle, from prototyping to multi-sprint delivery of new game support and major workflow changes.
  • Tackle hard technical problems: performance regressions, race conditions, complex state bugs.
  • Evolve local data, configuration, and user profiles safely across releases.
  • Collaborate with other teams and review contributions from community and internal developers.
  • Contribute to the public extension API, balancing third-party freedom with a sound permission model.
  • Diagnose field issues using crash reports, telemetry, and logs.
  • Write clean, well-tested code and uphold high standards across CI/CD, packaging, and documentation.
  • Share knowledge and support other engineers across pods.

Benefits of Working at Nexus Mods

Benefits
  • We work a 4-day week of 32 hours, with no reduction in pay.
  • An allowance of £25 each month to spend on video games.
  • Employee Assistance Programme.
  • Private BUPA healthcare for you and your family.
  • A very flexible training budget.
  • Regular social events throughout the year. Participation is optional!
Diversity and Inclusion
We celebrate diversity and want you to bring your whole self to work. Supporting an incredible community of tens of millions of users, we thrive on engaging as many views as possible to improve our platform. We see no reason why our culture should be any different.

raw.description:
What We Do

We’re on a mission to empower veterinary professionals with opportunities to achieve greater flexibility in their careers while helping animal hospitals provide care for more pets in their communities.

Powered by groundbreaking technology, Roo has built the leading veterinary staffing and careers platform, connecting Vets, Techs, and Veterinary Assistants with practices for relief support, full-time hiring, and free continuing education. Roo empowers the largest network of over 30,000 veterinary professionals to earn and learn on their schedule, helping Veterinarians earn over $400 million. Together, we’ve provided more than 5 million hours of coverage at over 10,000 animal hospitals.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product Design to lead our product design team and raise the craft bar across every Roo surface.

This role sits within Roo’s product team, which owns product and design craft across the company. The product team supports a number of squads (aka business units), the cross-functional teams accountable for driving the success of the key pillars of our marketplace. Designers are aligned to one or more squads to deliver meaningful business impact but formally sit within the product team to ensure we are creating a cohesive product experience across squads. Holding that tension well is at the core of this job.

Given Roo’s size and fast-paced environment, leading the design team at Roo will require you to be a player-coach. This means you'll spend real time in Figma owning a few projects end-to-end to drive measurable business impact for one or more business units. At the same time, you’ll help set the quality bar across our full product surface by defining what design excellence means at Roo, and making it stick. You'll grow and coach the team, raise the craft, and build the practices that let design scale with the company.

This role is remote, with occasional travel to our San Francisco co-working space for key meetings and team events.

Responsibilities

  • Lead, mentor, and grow the 5 person Product Design team. Support mid and staff-level designers in developing strong craft, critical thinking, and strategic influence.
  • Evolve our design competencies into a standard the whole company can understand and then make it operate. Today that bar largely lives in people's heads. You’ll make it explicit, defensible, and consistently applied.
  • Support career growth by running development conversations, writing performance reviews with business-unit leaders, and making the path from one level to the next clear
  • Take on real design work yourself. Everything from hard problems, quick wins, exploratory concepts, and the things that unblock the team.
  • Partner with leadership to align design direction with product strategy and company goals.
  • Build and strengthen design systems that enable consistency, quality, and scalability. This includes raising the team's leverage with AI by helping to drive forward efforts to make our design system agentic-friendly so prototypes can be built from real components.
  • Shape design practices across discovery, concept development, interaction design, prototyping, and delivery.
  • Encourage exploration and push the team to rethink assumptions while staying grounded in user needs and market realities.
  • Advocate for the customer experience across every surface and ensure design decisions always reflect real customer needs.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of product design experience with 4+ years of management experience
  • Demonstrated ability to grow, coach, and support staff-level designers in improving their craft and helping them extend their skillset from strong execution toward strategic influence
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence across visual design, interaction design, systems thinking, product storytelling, and user-centered craft.
  • Experience building and scaling design systems.
  • AI fluency in design practice. You've used AI to move faster on real work and you have a considered view on where it helps and where it produces work that shouldn't ship.
  • Ability to bring clarity to ambiguous spaces and turn loose ideas into compelling product concepts.
  • Strong cross functional communication skills and experience working closely with cross-functional leadership
  • Experience with a variety of user research methods. You know how to get answers from users yourself and help your designers do the same.
  • Excitement about shaping the future of the industry by designing experiences that support meaningful work.
  • Experience leading design across multiple products or surfaces. Two-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

$200,000—$280,000 USD
Tier 2 Pay Range (examples: LA, Boston, Seattle, DC, San Diego, Chicago)
$180,000—$250,000 USD
Tier 3 Pay Range (examples: Austin, Dallas, Portland, Denver, Philadelphia, Baltimore, Sacramento)
$170,000—$240,000 USD

$160,000—$225,000 USD
Tier 5 Pay Range (examples: Madison, Birmingham, San Antonio, Spokane, Toronto)
$150,000—$210,000 USD

Core Values

Our Core Values are what shape us as an organization and we're looking for people who exhibit the same values in their professional life; Bias to Urgency, Drive Measurable Impact, Seek Understanding, Solve Customer Problems and Have Fun!

What to expect from working at Roo!

Located in the US:
For permanent, full time employees, we offer:
  • Accelerated growth & learning potential.
  • Stipends for home office setup, continuing education, and monthly wellness.
  • Comprehensive health benefits to fit your needs with base medical plan covered at 100% with optional premium buy up plans.
  • 401K
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.
  • Paid Maternity/Paternity and reproductive care leave.
  • Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.
  • Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.
Located in Canada:

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off.

  • Gifts on your birthday & anniversary.
  • Opportunity for domestic travel, including for regional team building events.
Overall, you would be part of a mission-driven company that will significantly empower the lives of all veterinary professionals and the health of the overall animal industry that seeks massive innovation.
We have diverse, passionate & driven team members from a variety of backgrounds, and Roo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.   • Manage centralized MI follow-ups to support timely case progression and prevent verification delays.
  • Action MI requests raised by Scoping and Delivery teams in a prompt, organized, and efficient manner.

  • Ability to handle sensitive information with discretion and maintain data confidentiality.

We have recently launched our second product - a Whistleblowing platform with end-to-end encryption enabling employees to report issues safely and anonymously.

⚡️ About Merkle Science

Merkle Science provides blockchain transaction monitoring and intelligence solutions for web3 companies, digital asset service providers, financial institutions, law enforcement and government agencies to detect, investigate and prevent illicit use of cryptocurrencies. Our vision is to make cryptocurrencies safe and provide infrastructure for the safe and compliant growth of cryptocurrencies.
Merkle Science is headquartered in New York with offices in Singapore, Bangalore and London. The team has combined experience across Bank of America, Paypal, Luno, Thomson Reuters and Amazon. The company has raised over US$27 MM from SIG, Beco, Republic, DCG, Kenetic, GGV and several others.

The Role

You will design, build and run the systems behind our data products, covering ingestion, processing, analytical storage and serving. You own your work from the design document through to production. The people who design a pipeline also run it and answer for its numbers.

Our stack is very wide, and we go deep in every part of it. We don't stop at "it works." We keep measuring, profiling and tuning to make systems faster, cheaper and more reliable. We want engineers who are razor sharp, pay close attention to detail, and care as much about why a query takes 800 ms as whether it returns the right answer.

You don't need blockchain experience. If you're a strong data engineer who wants to learn it, we'd like to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build scalable, high-throughput data pipelines and platform systems for blockchain data across 30+ chains.

  • Build backend data services and loaders in Go and Python.

  • Design and evolve data models and analytical workloads in ClickHouse, and tune them for sub-second queries.

  • Build incremental, idempotent pipelines on Databricks over billions of rows and tens of terabytes.

  • Keep improving the scale, reliability, freshness, performance and cost efficiency of the platform.

  • Investigate hard performance and reliability problems and see them through to resolution.

  • Work closely with the product, analytics and investigations teams that use the data, and turn their needs into platform designs.

  • Help set technical direction through architecture discussions, design reviews and code reviews.

  • Mentor engineers and help set strong engineering and operational practices.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years building and operating production data systems, including ETL and ELT pipelines. At least two of those years should be spent owning systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Expert Python and strong SQL. You write typed, tested code, are comfortable with asyncio and concurrency, and have built incremental data models over billions of rows.

  • Go for backend services. You have built and run high-throughput services or data loaders in Go in production.

  • ClickHouse in production. You know MergeTree schema and sort-key design, materialised views, bulk loads and query tuning.

  • Databricks in production. You have worked with PySpark, Delta Lake and Unity Catalog, designed incremental and idempotent tables, and kept an eye on compute cost.

  • Large-scale data. You have hands-on experience with pipelines over billions of rows and tens of terabytes. You understand how partitioning, clustering and file sizing affect cost and latency.

  • Kafka, Airflow and Kubernetes in production. You understand delivery semantics and idempotent writes, have handled backfills and failures, and have run data workloads with Docker and Helm. Google Cloud is preferred; AWS is fine.

  • An operations and communication mindset. You instrument what you build, write runbooks and post-incident reviews, and can write a design document that a reviewer in another time zone can approve.

Nice to Have

  • Blockchain data: EVM, UTXO or non-EVM chain data models, and pulling data from nodes over JSON-RPC or gRPC.

  • Graph or distributed key-value stores: entity resolution or clustering on large graphs.

  • Infrastructure as code, GitOps and observability: Terraform, Helm, ArgoCD, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus and Grafana, and load-test design.

  • Experience building platforms that serve multiple data sources, datasets or product teams.

  • AI-assisted development, and experience in fintech, compliance or AML.

How We Work

  • You'll join a small, senior team where everyone owns their work end to end.

  • We make decisions based on measured evidence, not opinion.

  • We keep design notes and runbooks next to the code.

  • We test at production scale and run blameless post-incident reviews.

  • We use AI coding tools every day, and we use judgement when reviewing what they produce.

❤️ Well Being, Compensation and Benefits

We care about your well-being. Along with excellent health insurance, we offer flexible time off, learning & development initiatives and hours that are designed to provide work/life balance. We regularly host team-building sessions and encourage discussions around mental health.
We reward talent and believe in acknowledging people for their contributions. We offer industry-leading compensation, along with generous equity. As a rapidly growing business, there are endless opportunities to grow your career with Merkle Science.

Overview:

This role is responsible for identifying, attracting, and securing top-tier talent for highly specialized positions within aerospace, aviation and engineering industry. It requires a deep understanding of the manufacturing, industrial, and engineering landscape landscape, including key industry players, emerging technologies, and critical skill sets. Success in this position depends on strategic networking, leveraging diverse recruitment methodologies, and building strong relationships with both candidates and hiring managers to facilitate a seamless hiring process. This position is an hourly, flexible, assignment/project-based position.

This role will report to the client Delivery Manager and/or Director depending on the account type.

Location: Remote

Job Duties and Responsibilities

  • Full-cycle recruitment management for specialized technical and niche roles, overseeing the process from requisition intake to offer negotiation and onboarding.
  • Development and execution of innovative sourcing strategies to engage passive candidates with specialized skill sets, utilizing industry-specific job boards, professional networks, conferences, and referrals.

Akido builds AI-powered doctors. Akido is the first AI-native care provider, combining cutting-edge technology with a nationwide medical network to address America’s physician shortage and make exceptional healthcare universal. Its AI empowers doctors to deliver faster, more accurate, and more compassionate care.

Serving 500K+ patients across California, Rhode Island, and New York, Akido offers primary and specialty care in 26 specialties—from serving unhoused communities in Los Angeles to ride-share drivers in New York.

Founded in 2015 (YC W15), Akido is expanding its risk-bearing care models and scaling ScopeAI, its breakthrough clinical AI platform. Read more about Akido’s $60M Series B. More info at .

The Opportunity

Akido's Global IT team is seeking a Senior Platform Engineer to lead the design and engineering of our identity, endpoint, and cloud infrastructure platforms. This is a design-and-build role with an automation-first mandate: you will architect the platforms the company runs on, develop the automation that operates them, and set the standards that keep them consistent as we grow organically and through acquisition. You'll define infrastructure and configuration as code, build controls that produce their own evidence, and design routine operational work out of the system rather than absorbing it. You'll also serve as a technical leader and mentor to IT engineers across the United States, India, and our affiliated medical groups.

What you'll do

  • Own the Microsoft Entra ID identity platform, including Conditional Access, authentication methods, MFA, and application and workload identity governance.
  • Engineer privileged access for least privilege, with just-in-time elevation, scoped administrative roles, and emergency access.
  • Automate the identity lifecycle end to end, and make single sign-on and automated provisioning a repeatable standard for application onboarding.
  • Establish cloud governance across accounts and subscriptions, including landing zone design, network architecture, RBAC, secrets management, centralized logging, and cost visibility.
  • Define cloud and platform configuration as code, with peer review and deployment pipelines.
  • Lead tenant, domain, and directory consolidation as new entities join, and retire inherited legacy environments.
  • Own Microsoft Intune configuration, compliance, and targeting strategy, and its integration with Conditional Access.
  • Build and maintain unattended production automation against platform APIs, with appropriate logging, monitoring, and failure alerting; use operational data to find and automate repeatable or bottlenecked work and measure the results.
  • Partner with Security and Compliance to engineer controls that produce their own audit evidence, and plan rollouts and remediation to fail safe under change control appropriate to a clinical environment.
  • Author enforceable standards, runbooks, and architecture decision records, and provide technical guidance and mentorship to IT engineers across the US, India, and our affiliated medical groups.

Who you are

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong written communication; this role produces standards and documentation that others rely on.
  • 8+ years in enterprise IT infrastructure, platform, or systems engineering.
  • 5+ years hands-on with Microsoft Entra ID at enterprise scale, including Conditional Access, authentication methods, privileged roles, and enterprise applications.
  • 4+ years engineering Microsoft Intune at scale, including configuration and compliance policy, targeting strategy, Autopilot, update rings, and application deployment.
  • 5+ years with Azure or AWS.
  • 5+ years automating against platform APIs, including Microsoft Graph, in PowerShell, Python, or a comparable language.
  • 3+ years of production Infrastructure-as-Code experience with Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or ARM.

Key traits about you

  • You look for the automated solution first, and you build it to last.
  • You establish current state before changing it, and you can show how you know.
  • You plan change carefully, design rollouts that fail safe, and are thorough about verification.
  • You document clearly, to a standard a colleague can work from.
  • You are pragmatic about inherited environments and effective at improving them incrementally.
  • You collaborate well across organizational boundaries and build relationships before you need them.
  • You invest in the people around you, and see standards and mentorship as leverage.
  • You handle confidential material and protected health information with care.

Benefits

  • Stock-options package
  • Health benefits include medical, dental and vision
  • 401K
  • Long-term disability
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Life insurance
  • Paid Leave Program

Physical Demands: Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to thirty pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

Salary range
$132,600—$179,400 USD

With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the Team:

The Collections team plays a critical role in protecting AlphaSense's cash position and customer relationships while enabling the business to scale. We partner closely with Sales, Customer Success, Billing, Revenue Accounting, Deal Desk, and Legal to manage risk, resolve escalations, and build scalable, best in class Order to Cash processes as AlphaSense continues its journey toward becoming a public company.

About the Role:

This role sits at the point where individual contributors and people leadership paths diverge. Reporting to the Director of Accounts Receivable, the Accounts Receivable Manager leads cross functional collections initiatives, owns strategy and judgment for the most sensitive customer relationships and escalations, and begins to operate at a managerial altitude reviewing and elevating the work of others while representing Collections in cross-functional forums.

The ideal candidate has demonstrated sustained, manager level judgment on collections strategy and risk over multiple business cycles, enjoys solving complex, high stakes account problems, and is ready to signal a clear direction: deepen as a technical/IC leader (Collections Manager) or move into people leadership (Manager, Collections).

Who You Are:

  • 5-8 years of progressive collections or accounts receivable experience, with a track record of sustained performance at increasing levels of ownership.
  • Demonstrated manager level judgment on collections strategy, risk assessment, and complex account resolution.
  • Experience leading cross functional initiatives such as dunning strategy redesign, risk scoring models, or collections system enhancements.
  • Experience reviewing and approving the work of Senior Analysts and other team members on complex accounts.
  • Comfortable acting as a trusted backup to a Manager for escalations and portfolio ownership.
  • Strong ability to partner with Sales and Customer Success leadership on shared account strategy.

Fliff is the arena for high-upside play. We are dismantling the paywalls of legacy sportsbooks and reimagining the economics of social games to pioneer the next generation of rewards-driven entertainment spanning sports, casino, predictions, collectibles, and beyond.



Powered by a frictionless freemium architecture, Fliff democratizes access and gives millions of players nationwide a real stake, real thrill, and real upside. By combining authentic competitive drive with instant rewards and interactive games, we are turning passive sports fans and casual gamers into active, empowered participants – unlocking the player in everyone.

The Role:

The Director of Finance will serve as the financial anchor for Fliff, taking direct ownership of budgeting, forecasting, accounting operations, cash flow management, and internal controls. This role bridges strategic executive planning with hands-on financial stewardship, scaling our financial architecture to support rapid transactional growth, player wallet liabilities, and complex vendor/contractor ecosystems.

You will manage and mentor the finance and accounting team, partner across Product, Marketing, and Operations, and operate with high autonomy to deliver accurate, audit-ready financial insights directly to executive leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategic Planning, Budgeting & Forecasting

  • Own the company-wide operating budget, quarterly rolling forecasts, and multi-year financial models.

  • Analyze complex financial datasets to evaluate key unit economics, player lifetime value (LTV), acquisition efficiency (CAC), revenue growth, profitability, and burn rate.

  • Partner cross-functionally with department heads to track departmental budgets, identify variances, and uncover cost-saving and ROI-enhancing opportunities.

  • Prepare comprehensive financial presentations, board packages, and key performance metric summaries for executive leadership and stakeholders.

    • Comprehensive Financial Reporting & Accounting Operations

  • Direct month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close cycles, ensuring absolute integrity across consolidated balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements under US GAAP.

  • Deliver accurate and timely financial reporting packages, tax documentation, and detailed bank and wallet reconciliations.

  • Oversee end-to-end Accounts Payable (A/P) and Accounts Receivable (A/R) workflows, working cross-functionally to optimize working capital and maintain vendor relationships.

  • Direct domestic and global payroll operations and contractor payment pipelines to ensure precise, timely compensation and tax compliance.

    • Internal Controls, Policies & Systems Scalability

  • Design, implement, and enforce robust internal accounting policies, standard operating procedures, and risk controls across all financial workflows.

  • Lead the implementation and modernization of scalable financial software, ERP systems, and automated reconciliation tools tailored to high-volume transaction environments.

  • Drive audit readiness, coordinating directly with external auditors, tax advisors, and banking partners.

    • Cross-Functional Leadership & Ad Hoc Strategy

  • Lead, mentor, and scale the finance and accounting function, promoting a culture of precision, accountability, and continuous improvement.

  • Serve as a self-directed partner to leadership, managing upward proactively to flag financial risks, surface trends, and deliver scenario modeling for strategic initiatives.

  • Steer ad hoc financial analyses and special projects across new market entries, payment gateway optimizations, and prize/reward structures.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • 8–12+ years of progressive finance and accounting experience, including 4+ years of direct people management experience leading finance professionals.

  • Demonstrated mastery of financial reporting, US GAAP, and technical accounting across financial statements, reconciliations, and tax compliance.

  • Proven track record leading company-wide budgeting, rolling forecasting, and detailed variance analyses in high-growth environments.

  • Hands-on experience supervising payroll, contractor disbursements, and A/P & A/R functions at scale.

  • High autonomy as a self-starter with a demonstrated track record of managing upward and communicating effectively across non-finance teams.

  • Exceptional analytical rigor, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills with the ability to maintain accuracy under tight deadlines.

  • Experience in social gaming, sports entertainment, daily fantasy sports (DFS), fintech, or consumer tech platforms with high transaction volumes and dual-currency or wallet models

    • Preferred Qualifications

  • Active CPA, CFA, or an MBA/Master’s degree in Accounting or Finance.

  • Direct experience selecting, implementing, or optimizing modern ERPs (e.g., NetSuite) and FP&A/BI platforms.

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including base salary, benefits, and equity.

  • Unlimited/Flexible paid time off.

  • Health benefits with 100% paid premiums* for medical, dental, and vision plans for employees and dependents, plus on-demand healthcare concierge.

  • Pre-tax savings plans for healthcare, with up to a $500 annual employer contribution to the HSA (if enrolled in the HSA medical plan).

  • Employee-sponsored 401(k) to help reach your financial goals.

  • $500 work-from-home stipend for equipment and accessories.

  • Fully remote work environment.

  • Generous parental leave.

  • Professional development opportunities in a dynamic, global setting.

We are a multinational company with our headquarters based in Philadelphia, and offices in New York, Austin, and Sofia, Bulgaria. Wherever we are in the world, we pride ourselves on being a close-knit, focused team that is welcoming and friendly, and the work that we do is always interesting and rewarding. Wherever we are in the world, we pride ourselves on being a close-knit, focused team that is:

Welcoming and Friendly

We want to reflect the diversity of the cities we serve. By creating an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive, we’ll make Fliff better for employees and customers alike.

Lively and Creative

We respect and value each other’s ideas, experience and expertise. There is no such thing as a bad idea; only ideas that are executed and ideas that are discarded after consideration.

Stimulating and Rewarding

We know bright minds love a challenge, and we understand your desire to see your hard work pay off. We’ll make sure your daily tasks align with your career ambitions as we grow together.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Fliff is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

Join Our Team!

If you're ready to be part of an exciting, innovative, and dynamic team, apply now to help shape the future of sports gaming with Fliff.

IMPORTANT NOTICE: The privacy and security of applicant information is paramount and we take fraud attempts very seriously. Please note that Fliff will never ask for payment or personal financial information during the application process. All of our legitimate job opportunities can be found on our official career site (). Please be cautious of communications and links that come from non-company email addresses (@getfliff.com), social media messaging platforms or unsolicited phone calls.

Senior BESS Performance Engineer

We are:

Wizeline, a global AI-native technology solutions provider, develops cutting-edge, AI-powered digital products and platforms. We partner with clients to leverage data and AI, accelerating market entry and driving business transformation. As a global community of innovators, we foster a culture of growth, collaboration, and impact.

With the right people and the right ideas, there’s no limit to what we can achieve.

Are you a fit?

We are seeking a BESS Performance Engineer to join the Asset Management team, supporting a growing portfolio of distributed generation projects across the United States. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this role will lead performance monitoring, analysis, and reporting for standalone Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and solar-plus-storage assets, including AC- and DC-coupled configurations.

The ideal candidate combines expertise in battery performance modeling, renewable energy systems, and data analytics to optimize technical performance and commercial efficiency. Working closely with Data Science, Asset Management, Engineering, and Operations & Maintenance (O&M) teams, this individual will develop data-driven insights, automate reporting workflows, and identify opportunities to improve asset reliability, battery life, and energy market performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • BESS Performance Monitoring: Lead performance analysis, monitoring, and operational reporting for standalone BESS and paired solar PV + BESS assets across a distributed generation portfolio.
  • KPI Development & Tracking: Develop and monitor key performance indicators, including Round-Trip Efficiency (RTE), State of Health (SOH), State of Charge (SOC), auxiliary power consumption, and system availability.
  • Battery Degradation & Predictive Modeling: Develop degradation models and predictive analytics to forecast battery life, monitor SOH against capacity guarantees, and optimize charging and discharging cycles.
  • Data Analysis & Troubleshooting: Extract, clean, and analyze large-scale SCADA, DAS, telemetry, and discrete-event datasets to identify underperforming assets, diagnose component failures, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Data Integration & Automation: Collaborate with Data Science teams to integrate BESS telemetry into enterprise platforms, optimize data warehousing, and automate internal and external reporting pipelines.
  • Solar-Plus-Storage Performance: Evaluate the technical and operational impacts of transitioning from standalone BESS to AC- and DC-coupled PV + BESS configurations.
  • Performance Optimization & Reporting: Present technical and financial findings, recommend operational improvements and dispatch strategies, and communicate actionable insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Must-have Skills

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field.
  • 3–5 years of experience in performance engineering, battery modeling, energy storage analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Strong understanding of Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), battery architecture, degradation mechanisms, and performance modeling.
  • Experience with the operation, design, or analysis of AC and DC electric power systems.
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data analysis, time-series manipulation, and modeling.
  • Hands-on experience with SCADA, DAS, telemetry, and operational datasets for power plant performance assessment.
  • Experience with analytical and business intelligence tools, such as Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Power BI, or Tableau.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex datasets into actionable insights.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Proficiency in leveraging Generative AI tools and Large Language Models (LLMs) to accelerate code development, automate data processing, and improve analytical workflows.

Nice-to-have

  • Renewable Energy Experience: Direct experience evaluating the performance of distributed generation or utility-scale BESS and solar PV assets.
  • Energy Markets & Financial Optimization: Experience analyzing wholesale electricity markets, ISO/RTO dispatch strategies, Locational Marginal Pricing (LMP), energy arbitrage, and battery dispatch optimization.
  • Solar-Plus-Storage Expertise: Experience analyzing standalone battery storage and AC- or DC-coupled solar-plus-storage projects.
  • SCADA & Monitoring Platforms: Familiarity with platforms such as AlsoEnergy, GPM, Power Factors, Ignition, Wattch, Denowatts, SynaptiQ, or OSIsoft PI System.
  • Cloud & Data Infrastructure: Practical experience with cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure, data warehousing, and data pipeline development.
  • AI & Predictive Analytics: Experience designing and deploying AI-driven workflows, machine learning algorithms, and statistical models to improve predictive performance and operational efficiency.
  • Asset Management Systems: Familiarity with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS), such as Fiix, IBM Maximo, or Sitetracker.
  • Experience collaborating with Asset Management, Engineering, Data Science, and O&M teams in renewable energy environments.

What we offer

  • A High-Impact Environment
  • Commitment to Professional Development
  • Flexible and Collaborative Culture
  • Global Opportunities
  • Vibrant Community
  • Total Rewards (benefits vary by location and employment type)

Find out more about our culture here

Acerca del rol.

Coordinador/a de Becas.

En este rol serás responsable de coordinar la operación de becas del Campus En Línea para UNITEC, gestionando la asignación, renovación, seguimiento y liberación de los apoyos de alumnos de nuevo ingreso, regresos y reingreso conforme a cada calendario operativo. Tu labor conectará con nuestra misión global, generando impacto en la correcta aplicación de los instrumentos de beca, el cumplimiento normativo, la trazabilidad documental de cada expediente y la permanencia estudiantil.

Tus principales retos:

  • Coordinar la validación y asignación de becas de los alumnos de nuevo ingreso conforme a convocatoria, reglas de otorgamiento y documentación requerida, asegurando su correcta aplicación.

  • Gestionar la renovación de becas de la población de reingreso en cada calendario operativo, validando el cumplimiento de las reglas de permanencia en promedio, carga académica y documentación.

  • Atender los casos de regresos y excepciones de los alumnos, desde su análisis hasta la liberación de los apoyos mediante la aplicación de criterios normativos.

  • Coordinar la integración, validación y resguardo de los expedientes de beca, asegurando completitud, trazabilidad y soporte documental para auditoría.

  • Promover y difundir las convocatorias de beca entre los alumnos y áreas involucradas, garantizando claridad en requisitos, fechas y criterios.

  • Atender la auditoría de becas de las áreas centrales por tipo de instrumento, conciliando montos, vigencias y aplicación con Finanzas.

  • Generar reportes de otorgamiento, renovación, cobertura y seguimiento de becas por marca, escuela y nivel para la Gerencia.

  • Dirigir, asignar y dar seguimiento a las actividades del equipo a su cargo, estableciendo prioridades y controles de calidad para asegurar la atención oportuna.

Perfil que buscamos.

Requisitos indispensables:

  • Formación académica: Licenciatura en Administración, Educación, Psicología, Trabajo Social, Ciencias Sociales o áreas afines a la gestión y contención de problemas.

  • Experiencia: Al menos 3 años de experiencia en instituciones educativas de nivel superior, orientación de apoyos económicos (becas), atención y contención de casos de alumnos, y coordinación de equipos de trabajo.

  • Competencias técnicas: Dominio de gestión y reglas de otorgamiento de becas, normativas institucionales, sistemas de gestión (Banner y Monitor 360°), conciliación financiera, control de expedientes y Office 365 con nivel avanzado de Excel.

  • Nivel de inglés: Básico.

Deseables:

  • Maestría o especialización en Gestión Educativa, Psicología, Administración o áreas afines.

  • Experiencia en entornos educativos superiores y procesos normativos de auditoría.

  • Competencias clave: Pensamiento analítico, atención al detalle, orientación al servicio, comunicación asertiva, resolución de problemas y liderazgo colaborativo.

Tu impacto en UNITEC

En la UNITEC trabajamos para ofrecer educación de calidad con sentido práctico, accesible y transformadora. Aquí no solo formarás parte de una universidad, sino de un proyecto que impulsa el desarrollo profesional de miles de estudiantes que buscan construir un mejor futuro. Ser parte de UNITEC significa generar impacto tangible: formar personas altamente empleables, con valores, competencias sólidas y un fuerte compromiso con su comunidad.

Diversidad e inclusión

En UNITEC, el talento no tiene límites. Nos enorgullece ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades y celebrar la diversidad en todas sus formas. Todas las personas candidatas cualificadas serán consideradas sin distinción de raza, religión, nacionalidad, sexo, estado civil, orientación sexual, discapacidad, edad u otras características legalmente protegidas. En este centro de trabajo queda prohibida la solicitud de certificados médicos de no embarazo y de VIH como requisito para el ingreso, permanencia o ascenso.

raw.description:
Overview

Liquibase delivers world-class enterprise solutions that automate and streamline database change governance. These solutions leverage the industry's open-source leader with over 100 million downloads. At Liquibase, we support a large number of customers, value creativity, and solve complex problems around data management. This is a company where you can expect opportunities to grow.

Liquibase is hiring a Technical Writer to join our Documentation team, partnering alongside our Technical Writer and Content Engineer. This is a versatile, high-impact role responsible for keeping developer documentation accurate, clear, and actionable. You will craft engaging learning materials across our docs and Liquibase University, test technical instructions directly in the command line, and help operationalize modern agentic AI workflows to scale content quality. If you are an adaptable writer with a keen editorial eye and an appetite for learning developer-centric tools, you will thrive here.

Who you are:

  • You surprise and delight customersby delivering meaningful value, turning complex database automation concepts into clear, frictionless guides.
  • You’re committed to excellence, holding high editorial standards while balancing speed and continuous iteration.
  • You bring a growth mindsetand an eagerness to learn developer workflows, CLI tooling, and modern documentation technology.
  • You embrace changeand uncertainty with energy and optimism, comfortable context-switching between planned roadmap deliverables and real-time customer feedback.
  • You take ownershipand follow through, proactively testing docs hands-on and resolving user pain points from start to finish.
  • You are innovative.You see agentic AI not as a replacement, but as an opportunity to scale and train automated documentation quality.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Author, edit, and maintain high-quality documentation, user guides, release notes, and reference material for Liquibase core features, extensions, and integrations.
  • Partner with Documentation, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success teams to develop interactive coursework and training materials.
  • Hands-on testing of technical documentation and examples in the product, verifying that installation steps, flags, and workflows function exactly as published.
  • Review, triage, and process inbound feedback, prioritizing fixes and updating content to address customer friction.
  • Help train and evaluate agentic AI tools, enforcing editorial rule sets, evaluating AI-generated drafts, and providing feedback to optimize internal automation prompts.
  • Apply core documentation best practices and topic-based authoring principles to maintain modular, searchable, and easily navigable docs.
  • Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Support, and Security teams to capture upcoming feature changes and technical specifications early in the development cycle.
  • Contribute to docs-as-code workflows using Git for version control, review pull requests, and manage content in structured markup languages (Markdown, YAML, XML, HTML).

Must Haves:

  • Bachelor’s degree in English, Technical Communication, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Demonstrated editorial experience: exceptional developmental editing, copyediting, and proofreading skills with acute attention to clarity and structure.
  • An authentic eagerness to learn and experiment with developer tooling, technical applications, and emerging documentation tech.
  • Critical thinking skills to evaluate technical content from an end-user perspective and explain why an edit is necessary.
  • Strong multitasking skills with the agility to manage ad-hoc user feedback alongside ongoing content initiatives.

Nice to Haves:

  • Experience working with version control platforms such as Git, GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps in a docs-as-code environment.
  • Comfort working in the terminal/CLI (running commands, reviewing terminal outputs, verifying CLI options).
  • Experience experimenting with or prompting agentic AI platforms (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) for content generation, editing, or rule enforcement.
  • Experience developing training curricula, tutorials, or online coursework (e.g., LMS/University platforms).
  • Familiarity with topic-based authoring principles or structured formats like DITA.
  • Hands-on exposure to markup and data-interchange formats such as Markdown, YAML, XML, HTML, and JSON.
  • Experience authoring or reviewing REST API documentation.

Perks of life at Liquibase:

  • Remote First culture, potential for company-wide in-person gatherings
  • Home office allowance for remote workers
  • Meaningful equity
  • Comprehensive health, vision, and dental benefits - country dependent
  • Generous paid time off and paid holidays
  • 401k match program (US only)
  • No punks, no jerks culture
  • Growth opportunities and ability to move up within the company

We take pride in:

  • A transparent and collaborative team environment. We value multiple perspectives and fresh thinking.
  • Our entrepreneurial culture. We provide every employee the opportunity to make a meaningful impact.
  • Providing the opportunity to work with new technologies and learn from experienced professionals.
  • How organizations, large and small, use DevOps to drive developer agility and accelerate software delivery.

Company Overview - We are Liquibase

A career at Liquibase means joining a quickly growing company on the front lines of the DevOps space. Our vision is to be the easiest, safest, and most powerful community-led database change management solution. As companies of all sizes continue to adopt an agile methodology and DevOps practices, there is a growing realization that the database needs to be considered as part of this innovation process.

At Liquibase, we foster a culture rooted in the open-source values of freedom, choice, transparency, and meritocracy. These are not just fashion labels here, but sincere convictions, and you’ll see that reflected in the way we operate daily. We’re caffeinated, collaborative & confident experts, eager to solve the most challenging database CI/CD problems for our customers.

Want to help the software world move faster? You’ve found the right place.

Eligible candidates may be subject to criminal history checks, which will be conducted and used in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal law.

Full-time/Permanent Employee
