raw.title: Regional Sales Manager, West & North Central
raw.excerpt: About GreyNoiseGreyNoise Intelligence is a mission driven security startup focused on helping organizations understand and mitigate risks from Internet scanning and exploitation.
raw.description:
About GreyNoise

GreyNoise Intelligence is a mission driven security startup focused on helping organizations understand and mitigate risks from Internet scanning and exploitation. GreyNoise provides real-time, verifiable intelligence on all actors scanning the Internet and how some of them are attempting to exploit vulnerabilities on assets connected to corporate networks. The intelligence is highly trusted because it’s generated from a global fleet of thousands of purpose built sensors observing the Internet. Advanced data science techniques and AI are used to process millions of observed events into real-time intelligence for customers.

The GreyNoise Global Observation Grid observes and analyzes unique threat data at-scale that no one else can. GreyNoise provides the most actionable threat intelligence against perimeter threats, so that no attack works twice.

All US based positions are fully remote within the US, with optional office attendance at our DC area headquarters, unless otherwise specified. Applicants must have US work authorization.

Please see the specific job description for all international position locations.

The Role

As Regional Sales Manager, West & North Central, you will drive GreyNoise's growth across the Western and North Central United States, expanding our presence among leading enterprises and building strategic customer relationships.

This is a high-impact, hands-on role requiring enterprise cybersecurity sales expertise, entrepreneurial drive, and strong execution. You will own your territory end-to-end, from territory strategy and pipeline development to navigating complex sales cycles and closing strategic deals. You will have significant autonomy to shape our go-to-market approach, build lasting customer relationships, and directly influence GreyNoise's growth.

Location: We are specifically seeking candidates based in the Western or North Central U.S., including California, the Pacific Northwest, Mountain West, and North Central regions. Travel to customer sites and industry events is required.

About the Team

The GreyNoise Americas Enterprise team is a small, high-ownership, mission-driven group transforming how the world's leading organizations leverage real-time threat intelligence to strengthen their security posture, defend critical infrastructure, and stay ahead of emerging threats.

As a lean, entrepreneurial team, we operate with a high degree of autonomy, accountability, and urgency. Every team member has the opportunity to shape our strategy, build meaningful relationships with industry-leading organizations, and directly influence how GreyNoise helps protect some of the world's most critical enterprises and digital infrastructure.

What You Will Do

  • Own and grow the West & North Central territory, driving revenue, pipeline development, forecasting, deal execution, and long-term growth.
  • Develop and execute strategic account plans to expand GreyNoise's presence across leading enterprise organizations.
  • Build executive relationships with CISOs, security leaders, technical stakeholders, and strategic partners.
  • Lead complex enterprise sales cycles, from prospecting and technical evaluations through negotiation and close.
  • Represent GreyNoise at industry events, customer engagements, and partner forums to build relationships and generate opportunities.
  • Collaborate with Sales Engineering, Marketing, Product, and Customer Success to drive customer adoption, retention, and expansion.
  • Champion the voice of enterprise customers, translating security challenges and market feedback into actionable insights.
  • Help shape GreyNoise's enterprise go-to-market strategy and culture with an entrepreneurial, high-ownership mindset.

What You Will Bring

  • 8+ years of US Enterprise sales experience - selling threat intelligence and/or adjacent solutions.
  • Strong, established relationships with the West & North Central regions and a track record of successfully negotiating and selling 6-figure deals into these organizations.
  • Strong familiarity with Enterprise cyber security functions, teams and goals; including SOCs, vulnerability management and threat hunting is a must.
  • A strong hunter mentality – able to drive net-new business and support a high-velocity sales environment.
  • Comfort in Enterprise executive relationship management, while also being able to engage with end users and develop them as strong Champions of GreyNoise.
  • A proven sales background of consistent achievement against quota.
  • Excellent presentation, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Past experience of thriving in a high-velocity tech sales environment.
  • Proven ability to institute a repeatable sales process to drive performance.
  • CRM Knowledge (preferably HubSpot).
  • Previous experience with PLG is a plus. At GreyNoise we embody product led growth which is focused on an end user model that relies on the product itself as the primary driver of customer acquisition and expansion.

This position reports to the Head of Enterprise Sales, Americas.

Benefits

💵 Equity in a Growing Startup. Every employee has the opportunity to share in GreyNoise's success through equity.

👩‍⚕️ Health & Wellness Benefits. US employees receive 100% company-covered health, dental, vision, and life insurance. Benefits for international employees vary by country and local requirements.

6️⃣ Retirement Benefits. US employees receive a competitive 6% employer 401(k) match, 100% fully vested from day one. International employees receive applicable statutory pension benefits in accordance with local regulations.

🏖 Flexible Paid Time Off. We believe taking time away from work is essential to staying healthy and doing your best work. We take this very seriously and even include scheduled all-company shutdowns throughout the year. Employees also receive any additional leave required by local laws.

🌎 Remote-First, Globally Connected. Headquartered in the Washington, DC area, GreyNoise is a distributed team working remotely across the US and Europe. We value flexibility, trust, and meaningful connections, no matter where you work.

💻 Equipment Budget. Every new employee receives a GreyNoise Apple Mac laptop and a $500 stipend (or local currency equivalent) for equipment and accessories to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

👼 Paid Parental Leave. Growing your family is a big milestone, and we're here to support you. We offer four months of paid parental leave for birth or adoption, plus up to two additional months of optional unpaid leave, coordinated with applicable statutory leave entitlements and local requirements.

📚 Learning & Development Budget. Every employee receives $1,500 annually (or local currency equivalent) to invest in professional development. Use it for courses, books, conferences, certifications, and other learning opportunities related to your role.

🌴 Team Connection & Company Offsites. We bring our distributed team together through multiple company and team offsites, virtual events, and local meetups to build relationships and stay connected beyond our day-to-day work.

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on country of employment, local regulations, and applicable employment arrangements.

GreyNoise Culture

The hallmark of any great company is a palpable and viscous culture. The most important pillars of our culture are:
  • Be transparent, honest, and objective. This is what it means to be “clinical”
  • Empathize with customers, partners, and each other
  • Learn from mistakes and share the knowledge
  • The way feedback is delivered to one another matters as much as the feedback itself
  • Good work-life balance is the key to sustained productivity
  • The measure of a team member’s effectiveness is how well the rest of the team operates in their unexpected absence
  • No such thing as a million dollar idea, only million dollar execution
  • Out-innovate our previous selves
Check out our (work-in-progress) longform culture document.

Explainability

Any security product that is a “black box” that asks you to blindly trust it should raise red flags - we believe the same is true of your place of work. We obviously think GreyNoise is doing something unique, but don’t take our word for it - ask any of our 150+ enterprise customers, investors, thousands of happy users, or dozens of journalists who have cited GreyNoise over the past few years.

Why You Should Work at GreyNoise

  • You enjoy identifying and solving hard problems
  • You are comfortable taking an idea from concept to customer
  • You are open to both explaining your stance and questioning others in a clinical, open-minded, and respectful manner
  • You want to directly impact users
  • You want to grow beyond your current skill set

Apply for the job

Do you want to join our team? Then we'd love to hear about you!

he Client Success Manager is the primary point of responsibility and accountability for assigned client relationships and related Client Success activities to ensure clients realize value from D&B solutions. Technical implementation, integrations, workflow configuration, solution architecture and technical AI assessments remain with Technical Client Success Managers, Technical Advisory resources or other specialist functions.

raw.description:
True Zero Technologies, a veteran-owned small business, was founded on the principle that the purposeful enablement of people and technology in an organization directly ties to the quality of its outcomes. True Zero recognizes that those outcomes begin and end with our people, and that is what we have built a community of like-minded, driven, and passionate individuals and innovators who are aligned in a common goal of delivering top-tier services to our customers. Our culture and commitment have been recognized through numerous accolades, including being named one of the Best Places to Work in 2023 in two categories (“Prosperous and Thriving” ($5MM–$50MM in gross revenue) and “Mid-Atlantic Region” (DC, DE, MD, NC, VA, WV)), and again in 2025 as a Best Places to Work honoree. In addition, True Zero earned coveted spots on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing companies in America in 2022, 2023, and 2025, a testament to our sustained growth driven by our people-first approach and unwavering dedication to excellence.

Position Overview

True Zero Technologies is seeking an experienced SOC Analyst IV to provide advanced cybersecurity monitoring, threat detection, incident investigation, and response support within complex federal environments. This senior-level position will serve as a technical escalation point for Security Operations Center (SOC) activities, leading sophisticated security investigations, analyzing emerging threats, and ensuring effective detection and response capabilities across enterprise systems.

The ideal candidate will possess extensive hands-on SOC experience, strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, and deep technical expertise in Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platforms, endpoint security, network analysis, and cloud security monitoring.

Job Responsiblities

    Job Responsibilities

  • Advanced Security Monitoring & Incident Response: Provide Tier III SOC support for security alert triage, complex incident investigations, forensic analysis, and escalation of advanced security threats across federal enterprise environments.
  • Threat Detection & Analysis: Analyze security events, SIEM alerts, endpoint telemetry, network traffic, and threat intelligence to identify malicious activity, determine potential impact, and recommend appropriate containment and remediation actions.
  • SOC Tools & Situational Awareness: Maintain comprehensive operational awareness of SOC security technologies, monitoring platforms, log sources, and telemetry to ensure continuous visibility into enterprise security posture and emerging threats.
  • Incident Investigation & Escalation: Lead advanced technical investigations, correlate security events across multiple data sources, perform root cause analysis, and coordinate incident escalation and response activities with cybersecurity stakeholders.
  • SOC Operations & Process Improvement: Lead shift handovers, maintain incident documentation, and develop, review, and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), incident response playbooks, and operational workflows to improve SOC efficiency and consistency.
  • Red Team & Purple Team Collaboration: Support Red Team and Purple Team exercises by evaluating detection capabilities, analyzing simulated attack activity, identifying monitoring gaps, and recommending improvements to threat detection and response procedures.
  • Technical Leadership & Knowledge Sharing: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior SOC analysts, assist with complex troubleshooting, and contribute to continuous improvements in threat detection, incident handling, and SOC operational effectiveness.

Job Requirements

    Job Requirements

  • Security Operations Experience: Minimum of 6 years of progressive experience in Security Operations Center (SOC) operations, cybersecurity monitoring, threat detection, incident response, or related security disciplines, including advanced incident investigation and escalation responsibilities.
  • Professional Certifications: Must possess at least one of the following certifications: GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), or CompTIA Security+.
  • SIEM & Endpoint Security Expertise: Demonstrated hands-on experience with SIEM platforms, security event correlation, endpoint detection and response (EDR) technologies, endpoint telemetry analysis, and advanced security alert investigation within enterprise environments.
  • Operating Systems, Networking & Cloud Security: Strong technical knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems, network protocols, enterprise networking, and AWS-native security capabilities, including experience investigating security events across on-premises and cloud environments.
  • Incident Response & Technical Communication: Proven ability to conduct complex security investigations, analyze potential indicators of compromise (IOCs), document technical findings, execute incident escalation procedures, and communicate actionable security recommendations to technical teams and federal stakeholders.

WHY DEPT®?

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

What we believe in

We build software for the world's most ambitious brands, and we're opinionated about how it gets made:

  • Code quality is a top priority. Style guides, code reviews, and best practices are how we move fast without breaking things. You'll also get your hands on a wide range of cutting-edge technology.
  • Great UI/UX is critical. Aesthetics, usability, and speed are all part of the product. A technically correct experience that feels bad isn't finished.
  • Collaboration wins projects. Great communication is the single strongest predictor of whether a project goes well.
  • We're pragmatic. We know what to build and what to leave alone, and we make real-world tradeoffs between cost, speed, and craft. Shipping something useful beats architecting something perfect.
  • We're intellectually curious. We're constantly learning through craft show & tells, lunch & learns, workshares, and active Slack channels full of talented engineers across the globe.

The role

As a Senior Engineer, you own significant portions of a project and drive them to completion. You take a semi-defined problem, ask the questions that sharpen it, turn it into a plan, and ship it. You're past the stage of needing fully specified tasks handed to you, and you're building the judgment to know which task matters most.

You're comfortable working alongside product managers, engineers, marketing, sales, and finance, and you can explain your work to any of them without retreating into jargon. Most of what we build depends on getting those people to a shared understanding of what's being made and why.

This role is primarily backend focused, occasionally diving into cloud infrastructure. However, you should also be comfortable enough in a modern frontend codebase to apply best practices and create something visually appealing and smooth to use.

What you'll do

  • Build and deploy scalable backend services and APIs for global brands, taking high ownership of your workstreams and their dependencies.
  • Take specs that are incomplete or ambiguous, resolve the open questions, and turn them into clear requirements, tasks, and stories with time-to-complete estimates people can plan around.
  • Participate in technical design of systems, schemas, and pipelines, and offer sound guidance on architecture and infrastructure decisions.
  • Integrate third-party APIs and systems, and design the contracts that frontend teams and other services build against.
  • Perform code reviews that raise the bar, both submitting your own work and giving constructive feedback that makes your teammates better.
  • Surface technical blockers, risks, and client-facing issues early enough for the team to course-correct.
  • Advocate for best practices in testing, security, performance, and CI/CD, and encourage others to do the same.
  • Work directly with working-level client stakeholders over email, on calls, and in person, and start building demo and presentation content of your own.
  • Apply AI and agentic capabilities to real client work, and contribute back to how the craft adopts them through reusable templates, prototyping sessions, and practical guidance for other teams.
  • Share what you learn, internally through Slack, brown bags, and DEPT U, and externally through articles or talks as project work allows.

What you bring

  • Proven experience building and maintaining production-level backend systems used by real people.
  • Strong proficiency in Python.
  • Experience designing and integrating APIs and third-party systems.
  • Solid working knowledge of database platforms, both SQL and NoSQL.
  • Enough familiarity with modern frontend development (preferably Angular and Typescript) to read the code, review a PR, and debug across the stack.
  • Experience with at least one major cloud provider. Google Cloud preferred, AWS or Azure also welcome.
  • Daily, real-world use of GenAI productivity tools (Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex) in your development workflow.
  • A working understanding of core LLM concepts and where they're a good fit for a problem.
  • Fluency with version control (git), Agile processes, and CI/CD tooling.
  • The ability to research independently and know when to ask for help, without spinning wheels on already-solved problems.
  • A track record of "getting sh*t done" in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus points

  • Experience mentoring engineers earlier in their careers.
  • Exposure to agent development frameworks.
  • Contributions to open source, technical writing, or conference speaking.

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage
  • 401k plan, plus matching
  • PTO
  • Paid Company Holidays
  • Parental Leave

WE SUPPORT YOU BEING YOU:

DEPT® is an equal opportunity employer (EOE). We believe our work is its best when our people feel safe and free to be themselves. We’re committed to an inclusive and barrier-free recruitment and selection process and workplace, regardless of anyone’s identity, background, beliefs, lifestyle or disabilities. So tell us about any accommodations you need. It’s totally confidential and only used to make sure you feel fully supported at every step.

DEPT® participates in E-Verify, meaning your Form I-9 information will be sent to the federal government to confirm you are authorized to work in the U.S.

We are a B Corp-certified company passionate about purpose-driven work. Our hope is that you can feel good about the contributions DEPT® is making to the world and we always have an open door for your ideas in making the world a better place.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Coach, eBay, and OpenAI.

Learn more about DEPT®

DIVERSITY, EQUITY, & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our effortshere.

raw.description:
This is the role that decides whether our People Team scales or stalls. You own the systems and data behind a global team of more than 200 people in 8+ countries. You turn Rippling into a platform that runs itself, build the dashboards our leaders rely on to make decisions, and give the team its time back for work that moves the business.

your impact

Rippling, our HRIS, and our learning management system (LMS) are the backbone of how we run people operations across 8+ countries. You'll own both and keep improving them, building on the AI and automation the team already uses, so employees and managers get self-service they actually use and our leadership team and board get people data they can trust. You'll report to our Global Head of People Systems & Operations, work closely with our Global People Director on the data and insights that shape people decisions, and partner with stakeholders across the business, including our People Advisor - APAC, who leads Rippling governance and administration and owns the Time Off and Documents modules, and our People Advisor - EMEA/US.

what you'll do

  • Own Rippling configuration, workflows and automation globally, with the People Advisor - APAC leading governance, administration and data maintenance, so it's the single source of truth for people data in every country we operate in.

  • Partner with the People Advisor - APAC on the full systems and documents audit and turn the findings into a stable, well-governed setup.

  • Build and automate workflows that remove manual work, from approvals to onboarding tasks to reminders.

  • Build reports and dashboards that turn people data into insights leaders can act on, from headcount and turnover to hiring and performance, and deliver board-ready MI on a regular, reliable rhythm.

  • Work with our internal data and engineering experts for people MI, so we track process and performance as well as headcount.

  • Partner with the Global People Director, Finance and business leaders to understand what they need from people data and systems, and turn those needs into reports, workflows and fixes.

  • Build and automate the performance cycle in Rippling, from goals to reviews, so the Global Head of People Systems & Operations, who owns the cycle, gets clear dashboards and no manual tracking.

  • Own our LMS and make learning easy to find, assign and track.

  • Partner with the Regional Talent Acquisition Lead on Lever, using AI and automation to improve the candidate experience so hiring flows into onboarding in Rippling as one journey.

  • Launch and grow self-service so managers and employees get answers to first-line questions without waiting on us.

  • Make the most of AI in everything you own, from analysis and reporting to workflows and self-service, and keep testing new tools as they emerge.

  • Other related duties as reasonably assigned, in line with the scope and level of this role

how we'll measure success

  • Dashboards that are accurate and delivered on time, on a regular rhythm.

  • Self-service adoption by managers and employees, and a shrinking backlog of manual work you have automated.

  • Time and motion re-measured across the team, showing the capacity freed for higher-value work.

    • You own this area day to day. You go to the Global Head of People Systems & Operations for cross-team prioritisation, budget for new tools, and workflow principles that affect more than one team.

what you'll bring

  • 5+ years in HR, people operations or HR analytics, including at least 3 years administering an HRIS (Rippling, Workday, HiBob, BambooHR or similar), ideally across multiple countries.

  • Strong data analysis skills: you build reports and dashboards from people data and explain what the numbers mean, not only what they are (advanced Excel or Google Sheets).

  • A systems mindset: you see a manual process and want to automate it.

  • A solid grasp of how HR systems fit together, from data structure and permissions to integrations and reporting.

  • A habit of learning: you use AI tools every day, stay curious about new ones and keep building your skills.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including explaining data and system changes clearly to senior leaders in English.

  • A proactive, collaborative, customer-first mindset.

    • Nice to have (but genuinely optional):

  • Hands-on Rippling admin experience (Workflow Studio, custom reports, permissions).

  • Experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make) or SQL and BI tools.

  • Experience running an LMS or a performance cycle in an HRIS.

  • Experience presenting people data to senior leaders or a board.

life at clearer.io

    eCommerce is crowded, noisy and increasingly complex. At clearer.io, we're built for a different outcome: clarity you can act on.

Our AI agents enrich their catalogue, learn from their reviews and customers, and put that intelligence to work inside the tools they already own — so their products get found, trusted and chosen by shoppers and AI, without replatforming. We do this across our products: Clearer, Boost Commerce, REVIEWS.io and Influence, used by thousands of merchants worldwide.

    We care about doing the work properly: listening first, building second and shipping quickly where it matters. Results matter more than rhetoric.

  • Purposeful progress: we don't settle - we take initiative and embrace bold thinking

  • Endless innovation: we refine, improve, and take meaningful action

  • Always open: we build trust through transparency and global collaboration

clear benefits

  • Give Back Day - a paid day each year to volunteer for a cause you care about

  • Bonusly peer recognition - real-time shout-outs tied to our values, with points that convert to real rewards

a fair shot for everyone
